entries.name: Climb
entries.text: Ascend steep or vertical surfaces. May also be used against exceptionally large opponents; see combat movement on p. 162.

entries.name: Consume Alcohol
entries.text: Resist intoxication and loss of judgement/consciousness; also useful in displays of drinking endurance.

entries.name: Cool
entries.text: Stay composed under pressure, resist Fear, maintain resolve and oppose Charm, Intimidate or other Psychology effects (p. 183).

entries.name: Dodge
entries.text: Evade hazards or attacks by moving out of their path; commonly used to oppose attacks and avoid combat Damage.

entries.name: Drive
entries.text: Control road vehicles, including carts, coaches and unusual engineered vehicles.

entries.name: Endurance
entries.text: Withstand deprivation, prolonged effort and hostile environments. Also resists/removes Conditions (p. 184) and assists Wound recovery (p. 170).

entries.name: Entertain
entries.text: Perform for an audience with Acting, Comedy, Singing or Storytelling.

entries.name: Evaluate
entries.text: Appraise unusual goods, identify forgeries and detect flaws. Ordinary familiar items' approximate worth does not require this Skill.

entries.name: Animal Care
entries.text: At least one Advance maintains animal health in ordinary conditions without a Test. Test to diagnose illness, treat disease or heal injury; treatment details are on p. 171.

entries.name: Animal Training
entries.text: Train a particular animal type through the Animal Training Endeavour (p. 196). Listed specialisations: Demigryph, Dog, Hawk, Horse and Pigeon.

entries.name: Art
entries.text: Produce artwork in your chosen medium; more SL improves quality. Large/complex pieces may require an Extended Test. Listed specialisations: Drawing, Engraving, Mosaics, Painting, Sculpture, Tattooing, Weaving and Writing.

entries.name: Athletics
entries.text: Covers running, jumping and general physical movement or exertion.

entries.name: Bribery
entries.text: Locate people open to bribery, or Test to assess whether a specific person can be bribed and estimate their price.

entries.name: Channelling
entries.text: Gather and control Winds of Magic using the magic system (Chapter 8). Listed specialisations include Aqshy, Azyr, Chamon, Dhar, Ghur, Ghyran, Hysh, Magick, Shyish and Ulgu.

entries.name: Charm
entries.text: Encourage favourable consideration of you, your views or proposed actions. Success earns consideration, not automatic obedience.

entries.name: Charm Animal
entries.text: Befriend, calm or subdue an animal, including persuading it to stop threatening you or accept a distraction.

entries.name: Intuition
entries.text: Read people and surroundings to detect lies, concealed information or signs that something is wrong.

entries.name: Language
entries.text: Learn a non-native language. One Advance permits communication; complex discussion may still require a Test. Four Advances grant fluency without Tests. Examples include Bretonnian, Reikspiel and Wastelander; see p. 149.

entries.name: Leadership
entries.text: Direct others and command respect in combat, emergencies or social hierarchies.

entries.name: Lore
entries.text: Recall knowledge in a studied or experienced subject. Routine facts need no Test; unusual/obscure information does. Listed specialisations: Engineering, Geology, Heraldry, History, Law, Local*, Magic, Metallurgy, Science and Theology.

entries.name: Melee
entries.text: Fight with a specific close-combat weapon group. Lacking the correct specialisation usually penalises use (Chapter 11). Listed groups: Basic, Brawling, Cavalry, Fencing, Flail, Parry, Polearm and Two-handed.

entries.name: Navigation
entries.text: Find routes across wilderness or sea using landmarks, stars, maps or charts.

entries.name: Outdoor Survival
entries.text: Live off the land: hunt, fish, forage, build shelter/fire, read approaching weather and recognise animal traces, including with few tools.

entries.name: Gamble
entries.text: Assess wagers and play games of chance. Cheating uses the separate procedure on p. 135.

entries.name: Gossip
entries.text: Gather useful news or circulate rumours, typically where people gather.

entries.name: Haggle
entries.text: Negotiate a better bargain, usually through Opposed Haggle (p. 131).

entries.name: Heal
entries.text: A successful Test can identify illness, treat disease, restore Wounds or stop Bleeding. Illness, injury and treatment procedures appear on p. 172.

entries.name: Intimidate
entries.text: Pressure or frighten thinking creatures through explicit or implied threats.

entries.name: Pray
entries.text: Communicate with or petition a deity; divine-intervention procedures use Chapter 7.

entries.name: Ranged
entries.text: Use a particular missile-weapon group. Missing the required specialisation incurs the weapon-use penalties in Chapter 11. Listed groups: Blackpowder, Bow, Crossbow, Engineering, Entangling, Explosives, Sling and Throwing.

entries.name: Research
entries.text: Find useful, often obscure information in libraries or similar collections. Requires Read/Write; research guidance is on p. 150.

entries.name: Ride
entries.text: Ride animals within a chosen group. Horse also covers mules, donkeys and similar mounts. Listed specialisations: Demigryph, Griffon, Horse and Pegasus. Mounted combat is on p. 168.

entries.name: Row
entries.text: Propel a boat with oars. Tests are normally reserved for difficult conditions, races, rapids or urgent escapes.

entries.name: Sail
entries.text: Handle a sailing vessel, including ropes, steering and wind judgement, alone or within a crew. Commanding a trained crew instead uses Leadership.

entries.name: Perception
entries.text: Notice things through any available sense, including magical or non-human senses.

entries.name: Perform
entries.text: Entertain people close enough to watch through a successful physical performance. Listed specialisations: Acrobatics, Clowning, Dancing, Firebreathing, Juggling, Miming and Rope Walking.

entries.name: Pick Lock
entries.text: Understand locking mechanisms and open them without the proper key; lock complexity varies.

entries.name: Play
entries.text: A successful instrumental performance entertains listeners within hearing range. Listed specialisations: Bagpipe, Lute, Harpsichord, Horn and Violin.

entries.name: Secret Signs
entries.text: Read and leave concealed group-specific messages or warnings. Listed specialisations: Grey Order, Guild (Any One), Ranger, Scout, Thief and Vagabond.

entries.name: Set Trap
entries.text: Prepare or disarm traps, from simple snares to complex mechanisms.

entries.name: Sleight of Hand
entries.text: Pick pockets, conceal small objects, perform hand tricks or cheat at games. Usually Opposed by the target's Perception.

entries.name: Stealth
entries.text: Avoid notice through concealment, quiet movement or blending in. Listed specialisations: Rural, Underground and Urban.

entries.name: Swim
entries.text: Having this Skill permits ordinary swimming without a Test. Difficult currents, racing or escaping danger require Tests.

entries.name: Track
entries.text: Find and follow another's trail, or conceal your own.

entries.name: Trade
entries.text: Practise a craft/service and understand its associated knowledge. Listed specialisations: Apothecary, Calligrapher, Chandler, Carpenter, Cook, Embalmer, Engineer, Herbalist, Shipwright, Smith and Tanner.

entries.name: Accurate Shot
entries.text: Successful Ranged Attacks deal +1 Damage, or +2 if you aimed (p. 167).

entries.name: Acute Sense (Sense)
entries.text: Choose one of the five senses. The GM may allow Perception Tests using it to notice details normally beyond perception. Each further purchase selects a different sense.

entries.name: Aethyric Attunement
entries.text: On a Minor Miscast, roll twice and choose either result. A second purchase grants the same choice on Major Miscasts.

entries.name: Alley Cat
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Stealth (Urban) Tests. In a familiar settlement, identify its fastest or least conspicuous routes without a Test.

entries.name: Ambidextrous
entries.text: Ignore the −2 SL penalty for Tests relying only on your secondary hand, including attacks with a weapon held there.

entries.name: Animal Affinity
entries.text: Wild animals normally leave you alone while you show no aggression towards them.

entries.name: Arcane Magic (Lore)
entries.text:
Choose a Colour Lore (Beasts, Death, Fire, Heavens, Life, Light, Metal or Shadows), Witch Lore such as Hedgecraft or Witchcraft, or Dark Lore such as Daemonology or Necromancy. Gain one chosen spell in that Lore and access to memorise more. Normally only one Arcane Lore is allowed; with GM permission and suitable study, one Dark Lore may be added to another Arcane Lore. Pay 100 XP to unlearn the Talent, immediately losing its spells.

| Spells already known | XP for next spell |
| --- | --- |
| Up to 5 | 100 |
| 6–10 | 200 |
| 11–15 | 300 |
| 16–20 | 400 |
| 21+ | 500 |

entries.name: Argumentative
entries.text: To leave a pointless argument with you, the other person must win Cool Opposed by your Charm. While arguing, they suffer −3 SL to most Tests unrelated to you until attacked or alerted to something more important.

entries.name: Artistic (Art)
entries.text: Choose an art form, such as painting or poetry. Gain Advantage on Art Tests in that medium and may always Advance Art regardless of Career. Each further purchase chooses a different form.

entries.name: Attractive
entries.text: After a successful Charm Test on someone attracted to you, choose either the rolled SL or your units-die result as SL.

entries.name: Battle Rage
entries.text: When another ability permits Frenzy (p. 184), enter it without a Test. Ending Frenzy causes no Fatigued Condition.

entries.name: Beat Blade
entries.text: After a successful Melee Attack, you may forgo Damage. Until the opponent’s next Turn ends, they cannot Oppose Melee Tests with a Melee Skill, and Melee Attacks against them gain Advantage. Dodge remains available. Does not work against a larger opponent (p. 360).

entries.name: Beneath Notice
entries.text: With suitable clothing and behaviour, people generally assume you belong, including in the presence of social superiors. A plausible explanation satisfies gate guards or similar questions. Drawing attention through a blunder, weapon or other conspicuous action ends this protection.

entries.name: Berserk Charge
entries.text: A Charge deals +2 Damage.

entries.name: Blather
entries.text: When caught where you should not be or doing something improper, make Charm Opposed by Cool. Success makes the target accept your explanation for one Turn or minute per SL, as appropriate. If SL exceed their Willpower Bonus, belief lasts until someone points out its inconsistency.

entries.name: Bless (Deity)
entries.text: Gain all Blessings of your deity. Normally only one Bless (Deity) Talent is allowed. Bless is incompatible, in either direction, with Channelling, Arcane Magic, Chaos Magic, Magic Resistance, Petty Magic and Witch! Unlearning costs 100 XP, removes all its Blessings and may incur divine displeasure determined by the GM.

entries.name: Bookish
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Research Tests.

entries.name: Break and Enter
entries.text: By observing a building, locked room or vault, identify its apparently quickest and quietest entry. Gain Advantage on Pick Lock and Strength Tests to force doors or windows.

entries.name: Briber
entries.text: A brief conversation reveals whether someone accepts bribes and the amount needed for cooperation or silence. Gain Advantage on Bribery Tests.

entries.name: Cardsharp
entries.text: On a double in an Opposed Gamble Test, you may reroll the opponent’s Test and cancel any advantage they gained through Sleight of Hand.

entries.name: Careful Strike
entries.text: Melee Called Shots suffer only −1 SL, or no penalty when attacking with Advantage.

entries.name: Carouser
entries.text: Modest drinking causes no ill effects or Consume Alcohol Tests; test only when drinking excessively. Gain Advantage on Consume Alcohol Tests and Endurance Tests against poison.

entries.name: Catfall
entries.text: Treat every fall as deliberate, allowing an Athletics Test to reduce Damage. Athletics Tests made while falling gain Advantage.

entries.name: Cat-tongued
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Charm Tests to lie convincingly.

entries.name: Chaos Magic (Lore)
entries.text:
Gain one chosen spell from your selected Chaos Lore and access to memorise more. Each spell gained from it causes one Corruption Point. Normally only one Chaos Lore is allowed. This Talent cannot be unlearned.

| Spells already known | XP for next spell |
| --- | --- |
| Up to 5 | 100 |
| 6–10 | 200 |
| 11–15 | 300 |
| 16–20 | 400 |
| 21+ | 500 |

entries.name: Combat Aware
entries.text: Pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Perception Test to avoid Surprised. If the GM would already allow a Test to avoid Surprise, succeed automatically.

entries.name: Combat Master
entries.text: Count as two people when outnumbering an enemy or determining whether your side is outnumbered (p. 167).

entries.name: Combat Reflexes
entries.text: Roll Combat Initiative twice and choose either result.

entries.name: Commanding Presence
entries.text: Without an established authority in a crisis, people usually look to you and obey reasonable orders. Gain Advantage on Leadership Tests.

entries.name: Concoct
entries.text: Once per session, take a free Crafting Endeavour with Trade (Apothecary, Herbalist or Poisoner) without a Workshop; Trade Tools and materials remain required. The creation expires at the next Downtime’s start, complete or otherwise.

entries.name: Contortionist
entries.text: At the GM’s discretion, squeeze through gaps normally difficult or impossible. Gain Advantage on Athletics Tests to escape restraints.

entries.name: Coolheaded
entries.text: Gain +5 Willpower. This does not count toward Advances.

entries.name: Crack the Whip
entries.text: With Drive, direct your vehicle’s animals to take an Action as well as a Move without a Test. Required Drive Tests gain Advantage. In a vehicle Pursuit, add +1 to the animals’ Movement.

entries.name: Craftsman (Trade)
entries.text: Choose a Trade specialisation. Gain Advantage on its Tests and may Advance it regardless of Career. Each further purchase selects a different Trade.

entries.name: Criminal
entries.text: Double coin from successful criminal Income Endeavours. Law enforcers regard you suspiciously and criminals recognise you as one of them. You cannot enter a Career whose path lacks Criminal. With GM approval, pay 100 XP to remove this Talent.

entries.name: Deadeye Shot
entries.text: Ranged Called Shots suffer only −1 SL, or no penalty if aimed (p. 167).

entries.name: Dealmaker
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Haggle Tests and usually recognise when an offer cannot improve.

entries.name: Detect Artefact
entries.text: Touch identifies whether an item contains magic. With Second Sight, an Intuition Test can reveal its exact powers, activation and remaining charges.

entries.name: Dicer
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Gamble Tests.

entries.name: Dirty Fighting
entries.text: If an unarmed Called Shot to the body causes any Wounds, you may replace normal Damage with the Low Blow! Critical Wound (p. 175).

entries.name: Disarm
entries.text: After a successful attacking melee strike, forgo Damage to knock a held weapon 1d10 feet in a random direction. You may lose Momentum to catch it. Does not affect unarmed opponents, securely attached weapons or larger opponents (p. 360).

entries.name: Distract
entries.text: After a successful Melee Attack, forgo Damage to remove the target’s Momentum. Until your next Turn ends, it cannot regain Momentum or gain Advantage on a Test from any other cause.

entries.name: Doomed
entries.text: At age 10, a doomsayer of Morr foretold your death during the Dooming. Agree a Doom with the GM. Dying as foretold immediately refreshes every ally’s Fortune and gives your next character one additional starting Fate.

entries.name: Drilled
entries.text: Allies may freely Disengage from opponents you are also Engaged with. On your Turn, lose Momentum to give Momentum to shoulder-to-shoulder allies who also have Drilled.

entries.name: Dual Wielder
entries.text: When fighting with two weapons (p. 167), the second weapon’s free attack costs no Momentum. Daggers, Knives and similar weapons you wield also gain Parry in this situation.

entries.name: Embezzle
entries.text: When Earning in play or through Income, substitute Bribery or Evaluate for the normal Earning Skill to embezzle. Success doubles earnings; failure exposes irregularities and leaves you earning nothing while concealing them.

entries.name: Enclosed Fighter
entries.text: Ignore Melee penalties from confined spaces. You may Dodge even where space would normally prevent it.

entries.name: Etiquette (Social Group)
entries.text: Choose a social group, such as Criminals, Cultists, Guilders, Nobles or Soldiers. Appropriate dress and behaviour let you blend in; the GM may warn you when your behaviour would breach that group’s customs.

entries.name: Fast Hands
entries.text: Use Sleight of Hand to entertain with appearing or vanishing small objects. Gain Advantage on Sleight of Hand and on Melee (Brawling) Tests to touch an opponent, including for spells.

entries.name: Fast Shot
entries.text: While not Engaged, make one attack with a loaded Pistol-Trait weapon before the Round’s first turn. It consumes your Action for that Round. Resolve multiple Fast Shots in Combat Initiative order. On your turn, act normally but make no further attack.

entries.name: Fearless (Enemy)
entries.text: Choose an enemy group, such as Giants, Skeletons or Trolls, and become immune to fear it causes. Each further purchase chooses another group.

entries.name: Feint
entries.text: When attacking in melee with Advantage against an opponent without it, you may force them to defend using Intuition instead of another Skill or Characteristic.

entries.name: Field Dressing
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Heal Tests and easily make basic bandages or splints from ordinary materials.

entries.name: Fisherman
entries.text: With suitable fishing equipment and sufficient water, catch enough food for yourself plus Initiative Bonus other people. Normal foraging can secure additional fish (p. 152).

entries.name: Flagellant
entries.text: Feel no pain and ignore Critical Wound penalties except amputations. If another effect permits Frenzy, suffering a Wound lets you enter it immediately without a Test (p. 184).

entries.name: Flee!
entries.text: After Disengaging, immediately make an extra Move away. Choosing to Flee in combat causes no Broken Conditions (p. 163). Gain +1 SL on pursuit Tests as Quarry.

entries.name: Fleet-footed
entries.text: Increase Movement by 1.

entries.name: Frenzy
entries.text: Pass a Willpower Test to enter Frenzy, gaining extra attacks, additional melee Damage and immunity to most psychological effects. See p. 184 for the full Frenzy rules.

entries.name: Frightening
entries.text: Gain Fear 1, or Fear 2 if Large (p. 360). Enemies need an Extended Psychology Test with successes equal to Fear Rating, testing once each turn. Until successful, they cannot gain Momentum and your Melee Attacks against them gain Advantage.

entries.name: Furious Assault
entries.text: Once per Round after hitting in melee, lose Momentum to make an immediate extra attack.

entries.name: Gregarious
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Gossip Tests and usually recognise a settlement’s likely places for gossip.

entries.name: Gunner
entries.text: Ignore Dangerous on Blackpowder, Engineering and Explosive weapons you use.

entries.name: Hardy
entries.text: Add Toughness Bonus once more when calculating Wounds.

entries.name: Hatred (Group)
entries.text: Choose a group to Hate, such as beastmen, goblins, orcs, monsters, outlaws, Sigmarites, undead or witches. On encountering it, pass a Psychology Test or immediately seek its destruction by the fastest, deadliest means. Against it, gain +1 SL on Melee and Ranged Tests and immunity to its Intimidate and Fear, but not Terror. Full Hatred rules: p. 184.

entries.name: Holy Hatred
entries.text: When a Miracle causes Wounds, you may add +2 Wounds.

entries.name: Holy Visions
entries.text: Automatically recognise holy ground on entering it, perceive Blessings, Miracles and Chaos Magic cast in sight, and sense an object’s divine power by touching it.

entries.name: Hunter’s Eye
entries.text: With sufficient time, proper equipment and well-stocked hunting land, automatically obtain enough game for yourself and Initiative Bonus others. Normal foraging can provide more (p. 152).

entries.name: Impassioned Zeal (Cause)
entries.text: Choose a political, religious or philosophical cause. Charm Tests advocating it gain Advantage; lying about or denouncing it causes Disadvantage.

entries.name: Implacable
entries.text: Whenever you would gain Bleeding Conditions, gain one fewer.

entries.name: In-fighter
entries.text: As an Action, make an Opposed Melee Test to close inside the enemy’s reach. The winner chooses normal combat or in-fighting. In-fighting makes weapons longer than Short count as Improvised. An opponent can end it at their Turn’s start by losing Momentum.

entries.name: Inspiring
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Leadership Tests in combat.

entries.name: Instinctive Diction
entries.text: You may subtract 20 from a Minor Miscast table result; below 01, no Miscast occurs. Major Miscasts are unaffected.

entries.name: Invoke (Deity)
entries.text: Gain one chosen Miracle of your deity and access to memorise further available Miracles at their listed XP costs. Normally only one Invoke (Deity) is allowed. Invoke is incompatible, in either direction, with Channelling, Arcane Magic, Chaos Magic, Magic Resistance, Petty Magic and Witch! Unlearning costs 100 XP, removes all its Miracles and incurs extreme divine displeasure determined by the GM.

entries.name: Iron Jaw
entries.text: The first time each encounter that you would gain Stunned Conditions, gain one fewer.

entries.name: Iron Will
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Cool Tests against others’ influence, including Fellowship Tests and magic.

entries.name: Jump Up
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Perform (Acrobatics) Tests to entertain or move quickly outside combat. Upon gaining Prone, immediately attempt a Challenging (+0 SL) Athletics or Perform (Acrobatics) Test to stand.

entries.name: Kingpin
entries.text: Criminal no longer makes law enforcers suspicious or restricts Career access. Other criminals usually respect you, except prepared rivals seeking your position.

entries.name: Lightning Reflexes
entries.text: Gain +5 Agility. This does not count toward Advances.

entries.name: Linguistics
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Language Tests. Every Advance in a Language specialisation costs 50 XP regardless of previous Advances. Language (Magick) is excluded: this applies only to languages used for communication.

entries.name: Lip Reading
entries.text: With a clear view of a speaker’s mouth, pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Intuition Test to read their words.

entries.name: Luck
entries.text: Increase maximum Fortune by 1. May be purchased three times, for a total +3.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.text: Reduce the SL of every spell affecting you by 3. This Talent is mutually exclusive with Channelling, Arcane Magic, Bless, Chaos Magic, Invoke, Petty Magic and Witch!

entries.name: Magical Sense
entries.text: Automatically notice spellcasting within Perception yards and its rough direction, but not its nature. With Second Sight or another way to perceive the Winds, gain Advantage on Tests to interpret their behaviour or movement.

entries.name: Magnum Opus
entries.text: Each purchase lets you create one extraordinary masterwork using an Art or Trade Skill. It grants GM-determined bonuses, usually to Fellowship Tests involving people who have seen it. Selling it yields at least ten times normal value. Further purchases create additional masterworks.

entries.name: Marksman
entries.text: Gain +5 Ballistic Skill. This does not count toward Advances.

entries.name: Master of Disguise
entries.text: Change posture, facial expression and suitable clothing to disguise your appearance. On successful Entertain (Acting) Tests, choose rolled SL or the units-die result as SL.

entries.name: Master Orator
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Lore (Law) Tests to plead before a magistrate and equivalent Lore Tests to argue academic, religious or political matters before an audience.

entries.name: Master Tradesman (Trade)
entries.text: Choose a Trade specialisation. On successful Tests with it, use either rolled SL or the units-die result as SL. Further purchases choose different Trades.

entries.name: Menacing
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Intimidation Tests. Sensible thieves, bandits and pickpockets usually choose another available target.

entries.name: Mimic
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Entertain (Acting, Comedy) and Perform (Clowning). After hearing an accent for a day, reproduce it, with any local benefits set by the GM. Recognise attempts to conceal or imitate familiar accents unless the speaker also has Mimic.

entries.name: Night Vision
entries.text: With even faint light, see clearly for 20 yards and extend light sources’ effective illumination by 20 yards.

entries.name: Nimble-fingered
entries.text: Gain +5 Dexterity. This does not count toward Advances.

entries.name: Noble Blood
entries.text: When appropriately dressed, count as at least one Status Tier above anyone without Noble Blood. Against others with it, compare Status normally. Enter Noble as though it shared your current Class.

entries.name: Nose for Trouble
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Intuition Tests and usually locate opportunities for gambling, fighting or heavy drinking in a settlement.

entries.name: Numismatics
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Lore (Heraldry) Tests identifying the origin of coins, medals and flags. After a successful Evaluate Test to value an item, choose rolled SL or the units-die result as SL.

entries.name: Old Salt
entries.text: On successful ocean Row or Sail Tests, choose rolled SL or the units-die result as SL. Count as two boatmen towards an ocean-going vessel’s minimum crew.

entries.name: Orientation
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Navigation Tests. A glimpse of familiar signs, such as stars or trees, automatically reveals north.

entries.name: Panhandle
entries.text: Gain Advantage on begging Charm Tests, including Income Endeavours. Usually find safe but uncomfortable urban sleeping places, such as beneath bridges or near middens.

entries.name: Perfect Pitch
entries.text: Learn music after hearing it once. Gain Advantage on Entertain (Singing) and Play (Any) Tests.

entries.name: Petty Magic
entries.text:
Gain Willpower Bonus Petty spells on learning this Talent. Additional spells use the prices below; see Chapter 8: Magic. Unlearning costs 100 XP and immediately removes every spell linked to it.

| Spells already known | XP for next spell |
| --- | --- |
| Up to 5 | 50 |
| 6–10 | 100 |
| 11–15 | 150 |
| 16–20 | 200 |
| 21+ | 250 |

entries.name: Pharmacist
entries.text: Creating an alchemical remedy produces one additional dose (p. 154).

entries.name: Pilot
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Row and Sail Tests.

entries.name: Public Speaker
entries.text: Easily gather a crowd and usually judge its mood and motivations. Gain Advantage on Charm Tests to influence groups. Once Charmed, the group can be influenced through Leadership, including urging action or removing Broken (p. 169).

entries.name: Pure Soul
entries.text: Double the normal Corruption Point threshold before testing against mutation (p. 188).

entries.name: Rapid Reload
entries.text: Reduce your weapon’s Reload Rating by 1.

entries.name: Reaction Strike
entries.text: When Charged, pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Initiative Test to make one immediate free attack against the charger, outside turn order, using your primary-hand weapon. Limit: once per round.

entries.name: Read/Write
entries.text: Read and write every language you speak.

entries.name: Relentless
entries.text: After an opponent Disengages, test Challenging (+0 SL) Athletics, Drive or Ride at their Turn’s end. Success gives an extra Move to follow and free Disengagement from other opponents. As Pursuer in a Pursuit, gain +1 SL on chase Tests.

entries.name: Resistant (Threat)
entries.text: Choose a Threat, such as Disease, Magic, Corruption or Poison. Once per session, before rolling against that Threat, choose automatic success; further Tests against it gain Advantage. Further purchases select different Threats.

entries.name: Resolute
entries.text: When gaining a Condition, pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Cool Test to keep Momentum.

entries.name: Reversal
entries.text: In an Opposed Melee Test, retain Momentum if struck despite your own Test succeeding.

entries.name: Riposte
entries.text: Winning an Opposed Test while defending in melee lets you deal Damage as the attacker.

entries.name: River Guide
entries.text: Navigate dangerous river water without a Test unless Difficulty is Difficult (−1 SL) or harder. With the matching Lore (Local), no navigation Test is required: you know a safe route.

entries.name: Robust
entries.text: When testing to heal Wounds, you may recover 2 extra Wounds.

entries.name: Roughrider
entries.text: With Ride, direct your mount to take an Action as well as a Move without a Ride Test. Required Ride Tests gain Advantage. Mounted Pursuits add +1 to the animal’s Movement.

entries.name: Rover
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Stealth (Rural). Usually identify easy routes through wilderness and sources of game, water and shelter.

entries.name: Savant (Lore Specialisation)
entries.text: Choose a Lore specialisation you possess and gain Advantage on its Tests. Each further purchase selects a different Lore.

entries.name: Savvy
entries.text: Gain +5 Intelligence. This does not count toward Advances.

entries.name: Scale Sheer Surface
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Climb Tests. You may attempt apparently impossible surfaces, including sheer walls, ice and greased poles, with no imposed Difficulty harder than Very Hard (−3 SL).

entries.name: Schemer
entries.text: After successful Gossip or Lore (Politics) Tests, choose rolled SL or the units-die result as SL.

entries.name: Sea Legs
entries.text: Normal sea conditions require no seasickness Test. When the GM does require one, gain Advantage.

entries.name: Seasoned Traveller
entries.text: While in a region, you may always Advance its Lore (Local), regardless of Career.

entries.name: Second Sight
entries.text: Perceive the Winds of Magic (p. 236).

entries.name: Secret Identity
entries.text: Adopt a persona with a chosen Career for an encounter, day, adventure or other set period without testing to maintain it. Use that Career’s Class and Status, including for Banking or Income Endeavours. Income requires a Challenging (+0 SL) Earning Test with Entertain (Acting) or the assumed Career’s Earning Skill, rather than your real Career’s. With Embezzle, Bribery or Evaluate may replace it when embezzling. Failure exposes the deception, with GM-determined consequences.

entries.name: Shadow
entries.text: If someone you follow passes a Perception Test to detect you, choose to remain unseen and lose them, or keep following and be spotted.

entries.name: Sharp
entries.text: Gain +5 Initiative. This does not count toward Advances.

entries.name: Sharpshooter
entries.text: Ignore Ranged penalties from Prone targets and cover. Extraordinary accuracy feats remain possible with a successful Ranged Test at GM-set Difficulty.

entries.name: Shieldsman
entries.text: Once per Round while carrying a shield, lose Momentum either to grant its AP bonus to an adjacent ally without a shield or, after winning an attacking or defending Opposed Melee Test, to push the opponent up to 2 yards directly away and end engagement.

entries.name: Sixth Sense
entries.text: Just before triggering a trap or suffering hidden danger, pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Intuition Test to notice it at the final moment.

entries.name: Slayer
entries.text: Charging a creature larger than you automatically grants Momentum.

entries.name: Small
entries.text: Gain Size (Small); full Size rules are on p. 360 in Chapter 12: Bestiary.

entries.name: Sniper
entries.text: Ignore Long Range shooting penalties. Extreme Range shots suffer only −1 SL.

entries.name: Speedreader
entries.text: Read a full page at a glance and even a long book in a day. Double SL from successful Tests in an Extended Research Test.

entries.name: Sprinter
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Athletics Tests to run or jump.

entries.name: Step Aside
entries.text: After successfully Dodging an attack, move up to 2 yards and end engagement without granting opponents free attacks.

entries.name: Stone Soup
entries.text: A party member’s Foraging Test automatically finds enough extra food for you, even on failure, beyond whoever the result normally feeds (p. 152).

entries.name: Stout-hearted
entries.text: The first time each encounter you gain Broken Conditions, gain one fewer.

entries.name: Striding Gait (Terrain)
entries.text: Choose terrain, such as Coastal, Desert, Rocky, Tundra, Wetland or Woodland. Ignore its movement penalties and gain +2 SL to all Pursuit-related Tests there. Further purchases select different terrain.

entries.name: Strike Mighty Blow
entries.text: Melee weapons deal +1 Damage, or +2 when the attack has Advantage.

entries.name: Strike to Injure
entries.text: Roll twice on Critical Wound tables and choose either result. Silent Takedowns also ignore the Called Shot penalty (p. 135).

entries.name: Strike to Stun
entries.text: Improvised Weapons gain Pummel. With a Pummel weapon, ignore the Silent Takedown Called Shot penalty (p. 135).

entries.name: Strong Back
entries.text: Gain +1 SL on Opposed Strength Tests and carry +1 Encumbrance. A second purchase raises both totals to +3.

entries.name: Strong Legs
entries.text: On successful Athletics Tests to sprint or leap, choose rolled SL or the units-die result as SL.

entries.name: Strong-minded
entries.text: Once per session, before a Test, choose to ignore all its negative modifiers.

entries.name: Strong Swimmer
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Swim Tests and +2 SL in swimming Pursuits.

entries.name: Sturdy
entries.text: Count Strength Bonus twice when calculating carrying capacity in Encumbrance Points.

entries.name: Suave
entries.text: Gain +5 Fellowship. This does not count toward Advances.

entries.name: Super Numerate
entries.text: Calculate most mathematical problems without tools. Gain Advantage on Evaluate Tests and accurately track elapsed time while conscious.

entries.name: Supportive
entries.text: Ignore penalties for Charming higher Status Tiers, and gain Advantage on Charm Tests to ingratiate yourself with higher-Status people.

entries.name: Sure Shot
entries.text: Ranged Attacks deal +1 Damage and may ignore Partial armour. Impale weapons may also ignore Weakpoints armour.

entries.name: Surgery
entries.text: On successful Heal Tests outside combat, choose rolled SL or the units-die result as SL. Treat Critical Wounds requiring Surgery; see pp. 172–179 for effects.

entries.name: Tenacious
entries.text: The first time each encounter you would gain Fatigued Conditions, gain one fewer.

entries.name: Tinker
entries.text: For repairs, treat every Trade as Basic. With at least one Advance in the relevant Trade, repair Tests gain Advantage and take half normal time.

entries.name: Tower of Memories
entries.text: Store facts in an imagined tower to recall them precisely. On successful Lore Tests, choose rolled SL or the units-die result as SL.

entries.name: Trapper
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Set Trap Tests. With one hour of preparation, build a small animal trap or covered pit from available materials (p. 136).

entries.name: Trick Rider
entries.text: While mounted, use any Perform Skill and Dodge without modification.

entries.name: Tunnel Fighter
entries.text: Gain Advantage on Stealth (Underground). Easily estimate distance travelled underground and depth below ground.

entries.name: Unshakeable
entries.text: Being shot at with a Blackpowder weapon requires no Test to resist Broken.

entries.name: Very Resilient
entries.text: Gain +5 Toughness. This does not count toward Advances.

entries.name: Very Strong
entries.text: Gain +5 Strength. This does not count toward Advances.

entries.name: War Leader
entries.text: Allies affected by your battlefield Leadership may use it instead of Cool against Fear until the battle ends (p. 169). This ends if you die and is suspended while you have Broken, Unconscious or Fear Conditions.

entries.name: Warrior Born
entries.text: Gain +5 Weapon Skill. This does not count toward Advances.

entries.name: War Wizard
entries.text: On your Turn, cast one spell of CN 5 or less without using your Action. You cannot cast another spell that Turn.

entries.name: Waterman
entries.text: On successful Row or Sail Tests on rivers or lakes, choose rolled SL or the units-die result as SL. Count as two crew towards a river vessel’s minimum crew.

entries.name: Wealthy
entries.text: Earning through your Career in play or through Income provides +1 gold crown. A second purchase increases the total bonus to +3 gold crowns.

entries.name: Well-prepared
entries.text: Once per session, produce a needed Encumbrance 0 Trapping that you could plausibly have bought recently. Deduct its price as an earlier purchase; without money, you cannot use this Talent. Further uses that session cost Fortune.

entries.name: Witch!
entries.text: Gain one chosen Colour Lore or Witchcraft spell without needing the matching Arcane Magic, and treat its Channelling Skill as Basic. Another spell with the same benefits costs 150 XP, with each later spell costing 50 XP more. Witch hunters may take interest and established magical orders may present difficulties. Pay 100 XP to remove this Talent and every linked spell.

entries.name: Blessing of Battle
entries.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Weapon Skill.

entries.name: Blessing of Breath
entries.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

The target needs no air and ignores Suffocation.

entries.name: Blessing of Charisma
entries.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Fellowship.

entries.name: Blessing of Conscience
entries.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Breaking any stricture of your deity requires Average (+2 SL) Cool. Failure prevents that action through shame.

entries.name: Blessing of Courage
entries.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Willpower.

entries.name: Blessing of Finesse
entries.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Dexterity.

entries.name: Blessing of Fortune
entries.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

The target may reroll its next failed Test and must accept the new result.

entries.name: Blessing of Grace
entries.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Agility.

entries.name: Blessing of Hardiness
entries.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Toughness.

entries.name: Blessing of Healing
entries.text:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Restore 1 Wound to the target.

entries.name: Blessing of The Hunt
entries.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Ballistic Skill.

entries.name: Blessing of Might
entries.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Strength.

entries.name: Blessing of Protection
entries.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Before attacking the target, enemies must pass Average (+2 SL) Cool. Failure forces a different target or Action.

entries.name: Blessing of Recuperation
entries.text:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Reduce one disease’s duration by 1 day. Only one attempt is allowed for each instance of disease in each person.

entries.name: Blessing of Righteousness
entries.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

The target’s weapon becomes Magical.

entries.name: Blessing of Savagery
entries.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

For the target’s next Critical Wound inflicted, roll twice and use the better result.

entries.name: Blessing of Tenacity
entries.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Remove one Condition other than Besmirched from the target.

entries.name: Blessing of Wisdom
entries.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Intelligence.

entries.name: Blessing of Wit
entries.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Initiative. Cults may use different names and wording for the same Blessing without changing its effect.

entries.name: Becalm
entries.text:
Range: Fellowship Bonus miles Target: 1 sailing vessel within line of sight Duration: 1 hour

Remove a sailing vessel’s wind and surround it with calm water and weather out to Fellowship yards, even in a storm. The calm moves with it if oars or another means propel it.
entries.target: 1 sailing vessel within line of sight

entries.name: Drowned Man’s Face
entries.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

The target gains Fatigued and drowns for the duration (p. 169), including Daemons and Undead. When it ends, gain Stunned for 1 Round while expelling saltwater.

entries.name: Fair Winds
entries.text:
Range: Initiative Bonus miles Target: 1 sailing vessel within line of sight Duration: 1 hour

The vessel travels at top speed regardless of wind, tide or current. Sail Tests to control it gain +1 SL.
entries.target: 1 sailing vessel within line of sight

entries.name: Manalt’s Bounty
entries.text:
Range: Special Target: Special Duration: Instant

Reach into water to catch fish feeding one person, or two if it is seawater. Each +2 SL feeds another person.

entries.name: Sea Legs
entries.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

The target gains one each of Blinded, Deafened and Fatigued. To use its Move, it must Test Average (+2 SL) Athletics; failure also causes Prone.

entries.name: Waterwalk
entries.text:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus minutes

Walk on water as on solid ground, but only on bodies at least 10 yards wide.

entries.name: Death Mask
entries.text:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Gain Fear. Undead remain vulnerable to it despite any Talents, Traits, including Construct, or other effects.

entries.name: Destroy Undead
entries.text:
Range: Yo Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Undead in the area lose 1d10 Wounds plus 1 per SL, ignoring Toughness Bonus and AP. Under normal circumstances, those destroyed can never again be raised through Necromancy.

entries.name: Dooming
entries.text:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

See a vision of the target’s Doom, almost always concerning its death. Each character may receive this Miracle only once; afterwards it may purchase Doomed with XP as a Career Talent.

entries.name: Last Rites
entries.text:
Range: 1 yard Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Send a corpse’s soul to Morr and permanently protect the body from Necromantic spells. A foe with both Construct and Undead is destroyed.

entries.name: Portal’s Threshold
entries.text:
Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Until sunrise

Draw a line up to 8 yards long. Undead need Challenging (+0 SL) Cool to cross; those also having Construct cannot cross at all.

entries.name: Stay Morr’s Hand
entries.text:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus hours

A willing target at 0 Wounds becomes Unconscious and stops deteriorating for the duration, suspending diseases, Critical Wounds, poison and similar effects. Appropriate healing ends the Miracle. You may also end it with last rites taking about a minute, ensuring passage to Morr at death and permanently preventing Necromancy on the corpse.

entries.name: Blazing Sun
entries.text:
Range: Special Target: Special Duration: Instant

Non-Myrmidians looking towards you gain 1 Blinded, plus another per +2 SL.

entries.name: Eagle’s Eye
entries.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Create an invulnerable spectral eagle that cannot physically affect the world. Control its flight and replace your own sight with its Perception 55, Acute Sense (Sight) and Fly 80. While using its eyes you cannot see through yours.

entries.name: Fury’s Call
entries.text:
Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Allies in the area gain Frenzy (p. 358).

entries.name: Inspiring
entries.text:
Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Allies in the area gain +1 Drilled.

entries.name: Shield of Myrmidia
entries.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: Fellowship Bonus Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Allies gain +1 AP at every Hit Location.

entries.name: Spear of Myrmidia
entries.text:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

A spear you wield gains Impact and becomes Magical.

entries.name: An Invitation
entries.text:
Range: 1 yard Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Undo one fastening on a chosen door, window or hatch, such as a lock, latch or rope. Each +2 SL undoes one additional fastening.

entries.name: Cat’s Eyes
entries.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Control an invulnerable cat with normal cat abilities and share all its senses, replacing your own. Your own sense-enhancing Talents, including Night Vision, do not apply, and you cannot perceive through your body.

entries.name: Cheat the Odds
entries.text:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Special

Gain 1 Fortune Point until session’s end, plus another per +2 SL. You cannot invoke again until your Fortune reaches 0.

entries.name: Ranald’s Grace
entries.text:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

The target gains +10 Agility, +10 Stealth and +1 Catfall.

entries.name: Trickster’s Glamour
entries.text:
Range: 1 yard Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus minutes

For each target choose one: its purse appears empty or full; its clothing appears cheap and plain or rich and finely made; or one valuable item cannot be perceived. Each +2 SL adds one further effect to one target.

entries.name: You Saw Nothing
entries.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

The target remains unnoticed unless it attracts attention, for example by touching, attacking, speaking to someone, spellcasting or making loud noise. Invoke only when no one is looking directly at you.

entries.name: Rhya’s Children
entries.text:
Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship yards) Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Only usable outdoors beyond settlements. Touch earth to sense the presence and passage of all living creatures in the area.

entries.name: Rhya’s Harvest
entries.text:
Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: 1 Round

Food plants or fungi suited to the location grow where you touch. Each Round produces enough for one person.

entries.name: Rhya’s Shelter
entries.text:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Special

Only usable outdoors beyond settlements. Find natural shelter against all ordinary wind and rain, lasting as long as you camp there. It holds one person plus another per +2 SL. After breaking camp you cannot find it again.

entries.name: Rhya’s Succour
entries.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: Fellowship Bonus Duration: Instant

Each target removes 1 Condition. A target left with no Conditions also gains +1 SL on all Tests during its next Turn and feels fully rested.

entries.name: Rhya’s Touch
entries.text:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Special

Choose to heal Fellowship Bonus Wounds or cure one natural disease. Each +2 SL repeats either effect, including the same one. It takes at least 10 minutes; interruption requires a fresh attempt.

entries.name: Rhya’s Union
entries.text:
Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Fellowship Bonus hours

Consecrate two people’s union. They conceive during the duration if biologically possible.

entries.name: Anchorite’s Endurance
entries.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

The target gains Painless, feels no pain and ignores all Condition penalties.

entries.name: Balm to a Wounded Mind
entries.text:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus minutes

Suppress all Psychology Traits for the duration. Afterwards the target sleeps deeply until next sunrise unless disturbed. An unwilling target may resist sleep with Challenging (+0 SL) Cool.

entries.name: Bitter Catharsis
entries.text:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Remove one poison or disease, plus another per +2 SL. You lose 1d10 − Fellowship Bonus Wounds for each removed.

entries.name: Martyr
entries.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

You take all Damage dealt to the target instead, adding your Fellowship Bonus to your Toughness Bonus when calculating Wounds from it.

entries.name: Shallya’s Tears
entries.text:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Special

Pray uninterrupted for 10 − Fellowship Bonus Rounds to heal one Critical Wound, plus another per +2 SL. Interruption gives no benefit. Amputated parts cannot be reattached.

entries.name: Unblemished Innocence
entries.text:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Remove 1 Corruption Point gained within the last hour, plus another per +2 SL. A Fumbled invocation gives both you and the target 1d10 Corruption Points in addition to other effects.

entries.name: Beacon of Righteous Virtue
entries.text:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

All allies who see you immediately remove all Broken and gain Fearless (Everything) while the Miracle lasts and you stay in their sight. Orcs and goblins treat you as causing Fear.

entries.name: Heed Not the Witch
entries.text:
Range: You Target: You with AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Casting Tests for spells targeting any creature or place in the area take an additional −2 SL.

entries.name: Sigmar’s Fiery Hammer
entries.text:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

A warhammer you wield becomes Magical, adds Fellowship Bonus Damage, and gives each struck target +1 Ablaze.

entries.name: Soulfire
entries.text:
Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Everyone around you in the area loses 1d10 Wounds ignoring Toughness Bonus and AP. Daemon or Undead targets also gain Ablaze. Each SL may add 1 Wound against orcs, goblins, undead or Ruinous Powers servants.

entries.name: Twin-tailed Comet
entries.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards, maximum) Duration: Instant

Choose an outdoor area in sight and Range containing Sigmar’s enemies. Everything there except invalid creatures takes 1d10 + SL Wounds ignoring Toughness Bonus and AP, and gains Ablaze. If Sigmar finds no enemies, he strikes you instead.

entries.name: Vanquish the Unrighteous
entries.text:
Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Chosen allies gain Hatred towards orcs, goblins, undead and Chaos associates (p. 184). After killing such an enemy, Hatred gives +2 SL on combat Tests rather than +1 SL.

entries.name: Animal Instincts
entries.text:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus hours

Gain +1 Acute Sense (Any One). While resting, automatically wake if a threat approaches within Perception yards.

entries.name: King of the Wild
entries.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus minutes

Summon an animal suitable for the area that follows your wishes for the duration. See Beasts of the Reikland, pp. 325–327.

entries.name: Leaping Stag
entries.text:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Gain +1 Movement and +1 Strong Legs. Automatically pass Athletics Tests for Leaping.

entries.name: Lord of the Hunt
entries.text:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus hours

Choose an animal you have seen or an individual you know, subject to the GM. Its trail cannot be lost except through supernatural means, but ends on entering a settlement. Gain +1 SL on all Tests concerning that quarry.

entries.name: Tanglefoot
entries.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Everyone in the area gains one Entangled at Strength equal to your Fellowship.

entries.name: Tooth and Claw
entries.text:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Gain Bite (Strength Bonus + 3) and Weapon (Strength Bonus + 4), both with Magical attacks.

entries.name: Hoarfrost’s Chill
entries.text:
Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship yards) Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Gain Fear (p. 183). Everyone else in the area loses Advantage at each Round’s start.

entries.name: Howl of the Wolf
entries.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: Special Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Summon a white wolf to fight your enemies until expiry. Use Wolf (p. 327), with WS 45, Willpower 35, Bite +6, Frenzy, Magical and Size (Large).

entries.name: Pelt of the Winter Wolf
entries.text:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus hours

The target ignores mechanical penalties from cold and winter weather, but still feels discomfort and pain.

entries.name: The Snow King’s Judgement
entries.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Deal 1d10 Wounds plus 1 per SL, ignoring Toughness Bonus and AP. If the GM finds the target neither weak, cowardly nor deceitful, you suffer this instead.

entries.name: Ulric’s Fury
entries.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

An ally may make a free Frenzy Test on each Turn (p. 184). Replace Frenzy’s free attack with +1d10 Damage on its first melee hit that Turn. A 10 adds another d10 repeatedly until a result below 10.

entries.name: Winter’s Bite
entries.text:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

An axe you wield becomes Magical and adds SL Damage. Struck targets gain Fatigued and lose all Bleeding. Your axe cannot cause Bleeding.

entries.name: As Verena Is My Witness
entries.text:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

While you speak only truth, everyone listening believes you are truthful, though they may disagree with your conclusions.

entries.name: Blind Justice
entries.text:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Pass Challenging (+0 SL) Perception to see through illusion or misdirection Spells and Miracles. Average (+2 SL) Intuition detects whether someone speaking to you is lying, but cannot detect an honestly held mistake.

entries.name: Shackles of Truth
entries.text:
Range: Fellowship Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

A target denying a crime it committed gains an Entangled that cannot be removed during the duration. A false accusation instead makes you roll immediately on Wrath of the Gods.

entries.name: Sword of Justice
entries.text:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

A sword you wield becomes Magical and ignores AP. Struck criminals, as the GM determines, must pass Average (+2 SL) Endurance or gain Unconscious for at least Fellowship Bonus Rounds. Every crime against an unconscious target gives you +1 Sin Point.

entries.name: Truth Will Out
entries.text:
Range: Fellowship Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Ask one question for an immediate complete truthful answer. The target can Oppose your SL with Average (+2 SL) Cool: winning permits silence; +2 SL permits withholding minor detail, +4 SL significant detail, and +6 SL a lie. You know successful resistance occurred, but gain neither specific knowledge of the deceit nor proof.

entries.name: Wisdom of the Owl
entries.text:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Gain +20 Intelligence and +1 Acute Sense (Sight), Menacing and Night Vision. Ask the GM the most likely result of one immediate decision using facts currently available to you.

entries.name: Animal Friend
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: 1 yard Target: 1 Duration: 1 hour

A Bestial creature smaller than you becomes completely trusting and treats you as a friend.

entries.name: Bearings
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Instant

Know the direction of north.

entries.name: Careful Step
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Agility minutes

Organic matter remains unharmed under your steps. Track Tests to follow you through rural terrain suffer -3 SL.

entries.name: Conserve
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: 1 yard Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus days

Preserve up to a day’s rations against rot, mould and staleness. External damage, including water, fire and poison, still affects them.

entries.name: Dart
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Fire a magic missile with Damage +0.

entries.name: Dazzle
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Give the target 1 Blinded Condition immediately and another 1 at the start of every Round for the Spell’s duration.

entries.name: Drain
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Touch the target to deal a Damage +0 magic missile that ignores Armour Points, then heal yourself 1 Wound.

entries.name: Eavesdrop
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: Initiative yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus minutes

Hear the target’s speech as though beside them.

entries.name: Gust
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant

Create a momentary gust able to extinguish a candle, slam an open door or scatter a few pages.

entries.name: Light
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower minutes

Produce torch-strength light from your hand, staff or another part of your person. While active, an Average (+2 SL) Willpower Test lets you brighten it to lantern strength or dim it to candle strength.

entries.name: Magic Flame
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Create a small flame in your palm. It cannot burn you, but gives off heat and ignites flammable material as ordinary fire does.

entries.name: Marsh Lights
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower minutes

Create up to Intelligence Bonus lights resembling torches or hooded lanterns. While they remain in line of sight, spend an Action and pass Average (+2 SL) Willpower to direct them. They travel at walking pace in a straight line through objects and creatures; another Test is needed to change direction.

entries.name: Murmured Whisper
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Make your voice sound from any point within Willpower yards, even outside line of sight. Everyone within earshot of that point can hear it.

entries.name: Open Lock
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Open one non-magical lock by touching it.

entries.name: Produce Small Animal
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Instant

Produce a small local animal from a bag, pocket, hat, or beneath a rock, bush or burrow. The animal must be a type found nearby; with no suitable local animal, the Spell fails. Its temperament is uncontrolled.

entries.name: Protection from Rain
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus hours

Keep yourself and your possessions dry in any precipitation, including rain, hail, sleet, snow and similar falling water. Standing water is unaffected.

entries.name: Purify Water
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: 1 yard Target: Special Duration: Instant

Remove every non-magical impurity, including poison and contaminants, from water in one container, making it drinkable. Liquids made mostly of water, including ale and wine, become pure, non-alcoholic water.

entries.name: Rot
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: 1 yard Target: Special Duration: Instant

Rot about a fist-sized volume of organic material. Food spoils, fabric disintegrates and leather loses 1 Armour Point at 1 Hit Location; the GM determines similar effects.

entries.name: Shock
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Give the target 1 Stunned Condition.

entries.name: Sleep
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Touch a Prone target to make them Unconscious for the duration; loud noise, movement or jostling wakes them immediately. A standing or seated target instead falls Prone and wakes on impact, remaining conscious. A willing, suitably tired target falls into deep, restful sleep.

entries.name: Sly Hands
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Instant

Teleport an object no larger than your fist from elsewhere on your person into your hand.

entries.name: Sounds
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Produce quiet, indistinct sounds at a point in range, even outside line of sight. They may suggest footsteps, whispers or animals, but cannot be clear enough to communicate a message. While active, pass Average (+2 SL) Willpower to move the sounds within range or adjust their volume.

entries.name: Spring
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Touch the ground to produce water at 1 pint per Round, up to Initiative Bonus pints in total.

entries.name: Twitch
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: Half Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Move a small object slightly, such as tipping it from a shelf or shutting a book. A holder must pass Average (+2 SL) Dexterity or drop it.

entries.name: Warning
entries.text:
CN: 0 Range: 1 yard Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Immediately detect whether the object is poisoned, infected or trapped.

entries.name: Aethyric Armour
entries.text:
CN: 2 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain +1 Armour Point at every Hit Location.

entries.name: Aethyric Arms
entries.text:
CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Conjure a Magical melee weapon chosen from page 301.

entries.name: Arrow Shield
entries.text:
CN: 3 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Destroy missiles containing organic material whenever they enter the area, preventing their damage. Wholly inorganic missiles, including throwing knives and pistol shots, pass through normally.

entries.name: Blast
entries.text:
CN: 4 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Deal a Damage +3 magic missile to everyone in the area.

entries.name: Bolt
entries.text:
CN: 4 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Fire a magic missile with Damage +4.

entries.name: Breath
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: Special Target: Special Duration: Instant

Choose a target within 20 + Willpower Bonus yards and make Challenging (+0 SL) Ballistic Skill. That target and every creature within Initiative Bonus yards of them may oppose with Dodge; anyone who does not beat your result is hit for Willpower Bonus Damage. The casting Lore determines additional effects:
- Acid (Metal): +4 Damage; each weapon and armour item carried by a victim suffers 1 Damage.
- Cold (Beasts, Light, Necromancy): +2 Damage and 1 Fatigued Condition. Until that Condition is removed, the victim’s weapons have Slow.
- Electricity (Heavens): +2 Damage, ignores metal armour, and gives 1 Stunned Condition.
- Fire (Fire, Daemonology, Waaagh!, and Tzeentch Chaos Lores): +5 Damage and 1 Ablaze Condition.

entries.name: Bridge
entries.text:
CN: 4 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Create a magical bridge up to Willpower Bonus yards long and wide. Each +2 SL can add Willpower Bonus yards to either length or width.

entries.name: Chain Attack
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant

Strike with a Damage +4 magic missile. If it causes more Wounds than the victim’s Toughness Bonus, it jumps to the nearest other target within Willpower Bonus yards of that victim. Reduce Damage by 1 with each jump. Allow up to Willpower Bonus jumps, plus one additional target per +2 SL.

entries.name: Corrosive Blood
entries.text:
CN: 2 Range: You Target: You Duration: Toughness Bonus Rounds or hours

Gain Corrosive Blood (page 357) for Toughness Bonus Rounds. Alternatively, for Toughness Bonus hours, biting small parasites such as fleas and leeches die immediately without transmitting disease. Blood Rot and similar diseases are purged from your body.

entries.name: Dark Vision
entries.text:
CN: 1 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative Bonus Rounds

Gain Dark Vision (page 357) while the Spell lasts.

entries.name: Distracting
entries.text:
CN: 4 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain Distracting (page 358) for the duration.

entries.name: Dome
entries.text:
CN: 7 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Everyone in the area gains Ward 6+ (page 363) against Magical or ranged attacks coming from outside the dome. Attacks from inside can pass out normally, and movement is unrestricted.

entries.name: Drop
entries.text:
CN: 1 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Force a creature to release a held object, including a weapon, rope or another person’s hand, unless it passes Challenging (+0 SL) Dexterity. Each +2 SL may impose -1 SL on that Test.

entries.name: Entangle
entries.text:
CN: 3 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Give the target 1 Entangled Condition whose Strength equals your Willpower; its appearance suits your Lore.

entries.name: Fearsome
entries.text:
CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain Fear 1; each +3 SL may raise its value by 1.

entries.name: Flight
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain Fly (Athletics), allowing flight (page 358).

entries.name: Magic Shield
entries.text:
CN: 4 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Add +Willpower Bonus SL to your dispel attempts for the duration.

entries.name: Move Object
entries.text:
CN: 4 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: 1 Round

Move one non-sentient object no larger than 1 + SL yards in any dimension. The moving force has Strength equal to your Willpower and moves it up to Willpower Bonus yards, plus another Willpower Bonus yards per +2 SL. Resolve resistance to its movement with Opposed Willpower/Strength.

entries.name: Mundane Aura
entries.text:
CN: 4 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower minutes

Suppress magical auras on yourself and your possessions. Magical Sense and similar abilities see you as mundane, and no method can detect your magical nature. You have no effective magical ability and cannot cast other Spells. A Channelling Test ends this Spell immediately.

entries.name: Push
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards, maximum) Duration: Instant

Push every target in the area away by Willpower Bonus yards, inflicting 1d10 Damage that ignores Armour Points and making them Prone. A collision makes another creature of the same or smaller Size Prone without damaging it. Each +2 SL may extend the push by Willpower Bonus yards.

entries.name: Silence
entries.text:
CN: 4 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus minutes

No sound is audible inside the zone or can pass into or out of it. Casting Tests within it become one Difficulty step harder.

entries.name: Teleport
entries.text:
CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Instant

Teleport up to Willpower Bonus + SL yards, crossing gaps, bypassing hazards and ignoring obstacles.

entries.name: Terrifying
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain Terror 1 (page 362); each +3 SL may increase its value by 1.

entries.name: Ward
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain Ward 7+ (page 363) for the duration.

entries.name: Amber Talons
entries.text:
CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Your unarmed attacks lose Undamaging, gain Magical, deal SB + 4 Damage and cause 1 Bleeding Condition whenever they inflict Wounds. Also gain Scale Sheer Surface (page 125).

entries.name: Beast Form
entries.text:
CN: 5 Range: You Target: You Duration: Toughness minutes

Take the form of any animal in Beasts of the Reikland (pages 325–327), appearing as an ordinary amber-and-brown specimen. Gain its standard Traits except Bestial and Skittish, and replace Movement, Strength, Toughness, Agility and Dexterity with its values; recalculate Wounds. Each +2 SL allows 1 Optional Creature Trait, excluding Size (Enormous). You cannot speak, cast or dispel in this form. On reverting, retain Critical Wounds and lost Wounds, but this carryover cannot lower you below 0 Wounds.

entries.name: Beast Master
entries.text:
CN: 10 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus days

A creature with Bestial and Size (Small, Average or Large) accepts you as pack master, understands and obeys simple commands, and fights to the death to defend you. After the Spell ends, it will not attack you unless compelled, but this protection does not extend to allies.

entries.name: Beast Tongue
entries.text:
CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower minutes

Speak with creatures that have Bestial; they usually listen but need not answer or obey. Gain +2 SL to Animal Training and Charm Animal Tests. You can speak only to beasts, communicate with companions only by gestures, and cannot cast or dispel.

entries.name: Flock of Doom
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Summon local birds to attack everyone in the area who lacks Arcane Magic (Beasts). Each suffers a Damage 7 hit to the head at each Round’s end and 1 Blinded Condition while inside. Spend an Action and pass Average (+2 SL) Charm Animal to move the flock to another area in range.

entries.name: Hunter’s Hide
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain +20 Toughness, Acute Sense (Smell) (page 114), Dark Vision and Fear 1 (page 358).

entries.name: The Amber Spear
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: Strength yards Target: 1 (maximum) Duration: Instant

Fire a Damage +12 magic missile, ignoring AP from leather, fur, scales and similar armour. Choose its Hit Location; it also causes +1 Bleeding Condition.

entries.name: Wyssan’s Wildform
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain +1 Movement, +30 Strength and Toughness, and Belligerent, Bite (Strength Bonus + 1), Fear 1, Frenzy, Magical and Striding Gait (Woodland) (pages 356–361). You cannot use Language or Lore Skills for the duration.

entries.name: Caress of Laniph
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: 1 (maximum) Duration: Instant

Touch with your hand, not an enchanted staff, to deliver a Damage +6 magic missile that ignores TB and AP. Every 2 Wounds inflicted permanently lowers the victim’s maximum Wounds by 1 and lets you add 1 SL to your channelling pool.

entries.name: Dying Words
entries.text:
CN: 2 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Touch a body whose owner died within the last day to speak with their soul for the duration. The soul can only talk, need not answer, and cannot lie.

entries.name: Purple Pall of Shyish
entries.text:
CN: 9 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain +WPB Armour Points at every Location and Fear 1 (page 358). Each +2 SL may raise Fear by 1.

entries.name: Sanctify
entries.text:
CN: 10 Range: Touch Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower minutes

Inscribe a circle that creatures with Undead cannot cross in either direction.

entries.name: Scythe of Shyish
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Create a Magical Halberd in scythe form with Damage SB + WPB + 4. Undead foes gain no Advantage while Engaged with you.

entries.name: Soul Vortex
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Give everyone in the area +1 Broken Condition. Those with Undead also suffer a Damage +10 magic missile hit that ignores Toughness Bonus and Armour Points.

entries.name: Steal Life
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Deal a Damage +6 magic missile that ignores Armour Points. Remove all your Fatigued Conditions and heal yourself 1 Wound per 2 Wounds inflicted.

entries.name: Swift Passing
entries.text:
CN: 2 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Instant

Touch one creature with 0 Wounds to kill it. It cannot subsequently be raised as Undead.

entries.name: Aqshy’s Aegis
entries.text:
CN: 5 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Take no damage from non-magical fire and ignore any Ablaze Conditions received. Gain Ward 7+ (page 363) against magical fire attacks, including warpfire and Lore of Fire Spells.

entries.name: Cauterise
entries.text:
CN: 2 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Touch an ally to heal 1 Wound, or 1 + SL Wounds if they have Arcane Magic (Fire), and remove all their Bleeding Conditions. The wounds cannot become infected. A target without Arcane Magic (Fire) must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or scream; an Astounding Failure also gives 1 Stunned Condition and permanent scars.

entries.name: Crown of Flame
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain +1 War Leader (page 128) and the Fear Trait (page 358). Each +2 SL may add 1 to Fear or another purchase of War Leader. Gain +1 SL to every Channelling and Casting Test using Aqshy.

entries.name: Firewall
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Special) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Create a wall of fire Willpower Bonus yards long, 1 yard high and 1 yard deep. Crossing it causes 1 Ablaze Condition and a Damage +WPB magic missile hit. Overcasting for extra Area of Effect multiplies its length.

entries.name: Flaming Hearts
entries.text:
CN: 5 Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Allied characters in the area remove every Broken and Fatigued Condition and may make a Frenzy Test (page 184).

entries.name: Flaming Sword of Rhuin
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 sword (Hand Weapon) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Give a sword Damage SB + 6, Damaging and Magical (page 304). Every hit causes 1 Ablaze Condition. A wielder without Arcane Magic (Fire) gains 1 Ablaze Condition if they Fumble an attack with it.

entries.name: Great Fires of U’Zhul
entries.text:
CN: 10 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 (maximum) + AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

The central target suffers a Damage +10 magic missile hit that ignores AP, 2 Ablaze Conditions and Prone. Everyone else in the area suffers a Damage +5 magic missile hit ignoring AP. Fire then persists for the duration, no longer acting as a magic missile: anyone in the area at a Round’s end suffers WPB + 5 Damage ignoring AP and gains 1 Ablaze Condition.

entries.name: Purge
entries.text:
CN: 10 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Ignite all flammable material in the area and give creatures +SL Ablaze Conditions. Corrupting Influences, including Dhar, warpstone and Chaos-tainted objects, begin burning away. In subsequent Rounds, maintain the Spell with your Action and a Challenging (+0 SL) Channelling (Aqshy) Test. Every 30 minutes, pass Difficult (-1 SL) Endurance or gain 1 Fatigued Condition; failure (-1 SL or worse) also ends the Spell. The GM sets the time to remove corruption: as guidance, warpstone smaller than an acorn or a minor tainted object takes 10 - Willpower Bonus Rounds (minimum 1 Round); a fist-sized piece or more potent tainted object takes twice as long; a powerful Chaos artefact may take hours or longer. See Corrupting Influences, page 187.

entries.name: Cerulean Shield
entries.text:
CN: 7 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain +3 Armour Points at all Locations against metal weapons, including metal-tipped arrows. Anyone striking you with a metal melee weapon takes 6 Damage to the arm used.

entries.name: Comet of Casandora
entries.text:
CN: 16 Range: Initiative yards Target: AoE (2 x Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Special

Choose the impact area. At the end of the following Round, make Very Hard (-3 SL) Ballistic Skill or Average (+2 SL) Lore (Astronomy). Each +SL lets you shift the impact by Willpower Bonus yards; for each -SL, the GM shifts it 1d10 yards in a random direction. Then every target in the area suffers a Damage +18 magic missile hit, 1 Ablaze Condition and Prone.

entries.name: Coruscating Arc
entries.text:
CN: 12 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant

Use Chain Attack (page 243), with Damage +10 and 1 Blinded Condition in addition to its usual effects.

entries.name: Fate’s Fickle Fingers
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: AoE (Initiative Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

All allies in the area except those with Arcane Magic (Heavens) combine their Fortune Points into one shared pool. Any participant may spend them in the order claimed. When the Spell ends, divide the remaining points as fairly as possible.

entries.name: Starcrossed
entries.text:
CN: 7 Range: Initiative yards Target: 1 Duration: Initiative Bonus Rounds

Spend your Fortune Points to make the target reroll Tests.

entries.name: The First Portent of Amul
entries.text:
CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative Bonus Rounds

Gain +1 Fortune Point for the duration, plus another +1 per +2 SL.

entries.name: The Second Portent of Amul
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative Bonus Rounds

Gain 1 + SL Fortune Points for the duration; each +2 SL may grant an additional +1 Fortune Point.

entries.name: The Third Portent of Amul
entries.text:
CN: 12 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative Rounds

Gain +1 Fate Point for the duration.

Mystics may gain Arcane Magic (Heavens), but can learn only Fate’s Fickle Fingers, Starcrossed and the First, Second and Third Portents of Amul through that career. Access to other Heavens Spells requires entering an appropriate spellcasting career.

entries.name: Barkskin
entries.text:
CN: 3 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

The target gains +2 Toughness Bonus and suffers -10 Agility and Dexterity.

entries.name: Earthblood
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Casting requires direct contact with earth, either by touch or bare feet. At the start of every Round, living creatures in the area that directly touch the earth heal WPB Wounds.

entries.name: Earthpool
entries.text:
CN: 7 Range: Willpower yards Target: You Duration: Instant

On casting, sink into the ground and emerge at any point in range at the start of the next Round. A creature directly above your emergence is pushed 1 yard in a random direction and falls Prone. You may pass through water but cannot travel through solid rock.

entries.name: Fare of the Land
entries.text:
