entries.name: Banishment
entries.text:
CN: 12 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Creatures in the area whose Toughness is below your Willpower are affected. Those with Undead or Daemonic gain Unstable (WFRP p. 343), or fall to 0 Wounds if already Unstable.

entries.name: Blinding Light
entries.text:
CN: 5 Range: Willpower yards Target: You Duration: Instant

Everyone looking at you gains Blinded Conditions equal to SL unless they possess Arcane Magic (Light).

entries.name: Clarity of Thought
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Intelligence minutes

The target ignores penalties to mental processes for the duration, including Stunned, Mental Mutations and Psychologies.

entries.name: Daemonbane
entries.text:
CN: 10 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Oppose your Casting Test with the target’s Willpower. Winning banishes a Daemonic creature to its origin. On banishment, observers of the target gain Blinded Conditions equal to SL unless they possess Arcane Magic (Light).

entries.name: Healing Light
entries.text:
CN: 9 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

The target glows as brightly as a campfire and heals Intelligence Bonus + Willpower Bonus Wounds. Passing Very Hard (−30) Endurance also removes 1 Corruption point gained within the past hour.

entries.name: Net of Amyntok
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: Intelligence Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Target’s Intelligence Bonus rounds

Targets gain one Stunned Condition that cannot be removed during the spell. Afterwards, recovery Tests use Intelligence instead of Endurance. Bestial creatures are immune.

entries.name: Phâ’s Protection
entries.text:
CN: 10 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Creatures with Undead, Daemonic, mutations, or Corruption exceeding their combined Willpower and Toughness Bonuses cannot enter. Those already inside gain Broken until leaving. No creature inside can gain Corruption while the spell lasts.

entries.name: Speed of Thought
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Gain +20 Intelligence and Initiative.

entries.name: Crucible of Chamon
entries.text:
CN: 7 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 object Duration: Instant

Melt and destroy one non-magical metal object, including a weapon or armour covering one body part. Held objects are dropped. A worn object causes its wearer a magic-missile-like hit with Damage equal to Willpower Bonus, ignoring Toughness Bonus. The cooled metal retains its raw-material value for smithing.

entries.name: Enchant Weapon
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

One non-magical weapon becomes magical, gains Damage equal to Willpower Bonus, and gains Unbreakable (WFRP p. 298). Each +3 SL also adds one Weapon Quality or removes one Weapon Flaw for the duration.

entries.name: Feather of Lead
entries.text:
CN: 5 Range: Willpower yards Target: Area of Effect (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Choose one effect for everyone in the area: count as two steps more Overburdened, or ignore Overburdened entirely (Encumbrance, WFRP p. 293).

entries.name: Fool’s Gold
entries.text:
CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower minutes

All metal in a touched non-magical object becomes real gold for the duration, then reverts. Changed weight and material can spoil weapons or make armour unwearable.

entries.name: Forge of Chamon
entries.text:
CN: 9 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower minutes

A metal item gains one Item Quality or loses one Item Flaw. Each +2 SL permits one further Quality added or Flaw removed.

entries.name: Glittering Robe
entries.text:
CN: 5 Range: You Target: You Duration: Toughness Bonus Rounds

Gain Ward (9+) against every attack and spell targeting you (WFRP p. 343). Each hit saved improves it by 1, to a maximum of Ward (3+).

entries.name: Mutable Metal
entries.text:
CN: 5 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

A touched non-magical metal object becomes pliable. Reshape it with Average (+20) Strength, or, with GM agreement for complex work, an appropriate Average (+20) Trade or Art Test.

entries.name: Transmutation of Chamon
entries.text:
CN: 12 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

A magic missile hits everyone in the area with Damage equal to Willpower Bonus, ignoring Toughness Bonus. They gain one each of Blinded, Deafened and Stunned for the duration, +1 AP, and suffer Suffocation (WFRP p. 181). Anyone dying during the spell remains permanently encased in base metal.

entries.name: Barkskin
entries.text:
CN: 3 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

The target gains +2 Toughness Bonus but takes −10 Agility and Dexterity.

entries.name: Earthblood
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Casting requires direct contact with earth, by touch or bare feet. Each living creature in the area directly touching earth heals Willpower Bonus Wounds at the start of every Round.

entries.name: Earthpool
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Instant

Disappear into the ground and emerge at the next Round’s start anywhere within Willpower yards, plus Willpower yards per +2 Casting SL. Enemies you engage upon emergence gain Surprised. Travel through water is allowed; solid rock blocks it.

entries.name: Fat of the Land
entries.text:
CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus days

The target needs no food or drink but still excretes normally, with green waste.

entries.name: Forest of Thorns
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Target earth to grow dense thorny plants. Anyone without Arcane Magic (Life) trying to cross on foot must pass Hard (−20) Agility or gain one Bleeding and one Entangled Condition at Strength equal to your Willpower. When the spell ends, the plants remain without magical effects.

entries.name: Lie of the Land
entries.text:
CN: 5 Range: Initiative Bonus miles Target: You Duration: Special

Touch earth and commune for 1 minute to obtain a mental map of natural terrain in range, including land, woods and rivers. Settlements appear only indirectly as clearings or trenches. Each SL spent increasing Range also adds 1 minute of communion.

entries.name: Lifebloom
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: Special Duration: Special

Restore a blighted or desolate target: a dry river flows again; a dry or polluted well becomes clean and full; planted fields, vineyards or orchards ripen immediately; a sick or unproductive domestic animal loses all diseases and regains vitality.

entries.name: Regenerate
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

The target gains Regenerate (WFRP p. 341).

entries.name: Cerulean Shield
entries.text:
CN: 7 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Gain AP equal to SL at every location against melee attacks. An attacker using a metal weapon takes Damage equal to your Willpower Bonus, reduced by Toughness Bonus but ignoring Armour.

entries.name: Comet of Casandora
entries.text:
CN: 10 Range: Initiative yards Target: AoE (Initiative Bonus yards) Duration: Special

Choose an impact point in range. At the end of the next Round, Test Average (+20) Perception. Each positive SL lets you move the point Initiative Bonus yards; for each negative SL the GM moves it that far in a random direction. A Damage +12 magic missile then hits everyone in the area and gives them one Ablaze and Prone.

entries.name: Fate’s Fickle Fingers
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: AoE (Initiative Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

All allies in the area except those with Arcane Magic (Heavens) pool their Fortune points. Any participant may spend from the pool in order of request. When the spell ends, distribute remaining points as fairly as possible.

entries.name: Starcrossed
entries.text:
CN: 7 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Initiative Bonus rounds

For the duration, you can spend Fortune points to force an opponent to reroll Tests.

entries.name: The First Portent of Amul
entries.text:
CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative Bonus rounds

Gain 1 Fortune point, plus 1 per +2 SL. Unspent points disappear when the spell ends.

entries.name: The Second Portent of Amul
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative Bonus rounds

Gain Fortune points equal to SL, plus 1 per +2 SL. Unspent points disappear when the spell ends.

entries.name: The Third Portent of Amul
entries.text:
CN: 12 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative Bonus rounds

Gain 1 Fate point, lost if unused when the spell ends.

entries.name: Bewilder
entries.text:
CN: 5 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

A target failing Challenging (+0) Willpower rolls 1d10 once for its behaviour throughout the duration.

| Roll | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| 1–2 | Befuddled: The target must pass a Challenging (+0) Willpower Test to take actions. |
| 3–4 | Wander: The target can act normally but moves in a random direction. |
| 5–6 | Attack: The target charges the nearest target and attacks. |
| 7–8 | Do Nothing: The target can only stand still and Dodge. |
| 9–10 | Curl Into a Ball: The target receives the Prone Condition and is Helpless (WFRP, page 162). |

entries.name: Choking Shadows
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

A target needing to breathe gains 1 Fatigued Condition, cannot speak, and suffers Suffocation (WFRP p. 181).

entries.name: Doppelganger
entries.text:
CN: 10 Range: You Target: You Duration: Intelligence Bonus minutes

Take the appearance of a humanoid you know sufficiently well, as judged by the GM. Those without Second Sight are visually fooled, though wrong mannerisms may raise suspicion. Second Sight users need Difficult (−10) Intuition to detect the disguise.

entries.name: Illusion
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Initiative Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower minutes

Create a chosen illusion in the area. Anyone without Second Sight is fooled; Second Sight users need Difficult (−10) Intuition to recognise it, without seeing through or ending it. It stays still unless you use your Action and pass Hard (−20) Channelling to animate it within the area for one round.

entries.name: Mindslip
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: 1 yard Target: 1 Duration: Willpower minutes

The target forgets all previous memories of you for the duration. At expiry, Average (+20) Intelligence is required to recover them; failure makes the loss permanent until dispelled.

entries.name: Mystifying Miasma
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Anyone in the mist without Arcane Magic (Shadows) gains one each of Blinded, Deafened and Fatigued for the duration. Moving requires Challenging (+0) Perception to avoid Prone. If dispelled, affected creatures must pass Easy (+40) Initiative or gain Stunned.

entries.name: Shadowsteed
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Until the next sunrise

Summon a Riding Horse (WFRP p. 316) without Skittish. Outside sunlight it gains Dark Vision, Ethereal, Fear (1), Magical, Painless, Stealthy, Stride and Ward (9), and remains rideable while insubstantial. Ride Tests gain +20 for riders with Arcane Magic (Shadows), or −20 without it. It never needs rest and dissolves at sunrise; a mounted rider then falls and takes falling damage (p. 166).

entries.name: Shadowstep
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: You Duration: Instant

Teleport up to Willpower yards. Enemies engaged with you at either departure or arrival gain Surprised.

entries.name: Shroud of Invisibility
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Make the target invisible, automatically fooling those without Second Sight. A Second Sight user passing Challenging (+0) Perception senses someone nearby without locating them precisely. Other senses can still detect the target. Loud noise or attacking ends the spell.

entries.name: Caress of Laniph
entries.text:
CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Instant

A Damage +6 magic missile ignores Toughness Bonus and AP. Heal 1 Wound per 2 Wounds inflicted, up to your maximum.

entries.name: Crystal Maze
entries.text:
CN: 13 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Targets vanish into the crystal maze and cannot be harmed or affected. At the end of each of their subsequent rounds, each rolls 1d10 on the following table.

| Roll | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| 1–3 | Escape: The target returns to the material realm where it disappeared. |
| 4–6 | Confused: The target rolls again next round. |
| 7–9 | Lost: The target is lost for 1d10 hours and rolls to resist a Moderate Exposure to Corruption (WFRP, page 182) when they return. |
| 10 | Doomed: The target is lost forever in the Realm of Tzeentch. |

entries.name: Dying Words
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Touch someone dead no more than a day to call their soul back for the duration. It can only speak, need not answer, and cannot lie.

entries.name: Purple Pall of Shyish
entries.text:
CN: 9 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Gain AP equal to Willpower Bonus at every location and Fear (1) (WFRP p. 339). Each +2 SL may increase Fear by 1.

entries.name: Sanctify
entries.text:
CN: 10 Range: Touch Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower minutes

Inscribe a circle that Undead cannot enter or leave.

entries.name: Scythe of Shyish
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Create a magical scythe using Melee (Polearm), with Halberd rules and Damage Willpower Bonus + 3. Engaged Undead receive no Advantage against you.

Shyish Uncovered — CN: 4 Range: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Target: You Duration: Initiative Bonus minutes. Learn how many creatures of each species died in the area and when, within the previous month plus one month per +1 SL. Names and causes of death are not revealed. If you know a deceased person’s name, each additional +2 SL permits one question answered through knocks, such as yes/no or numbers.

entries.name: Soul Vortex
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Everyone in the area gains +1 Broken Condition. Undead also take a Damage +10 magic missile ignoring Toughness Bonus and AP.

entries.name: Steal Life
entries.text:
CN: 7 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

A Damage +6 magic missile ignores AP and causes 1 Fatigued Condition. Remove all your own Fatigued Conditions and heal up to half the Wounds it inflicted, rounded up.

entries.name: Swift Passing
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Instant

Touch a target at 0 Wounds with at least 2 Critical Wounds to kill them. They cannot be raised as Undead.

entries.name: Aqshy’s Aegis
entries.text:
CN: 5 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Ignore Damage from non-magical fire and any Ablaze Conditions you receive. Gain Ward (9) against magical fire, including warpfire, Breath (Fire) and Lore of Fire spells (WFRP p. 343).

entries.name: Cauterise
entries.text:
CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

The target heals 1d10 Wounds, removes all Bleeding Conditions, and avoids infection in those wounds. Without Arcane Magic (Fire), they must pass Challenging (+0) Cool or scream. Failure by at least 6 SL also causes Unconscious and permanent scarring; they wake after 1d10 hours.

entries.name: Crown of Flame
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Gain Fear (1) (WFRP p. 190), War Leader (p. 147) and +10 on Aqshy Channelling and Casting. Each +2 Casting SL increases Fear by 1 or grants another War Leader level.

entries.name: Firewall
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Special) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Create a wall Willpower Bonus yards long, 1 yard high and 1 yard deep. Each +2 Casting SL adds Willpower Bonus yards of length. Crossing causes 1 Ablaze and a magic missile with Damage equal to Willpower Bonus.

entries.name: Flaming Hearts
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Allies remove all Broken and Fatigued Conditions and gain Drilled, Fearless and Stout-hearted. Each already possessed Talent gains one temporary level instead.

entries.name: Flaming Sword of Rhuin
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

A sword (Hand Weapon) gains Damage SB+6 and Impact (WFRP p. 298). Each struck creature gains 1 Ablaze. A wielder without Arcane Magic (Fire) also gains 1 Ablaze when Fumbling an attack with it.

entries.name: Great Fires of U’Zhul
entries.text:
CN: 10 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

A Damage +10 magic missile ignores AP and causes 2 Ablaze and Prone. Everyone in the target area also takes a Damage +5 hit ignoring AP and must pass Challenging (+0) Dodge or gain 1 Ablaze. The remaining fire no longer counts as a magic missile: at each Round’s end, anyone in the area takes 1d10 + 6 Damage ignoring AP and gains 1 Ablaze for the duration.

entries.name: Purge
entries.text:
CN: 10 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Ignite flammable material in the area and give creatures Ablaze Conditions equal to SL. Corrupting Influences such as Dhar, Warpstone and Chaos-tainted items begin burning away. Maintain the spell each subsequent round with Challenging (+0) Channelling. The GM sets removal time: a sub-acorn Warpstone quantity or minor tainted item suggests 10 − Willpower Bonus rounds (minimum 1); a fist-sized quantity or stronger item takes twice as long; major artefacts may require hours or longer (WFRP p. 182).

entries.name: Amber Talons
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Unarmed attacks become magical, deal Damage equal to SL + Strength Bonus + Willpower Bonus, and inflict 1 Bleeding whenever they cause Wound loss.

entries.name: Beast Form
entries.text:
CN: 5 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower minutes

Become a creature from Beasts of the Reikland (WFRP p. 314), gaining all standard Traits except Bestial and replacing Movement, Strength, Toughness, Agility and Dexterity; recalculate Wounds. Each +2 SL permits one Optional Trait. You resemble a normal amber/brown specimen, cannot speak, cast or dispel. On reverting, subtract the same number of Wounds lost in Beast Form from your normal Wounds, to a minimum of 0.

entries.name: Beast Master
entries.text:
CN: 10 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus days

One Bestial creature of Small, Average or Large Size accepts you as pack master, obeys simple instructions and fights to the death to protect you. After expiry it will not attack you unless compelled, though allies have no such protection.

entries.name: Beast Tongue
entries.text:
CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower minutes

Communicate with Bestial creatures and gain +20 Charm Animal and Animal Training. They need not answer or obey but usually listen. You cannot speak ordinary languages, cast or dispel during the spell; gestures and Language (Battle) can communicate with your party.

entries.name: Beast Unbroken
entries.text:
CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

A domestic animal becomes permanently wild until dispelled. The GM chooses flight or hostility to its owner. Charm Animal can deter attacks but cannot tame it. Riders must pass Hard (−20) Ride to avoid being thrown. At +4 Casting SL, you may instead target a Human, who resists with Difficult (−10) Willpower. Failure causes thick body hair, loss of speech and the following 1d10 behaviour roll each round. Both versions persist until dispelled.

| Roll |  |
| --- | --- |
| 1–3 | Distracted: The target scratches its fur, defecates, or picks its nose |
| 4–6 | Panicked: The target moves in a random direction, running into obstacles or attacking creatures in its path |
| 7–9 | Friendly: The target laughs maniacally and crawls or dances toward the nearest character |
| 10 | Enraged: The target releases a primal scream, causing Fear (1) in anyone without the Arcane Lore (Beasts) Talent who can hear it |

entries.name: Flock of Doom
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

A bird flock deals a Damage +7 hit at each Round’s end to everyone in the area without Arcane Magic (Beasts). Every creature in the area suffers 1 Blinded. As your Action, pass Average (+20) Charm Animal to move the flock to another target in range.

entries.name: Hunter’s Hide
entries.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Gain +20 Toughness, Dark Vision and Fear (1) (WFRP p. 339), and Acute Sense (Smell) (p. 132).

entries.name: The Amber Spear
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant

A Damage +12 magic missile follows a straight line, ignoring leather and fur AP. Whenever it wounds a creature, also give that creature 1 Bleeding and continue to the next target, reducing Damage by 1 per creature passed through. Failure to inflict Wounds stops it. Only the first target receives the minimum 1 Wound rule (WFRP p. 159).

entries.name: Wyssan’s Wildform
entries.text:
CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Gain Arboreal, Armour (2), Belligerent, Big, Bite (Strength Bonus +1), Fear (1), Fury, Magical and Weapon (Strength Bonus +2) (WFRP p. 338). You cannot use Language or Lore Skills for the duration.

entries.name: Wizard’s Robes
entries.text:
Wizard robes grant a bonus to Channelling Tests and are awarded at the listed Career ranks. The prices and Availability below are rough guides to illicit second-hand sales; robes may also be made with the Crafting Endeavour.

| Grade | Channelling bonus | Awarded to | Cost | Enc | Availability |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Practical Robes | +1 SL | Wizard | 1 GC | 1 | Rare |
| Standard Robes | +2 SL | Master Wizard | 8 GC | 2 | Exotic |
| Elaborate Robes | +3 SL | Wizard Lord | 30 GC | 4 | Exotic |

Chaos sorcerers, necromancers and daemonologists use their own designs and need a willing tailor. Witches and hedge witches receive no benefit from robes. A wizard, witch or hedge witch wearing robes for a Lore they do not practise suffers –1 SL to all Casting and Channelling Tests.

Practical outfits are plain and may conceal the wearer’s profession. Standard outfits are more complex, commonly including a heavy coat or cloak and distinctive headwear. Elaborate outfits are bulky, heavy and impractical, and immediately identify the wearer as a wizard; any grade can comprise coordinated clothing and accessories rather than a literal robe.

Fungus: Begins after 1d10 days and lasts 1d10 days. Major imposes –2 SL to Agility- and Dexterity-based Tests; Extreme imposes –4 SL.

Goitre: Neck swelling develops over a couple of hours and may be mistaken for mutation. Minor is painful for 1 week; Moderate applies –1 SL to all Tests for 1 week.

Gripes: Apply –1 SL to Willpower-based Tests. Duration: Minor 1 hour; Moderate 1d10 hours; Major 1 day; Extreme 1d10 days.

Gut Burn (X): After 1d10 rounds, take a Damage X hit ignoring Armour.

Hair Loss: Starts after 1 day. Minor loses hair in clumps with normal regrowth; Moderate leaves noticeable bald patches after regrowth.

Hallucination: Starts after 1 hour. Minor lasts 1 hour with no penalty. For Moderate, test Easy (+40) Intelligence at the start of every round for 1 hour; Major uses Average (+20) for 1d10 hours; Extreme uses Challenging (+0) for 1 day. Each failed Test gives Stunned.

Itchy Bits: Starts after 1d10 rounds. Apply –1 SL to Agility-based Tests for 1 hour with Minor, or 1d10 hours with Moderate.

Intoxicating: On drinking, make a Challenging (+0) Consume Alcohol Test; failure requires a Stinking Drunk roll (WFRP p. 121). After 1d10 days, the effect may recur and requires an Average (+20) Consume Alcohol Test. Thereafter test Easy (+40) every 1d10 days until 5 consecutive Consume Alcohol Tests succeed and the potion leaves your system.

Mindslip: Roll on Mental Corruption (WFRP p. 185). The effect lasts 1 day for Moderate or 1 week for Major.

Oozing Orbs: Eyes sting and weep for 1d10 hours. Minor applies –1 SL to Perception and Ballistic Skill Tests; Moderate applies –2 SL.

Permeating Stench: Gain Distracting (WFRP p. 339), affecting allies and enemies. Duration: Minor 1 hour; Moderate 1d10 hours; Major 1 day; Extreme 1d10 days.

Poison: Moderate requires a Hard (–20) Endurance Test or gives 1 Poisoned. Major requires Very Hard (–30) or gives 2 Poisoned. Extreme requires Futile (–40) or gives 3 Poisoned.

Potent Brew: On drinking, make a Hard (–20) Consume Alcohol Test; failure requires a Stinking Drunk roll (WFRP p. 121).

Ravenous: Each round for 1d10 rounds, pass an Average (+20) Cool Test or attempt to eat the nearest organic object, including creatures or refuse. Moderate uses Challenging (+0) instead.

Retching: Begins after 1d10 hours. Failing a Test involving physical movement gives Stunned from vomiting. Duration: Moderate 1 day; Major 1d10 days.

Scabies: Moderate applies –1 SL to Weapon Skill, Ballistic Skill and Agility- and Dexterity-based Tests for 2d10 hours. Major applies that penalty for 1d10 days. Extreme applies –2 SL for 2d10 days.

Sensory Loss: Roll on Sensory Loss. Moderate removes one sense for 1d10 minutes; Major removes two for 1d10 hours; Extreme removes three for 1d10 days.

Shrieks: Involuntary screaming lasts 1 round with Moderate, 1d10 minutes with Major, or 1d10 hours with Extreme. After Extreme, speech remains a hoarse whisper for 1d10 days.

Spots: Begins after 1d10 minutes, applying –2 SL to vision-based Perception Tests. Minor lasts 1d10 minutes; Moderate lasts 1 hour.

Suppurating Sores: Moderate inflicts a Damage 4 hit; Major a Damage 6 hit; Extreme a Damage 8 hit plus permanent loss of 1 Wound. These hits ignore Armour.

Tingles: Gain +1 SL to Toughness-based Tests and –1 SL to Agility- and Dexterity-based Tests. Duration: Minor 1 hour; Moderate 2d10 hours; Major 1d10 days; Extreme 1d10 weeks.

Vapours: Before any Skill Test, pass an Average (+20) Cool Test; Cool Tests and Tests to defend against clear danger are exempt. Minor lasts 1 hour; Moderate 1 day.

Violent Wind: At the start of each round, make a Difficult (–10) Endurance Test. Failure gives Distracting (WFRP p. 339), affecting allies and enemies, and forces a choice of either Move or Action in the following round. Duration: Minor 1 minute; Moderate 1 hour; Major 1 day; Extreme 1d10 days.

Voice Change: Voice pitch rises or falls without further effect. Minor lasts 1d10 minutes; Moderate 1d10 hours.

Warts: Apply –1 SL to Dexterity-based Tests. Minor lasts 1 day; Moderate 1 week.

Wens: Roll a Hit Location for cysts that last 1d10 days. A combat hit there requires a Hard (–20) Endurance Test; failure causes Festering Wound (WFRP p. 187).

An Alchemical Laboratory, including space and equipment, costs 100 GC. Poor Quality costs 50 GC and applies –1 SL to Brewing Tests; Fine Quality costs 200 GC and grants +1 SL.

The brewer also needs the chosen potion’s recipe. Negotiate its price with the owner; no fixed price or guarantee of effectiveness is supplied, beyond the seller’s reputation.

entries.name: Concoct
entries.text: Max: Intelligence Bonus. Tests: Trade (Apothecary) and Trade (Alchemist). Take one free Crafting or Brew Potion Endeavour using either Skill without a workshop or laboratory. Other Crafting Endeavours gain no benefit.

entries.name: Panacea Universalis
entries.text:
Onset: 1d10 rounds. Volatility: Moderate. Ingredient Cost: 6 GC; Locale: Temperate Forest; Ingredient Difficulty: −10. Creation Difficulty: −2 SL; Time: 1 month. Once active, immediately recover 3 × Toughness Bonus Wounds and remove all Bleeding and Fatigued Conditions. Each listed Critical Injury may also heal on its required Test; multiple injuries can heal, but amputations cannot.

entries.name: The Cursed Quality
entries.text: Cursed also makes the item Magical, allowing its weapons to harm targets vulnerable only to Magical attacks. Close examination with the Sight reveals Dhar gathering in it. Each item has a normal benefit (Boon), a curse (Bane), and circumstances that activate it (Trigger).

entries.name: Knuckles of Ignominy
entries.text:
Knuckledusters with Impale. Causing a Critical Hit automatically infects the bearer without a resistance Test. Roll once on this table each time they Impale during a combat. Onset occurs within 1 or 2 days, usually publicly; the disease ends within 24 hours after at least one socially embarrassing interaction.

entries.name: Grim (Rating)
entries.text: At its Turn's start, raise Advantage to Grim Rating if currently lower. With Up in Arms Group Advantage, generate Rating Advantage for the Adversary pool instead.

entries.text:

| One of the College Lores | Varied, see page 182 | Combat, Power, or Spell |

| Lore of Hedgecraft | Animal Companion | Power |
| Lore of Necromancy | Small Undead Construct | Combat or Power |

Witches and hedge witches enchant an animal or bird, rarely larger than a large cat, increasing its intelligence and understanding and making it magical. Some Imperial wizards, especially Jade and Amber, use the same method. Chaos Sorcerers and Daemonologists generally summon and bind minor Daemons.

entries.name: Magical Assistant
entries.text: Max: 1. Power Familiar only; unavailable to other Species. Assist the creating wizard’s Channelling, Lore (Magic) and Language (Magick) Tests, and Research concerning magical innovation or discovery. Assistance gives +20 rather than +10 (WFRP p. 155).

entries.name: Suffuse With (Wind)
entries.text: Max: 1. Tests: see effects. Select one Wind. Successful casting from its associated Lore within 8 yards gains +1 SL; multiple nearby sources of the same Wind do not stack. Additional effects: Aqshy permits Frenzy and substitutes Channelling (Aqshy) for Willpower to enter it; Azyr substitutes its Channelling for Perception; Chamon for Evaluate; Ghur for Charm Animal and Lore (Beasts); Ghyran for Lore (Plants, Animals, Herbs) and Animal Care; Hysh for Research; Shyish for Intimidate; Ulgu for Stealth. Each substitution applies to all relevant Tests.

entries.name: A Bite of Midges
entries.text:
CN: 5 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

At each Round’s end, warm-blooded creatures in the area take a Damage +2 hit. While inside, each must pass Average (+20) Endurance or gain one Blinded and one Fatigued.

entries.text:

entries.text:

Inherit clan from the mother; marriage does not change it, though an epithet may conceal it. Eyes grey with age, usually completely by 200, while hair eventually turns deep silver. Use the source’s 2d10 appearance tables without added age thresholds or reroll rules.

entries.text: Choose an enemy type, such as Daemons, Undead, Dragons, Goblins or Elves. When this weapon attacks that type, you may Reverse the attack Test and its Critical Wound table rolls.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Master Rune of Snorri Spangelhelm
entries.text: A failed Melee Test with this weapon becomes a success at 0 SL. An opponent can still defeat the attack by scoring more SL on the Opposed Test.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Master Rune of Haste
entries.text: Grants Fast, with a −30 penalty to Melee defence Tests against this weapon instead of −10.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Force
entries.text: While wearing the armour, a successful charging Melee attack adds Damage equal to your highest location AP for each Rune of Impact.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Fortitude
entries.text: Wearing the armour grants +10 Toughness per Rune of Fortitude.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Iron
entries.text: Wearing the armour grants +2 Wounds per Rune of Iron. Remove these Wounds when taking it off; this may cause a Critical Wound if you are badly injured.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Resistance
entries.text: While wearing the armour, gain +10 per Rune of Resistance on Tests to Oppose incoming Melee attacks.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Shielding
entries.text: While wearing the armour, reduce Damage from incoming ranged attacks and spells by 2 per Rune of Shielding. Damage reduced to 0 or less causes no Wound loss.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Stone
entries.text: Each Rune of Stone adds +1 armour AP. Armour bearing only Runes of Stone is exempt from the Rule of Pride and works even within 100 yards of an identical suit.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Master Rune of Adamant
entries.text: While wearing the armour, you may Reverse a Critical Wound table roll made when you suffer a Critical Wound.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Master Rune of Gromril
entries.text: Removes Weakpoints. Only a Runic Flaw (p. 126) can Damage this armour; Talents and effects such as Penetrating cannot reduce its AP. Effects that bypass armour and directly cause Wounds still work.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Master Rune of Steel
entries.text: While wearing the armour, lose at most 10 Wounds from each instance of Damage.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Clear Sight
entries.text: Hold the talisman to your eye to ignore penalties from non-magical fog, mist, smoke or similar vapours. Two Runes of Clear Seeing also pierce magical vapours and permit clear sight in complete darkness.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Truth
entries.text: Touch the talisman to a fake, forgery, counterfeit or deliberately devalued item and it shines. Two Runes of Disclosure also expose magical illusions or copies; three show the bearer exactly how the deception was made.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Far Sight
entries.text: Hold the talisman to your eye to see clearly up to one mile away. Two Runes of Farseeing extend this to two miles; three extend it to four.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of the Furnace
entries.text: While worn, prevents Ablaze and heat exposure, and reduces incoming fire or flaming-attack Damage by 4 per Rune of the Furnace.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Luck
entries.text: While worn, grants one Fortune point per Rune of Luck, even above normal maximum Fortune. Remove those points when taking it off, minimum 0 Fortune. They cannot return until the next session.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.
entries.adaptation: Permanent Resilience expenditure converted to maximum Fortune (core Appendix I).

entries.name: Rune of Restoration
entries.text: After a good night’s sleep wearing it, recover Toughness Bonus Wounds per Rune of Restoration.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Spellbreaking
entries.text: While wearing it, activate a Rune of Spellbreaking before a Magic Resistance Willpower Test to count as rolling 01. Each rune can activate once per adventure.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Spelleating
entries.text: After you dispel a spell with Magic Resistance while wearing it, its caster cannot attempt that spell for your Willpower Bonus in Rounds. Two Runes of Spelleating change this to hours; three change it to weeks.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Warding
entries.text: While worn, lets you impose −10 per Rune of Warding on attacks or spellcasting Tests targeting you.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Master Rune of Balance
entries.text: While worn, when an enemy you can see casts a spell, you may Reverse their Spellcasting Test, or your Opposed Willpower Test if within Magic Resistance range.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Master Rune of Industry
entries.text: While worn, allows one extra Endeavour between adventures.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Master Rune of Kingship
entries.text: While worn, allows you to Reverse Charm, Intimidate or Leadership Tests targeting a Dwarf or a group mostly made up of Dwarfs.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Master Rune of Passage
entries.text: While worn and moving at walking pace or slower, lets you pass through fixed solid objects, including trees, stone and metal cages. You cannot pass through animals or Undead, or finish a Move inside a solid object.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Master Rune of Spite
entries.text: When a Melee attack damages you, its attacker immediately takes 2d10 Damage to a random location, reduced normally by Toughness Bonus and AP.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Alarm
entries.text: A Small or larger creature entering range triggers a loud alarm. Two Runes of Alarm can instead play a recorded sentence; three can instead send a recorded telepathic message any distance to the crafter or their nearest living descendant.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Battle
entries.text: Affected allies start combat with one Momentum per Rune of Battle.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.
entries.adaptation: Fourth Edition Advantage references converted to Momentum (core Appendix I).

entries.name: Rune of Courage
entries.text: Affected allies gain +10 to Psychology Tests per Rune of Courage.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Discovery
entries.text: The crafter selects one metal or gem per Rune of Discovery, such as gold, diamond, gromril, iron ore, obsinite, ithilmar or brightstone. The item shines when a selected material is within range.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Enemy Detection
entries.text: Define a creature category or description per rune, from Skaven or obvious Chaos worshippers to one-eyed red-haired women. The rune glows crimson when a clear match enters range.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Locking
entries.text: Locks in range cannot be picked or forced except by magic or their key. Two Runes of Locking also block magic. Three block the key too, allowing only the crafter or nearest living descendant to open them at will. Breaking the protected chest or door still bypasses the lock.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Purification
entries.text: Affected allies gain +20 per Rune of Purification on Tests against toxins in air or water.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Retribution
entries.text: Desecrating a body in range, including theft from the dead or necromantic casting, immediately gives the offender one Ablaze Condition per Rune of Retribution.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Sanctuary
entries.text: Affected allies gain +10 per Rune of Sanctuary to Magic Resistance Willpower Tests to dispel.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Slowness
entries.text: An enemy Running to Engage an affected ally loses 4 yards of Run distance per Rune of Slowness, to a minimum of its Walk distance.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Verminkill
entries.text: Rodents, Skaven and rat-based creatures such as Rat Ogres lose 2 Wounds per Rune of Verminkill upon entering range or starting a Turn there. Ignore Toughness Bonus and AP.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Master Rune of Expel Chaos
entries.text: Affected allies may Reverse Tests against corruption, Tests to avoid mutations from Corruption, and rolls on Physical or Mental Corruption Tables. When engaged with a Daemonic enemy with Unstable, count the ally as having +2 Momentum when calculating Unstable Wound loss.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.
entries.adaptation: Fourth Edition Advantage references converted to Momentum (core Appendix I).

entries.name: Master Rune of Grimnir
entries.text: You may Reverse enemy Ranged attack Tests targeting affected allies.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Master Rune of Grungni
entries.text: You may Reverse enemy spellcasting Tests targeting affected allies.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Master Rune of Stromni Redbeard
entries.text: Affected allies start combat with one Momentum. This rune’s range doubles to 12 yards, or 24 yards on a battle standard.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.
entries.adaptation: Fourth Edition Advantage references converted to Momentum (core Appendix I).

entries.name: Master Rune of Valaya
entries.text: Affected allies may Reverse Magic Resistance Willpower Tests to Oppose casting. Magic Resistance has no range limit for them: they may Oppose spells against any visible target and dispel persistent spells as well as incoming spells.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Accuracy
entries.text: This weapon gains +10 to hit per Rune of Accuracy.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Burning
entries.text: A hit from this weapon gives one Ablaze Condition per Rune of Burning.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Forging
entries.text: The crew may activate a Rune of Forging to cancel a Fumble, Misfire or both when using this weapon. Each rune works once per adventure.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Penetrating
entries.text: Each Rune of Penetrating adds +2 Damage to this weapon.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Reloading
entries.text: Reduce this weapon’s Reload Rating by 2 per Rune of Reloading. At 0 or below, remove Reload. A Salvo weapon retains a minimum Reload Rating of 1.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Seeking
entries.text: Against flying enemies, this weapon gains +20 to hit per Rune of Seeking.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of the Stalwart
entries.text: Dwarfs crewing this weapon start combat with one Momentum per Rune of the Stalwart. Leaving the crew or becoming Engaged removes this extra Momentum.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of the Valiant
entries.text: Dwarfs crewing this weapon gain +10 Willpower per Rune of the Valiant.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Master Rune of Defence
entries.text: The crew always has hard cover: Ranged attacks against them suffer −30.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Master Rune of Disguise
entries.text: Enemies cannot see this weapon until it fires, after which it stays visible for the combat. Its crew remains visible and moving it still makes noise.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Master Rune of Immolation
entries.text: Any Dwarf in the crew may activate this as a Free Action, destroying the weapon. Every creature within 6 yards suffers Damage 15 to a random location, reduced by Toughness Bonus and AP. Survivors gain Ablaze.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Master Rune of Skewering
entries.text: Once per adventure, activate before a Ranged attack roll with this weapon to count as rolling 01. A successful attack also scores a Critical and can strike any chosen location.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Hearth and Home
entries.text: Requires an Anvil of Doom and a Hard (−2 SL) Runesmithing Action (p. 132). Until the next Round ends, Dwarfs within 25 yards may count as rolling 01 on Cool Tests.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

entries.name: Rune of Oath and Steel
entries.text: Requires an Anvil of Doom and a Hard (−2 SL) Runesmithing Action (p. 132). Dwarfs within 25 yards gain +2 AP to worn armour until the next Round ends.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.
entries.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

entries.name: Rune of Wrath and Ruin
entries.text: Requires an Anvil of Doom and a Hard (−2 SL) Runesmithing Action (p. 132). Each enemy within 25 yards takes Damage 12 to a random location, reduced by Toughness Bonus and AP.
entries.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

Suggested Restitution For Grudges
entries.text:
| Type of Grudge | Suggested Restitution |
| --- | --- |
| Insult to personal honour, such as accusations of lying or poor craft | Equally public apology; compensation for lost earnings |
| Insult to ancestral honour or dead kin | Public apology, gold, and actions restoring the ancestor’s honour |
| Theft, defective goods or damaged property | Full repayment, extra gold for the insult, and repair or replacement labour |
| Injury from defective machinery or a fight | Equivalent injury or gold for lost earnings |
| Failure to fulfil an oath, including protection or courage | Apology and compensation by the offender’s clan; possible exile or Slayer Oath |
| Death, torture, violation, attempted murder or deliberate mutilation of you or kin, including beard cutting | Offender’s death as a Blood Grudge; Dwarfs may choose the Slayer Oath as a merciful alternative |
| Deliberate oathbreaking, including refusal of a lord’s summons or killing kin | Offender’s death as a Blood Grudge, with the same possible Slayer Oath leniency |

entries.name: Crewed (Rating)
entries.text: Requires Rating crew, each possessing the appropriate Ranged Skill. Only one fires each Round; others may move/reload it on their Turns. Misfires affect every crew member at a random Hit Location instead of the Primary Arm. Any crew shortage doubles Reload; being short by at least 2 also adds Imprecise, and at least 3 adds Dangerous. Each duplicate Flaw instead gives a printed −10 to Ranged Tests.

entries.name: Salvo (Rating)
entries.text: Holds Rating shots. Fire one or several, reducing remaining Salvo by the shots used. Each missile after the first suffers a cumulative printed −10 to its Ranged Test. Reload Rating gives the SL needed to restore 1 Salvo; never exceed profile capacity. A Dwarf Salvo weapon misfiring on 00 inflicts hits on its crew equal to remaining Salvo, minimum 1.

entries.name: Spread (Rating)
entries.text: Point Blank: one target, +Rating Damage. Short–Long: target plus the next Rating closest visible creatures; no pair may be more than Rating yards apart. Extreme: the same multiple targets, but −Rating Damage.

Reckoner’s Log: traditionally stone records broken when a grudge is settled; parchment books instead have Encumbrance 1. Stone Tablet: lasting records. Mason tools include a masonry hammer, chisels, pick, spikes and steel tongs.

* Ithilmar and Dragon Armour otherwise use Plate rules, including −10 Stealth while worn. Carried Ithilmar Plate has minimum Enc 1. Ithilmar may also form scale, chain or horse barding; it is always Unique and costs 128 times the ordinary equivalent, or seven doublings. Examples: a 1 GC Mail Coif costs 128 GC, and 8 GC Plate Bracers cost 1024 GC.

Dragon Armour is Plate only. It prevents Ablaze when the protected location is hit; full coverage also prevents location-independent Ablaze, while partial coverage does not. Against any heat-based attack, including Fire Breath and Fire Lore, Dragon Armour cannot be bypassed by armour-ignoring effects and doubles its AP. Other heat protection is at GM discretion. It does not stop suffocation, poisonous fumes, blinding smoke, extreme heat exposure or prolonged intense heat. Dragon Armour is always Unique and costs 1024 times the ordinary equivalent, or ten doublings: a 3 GC Helm costs 3072 GC and a 10 GC Breastplate costs 10240 GC. In Chrace, a White Lion Cloak is considered vulgar unless its wearer hunted and killed that lion.

Aethyrolabe: a Challenging (+0) Lore (Magic) Test reveals relative Wind concentrations; Hard (−20) finds the nearest concentration of one chosen Wind. Flamespyre Phoenix Feather: burns for about one year, lighting as a lantern and igniting as a torch. Frostheart Phoenix Feather: stays cold for about one year, lighting as a candle and refrigerating as an ice brick. Safe feather transport is the buyer’s responsibility. Staff of Nightelm: against Witchcraft, Daemonology, Necromancy, Dark Magic or Chaos Lore spells, the bearer counts as having Magic Resistance 3; it can form a polearm shaft. Eternal Grove wood: crafting suffers −4 SL; bows and polearms made from it gain Durable 4. Wayshard: sold only to trusted protectors, aids Yenlui meditation (p. 46), and a Challenging (+0) Pray Test reveals the nearest waystone’s direction.

entries.name: Example Obsessions
entries.topic: High Elf creation, Careers and magic
entries.text:
| 1d10 | Obsession |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Create an enduring artistic or scholarly masterwork. |
| 2 | Defeat the Dark Elves permanently by strengthening Ulthuan’s army. |
| 3 | Make one Ulthuan kingdom paramount, whether rebuilding Yvresse or sustaining a realm such as Eataine. |
| 4 | Restore High Elf dominions overseas by expanding Ulthuan’s fleets. |
| 5 | Keep Ulthuan’s people and wealth out of alliances with Humans or Dwarfs. |
| 6 | Explore distant regions to see what no Elf has seen. |
| 7 | Find lasting love or a deep friendship with someone who truly understands you. |
| 8 | Teach a philosophy that improves future lives, whether through morality, ending suffering or encouraging pleasure. |
| 9 | Acquire wealth and influence to protect family, friends or neighbours. |
| 10 | Master your emotions and nature to achieve inner peace. |

entries.name: Example Dreams
entries.topic: High Elf creation, Careers and magic
entries.text:
| 1d10 | Dream |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | War-torn Ulthuan; Morvael and Mentheus clasp hands as a Dragon flies. May urge delegation, warn of danger to a friend, or foretell disaster. |
| 2 | Khaine defeats Vaul in a heavenly duel. May warn that revenge will fail or someone is setting a trap. |
| 3 | As Oeric’s lifelong servant, you watch him carve a marble maiden. May suggest dangerous temptation, recovery of something lost, or making a masterwork. |
| 4 | Storms, harpies and green witchfire surround Anlec. May warn of a perilous building or enemies secretly gathering strength. |
| 5 | The Great Vortex tosses you among serene mages. May demand sacrifice to prevent disaster or the undertaking of a dangerous great work. |
| 6 | Malerion and Snorri Whitebeard greet each other as friends before the Phoenix Throne claim. May promise a valuable friendship or warn of betrayal by someone close. |
| 7 | The Bloody-handed God rages over treasures hidden in the mortal world where gods cannot enter. May foretell theft, loss, rediscovery, changing loyalties or a lover’s manipulation. |
| 8 | An admiral orders his dragonship to ram a floating fortress amid an icy sea. May call for bold action to win, or caution against advancing before securing recent gains. |
| 9 | Flamespyre Phoenixes rise from pale stone pillars. May offer reinvention, renewed purpose or escape from death. |
| 10 | An ancient Dragon finds the world too cold and returns to sleep. May warn against ignoring a growing threat for comfort, or indicate circumstances do not favour a planned action. |

entries.name: Cadai Meditation
entries.text: Each day, meditate for at least one hour, then pass an Average (+20) Pray Test to set Yenlui to Light.

entries.name: Mind over Body
entries.text: Max: 3. After at least twenty minutes of quiet meditation, pass a Challenging (+0) Pray Test for benefits lasting 1d10 + SLd10 hours. Level 1: gain Painless and no pain-caused Conditions. Level 2: perceive shapes mentally, including fine detail in crafted objects but no colours, expressions or other fine details; Trade (Smith) has no blindness penalty, and Blinded cannot affect you even from magic or gods. Level 3: spend Resolve to ignore Critical Wound penalties on Extended Tests, including Crafting Endeavours.

entries.name: Fetterfetch
entries.text:
Enchant a dowsing instrument for a spirit you can name. Anyone can use it to find that spirit’s fetter: a nature spirit’s home, or a ghost’s remains, valued object or connected person. Following it requires an Extended Difficult (−1 SL) Navigate Test, one Test per hour, needing 5–15 SL according to distance, concealment and deliberate obstruction. Destroying a fetter usually banishes a spirit or releases a ghost, but killing a loved one may transfer the ghost’s bond to the killer. Resolving unfinished business or communicating for it may instead release it; an unwilling or hostile ghost can resist such efforts. The GM should give a ghost Regenerate while it defends its fetter.

entries.name: Pactbind
entries.text: Cut your hand with a ritually prepared Dhar-infused blade and state an agreement. Another living creature must willingly cut their hand with it and clasp yours, accepting the exact terms without amendment. Any commitments you state also bind you. Each subject must fulfil the literal agreement to the best of their ability; the GM interprets it. A subject receives one warning before a breach. entries.name: Nameless Summons
entries.text:
Prepare a circle up to Willpower Bonus yards across and invite an entity without controlling its identity or conduct. After casting, Test Challenging (+0 SL) Cool and add its SL to 1d10 on the Nameless Summons table. The GM decides the entity, requests, demands and actions; it may demand payment or attack. It remains indefinitely while inside the circle. On leaving, it returns after up to its Willpower Bonus Rounds (minimum 1).
