entries.name: Distant Sounds
entries.text: Listen clearly to a specific known target or noise anywhere in range, including behind walls or in sealed rooms. You must know the target’s location. You may also whisper to them.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Long Reach
entries.text: Extend your reach by the Range with invisible arms. You can grasp or manipulate objects, hold a ladder or ledge, lift up to 2 Enc, and make Sleight of Hand Tests.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Lose the Loot
entries.text: Touch illicitly acquired goods to sense who and where will buy them at a decent price. In a large town or city, this points to the nearest Fence. The GM decides their attitude, but with no Sin Points they should at least trade with you.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Silence Reigns
entries.text: Everyone in the area hears only ordinary background noise; footsteps, barking and other sudden sounds are concealed.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Poor Man’s Face
entries.text: Valuables carried on you are hidden with Ranald for the duration; searches find worthless substitutes. Each hour an object remains hidden gives a 1% chance that Ranald keeps a valuable permanently.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Talk Your Way Out
entries.text: Gain a single +8 SL bonus to a Charm Test made to talk your way out of being caught red-handed.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: The Heat Is Off
entries.text: After a crime, people and authorities overlook you for the next few hours and struggle to recall your presence. Subtract 3 when calculating watch presence using the patrol rules (p. 92). Fellowship-based Tests against Fel take −3 SL because others cannot concentrate on you. Attempting another crime ends the Miracle.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Bountiful Fortune
entries.text: Each chosen companion may reverse the percentile dice on their next Test. The benefit expires if unused within Fellowship Bonus Rounds.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Crisis of Confidence
entries.text: Choose someone in range about to attempt a voluntary Fellowship-based Test. They abandon the attempt. If they must make the Test regardless of choice, it instead takes −20.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Force the Hand of Chance
entries.text: Gain +1 SL on a specified Test. You may repeatedly roll 1d10, adding another +1 SL for each result of 6 or less and stopping whenever you choose. Any result of 7 or more removes every bonus gained and gives −1 SL on the original Test instead.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Perfect Empathy
entries.text: While speaking with someone, understand their meaning, intentions and current thoughts perfectly, regardless of language.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: The Gamemaster
entries.text: On observing a game, sport or similar pastime, learn its rules and best strategies. If it depends on mental skill rather than chance or physical prowess, competing Tests gain +4 SL. When the Miracle ends, you retain only the rules.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Up the Stakes
entries.text: Make a Test normally. Success becomes an Astounding Success; failure becomes an Impressive Failure.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: A Suitable Sucker
entries.text: For the duration, you may reroll results on the Contents of a Purse (p. 28) and Victim Quirk (p. 29) tables. A chosen reroll must be accepted.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Bamboozle
entries.text: A Human-sized creature failing Hard (−2 SL) Cool follows your directions for its next round. You cannot order direct self-harm, though indirect harm is possible. Undead and Daemonic creatures are immune.
entries.adaptation: Named Fourth Edition Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364). Ordinary printed numerical bonuses remain unchanged.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: One Almighty Lie
entries.text: Tell and roleplay an outrageous lie, then invoke the Miracle. If the Pray Test succeeds, add its SL to d10 and apply that total as bonus SL on your Charm Test. The GM may award further SL for an entertaining, implausible lie.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Ranald’s Mischief
entries.text: For an Opposed Test against one adversary, temporarily match two of your Characteristics to theirs. Roll twice on this d10 table, rerolling duplicates: 1–2 Weapon Skill; 3–4 Intelligence; 5–6 Fellowship; 7–8 Initiative; 9–0 any Characteristic of your choice.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Unremembered Face
entries.text: Each creature you meet must pass Hard (−2 SL) Cool to recall more than two facts about your appearance. You choose those two facts.
entries.adaptation: Named Fourth Edition Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364). Ordinary printed numerical bonuses remain unchanged.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Back At You
entries.text: Choose a combat in range in which you are not participating. Compare its participants’ S, T and WS; the one higher in at least two is stronger. While the Miracle lasts, Wounds that participant inflicts in one attack may be added to the next Damage the weaker participant inflicts on them.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Class War
entries.text: A Gold Tier target suffers Curse of Ill-Fortune (Fourth Edition core p. 255) for one day per level of Gold Standing, plus one day per Pray SL. Habitual adherence to Ranald’s strictures prevents the curse.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Free Your Mind
entries.text: You or a chosen target automatically resist Charm and Leadership Tests made by someone of higher Status than that target.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Moment of Clarity
entries.text: Gain Immunity to Psychology for the duration.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Rally Round
entries.text: Allies in the area gain +2 SL to Endurance and Cool Tests, plus another +1 SL per 10 people in the crowd. Silver and Gold Status characters receive no benefit.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Under my Protection
entries.text: Choose an authority figure who has threatened or persecuted a particular victim. From their next sleep, the target has nightmares and must Test Challenging (+0 SL) Cool each morning or gain a Fatigued Condition. Treating their victims kindly or otherwise making amends ends the dreams.
entries.adaptation: Named Fourth Edition Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364). Ordinary printed numerical bonuses remain unchanged.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Auroch’s Heart
entries.text: The target adds your Fellowship Bonus as SL to all Toughness Tests for the duration.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Earthshudder
entries.text: Within Fellowship Bonus yards of a chosen point, targets must pass Difficult (−1 SL) Athletics or gain Prone. Constructed structures in the area take d10 + SL damage.
entries.adaptation: Named Fourth Edition Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364). Ordinary printed numerical bonuses remain unchanged.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Nature’s Repast
entries.text: Touch up to six individual meals made from wild foraged or hunted food. Each eater can go four days before needing an Endurance Test against starvation. The quantity of food and number of people it feeds do not increase.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Pax of Taal
entries.text: Natural animals with Intelligence 25 or less in the area become peaceful and attack nothing, including prey and each other. Bipedal and Chaos-twisted creatures are excluded. Attacking affected animals ends the effect on them.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Rending Paw
entries.text: You or one ally gain +20 Strength for the duration.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: River’s Blessing
entries.text: For the duration, gain +4 SL on Swim Tests and move through water at your full Movement rate rather than half. This has no effect in salt water.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Wild Wind
entries.text: You are unaffected. Other targets in the area take −2 SL on WS and Agi Tests and must pass Difficult (−1 SL) Toughness each round or gain Prone. Ranged attacks cannot be made within the area; only gunpowder and artillery weapons may attack into it.
entries.adaptation: Named Fourth Edition Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364). Ordinary printed numerical bonuses remain unchanged.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Wilderness Way
entries.text: Invoke before a journey period using Chapter 7, Pathfinding (p. 112). Record Pray SL as rerolls available for Planning, Travel or Camp Endeavour results during that journey period. An encounter removes unused rerolls. You may invoke again before the next journey stage.
entries.conversion: Miracle effects remain reference text. No temporary Characteristic changes, Conditions, command Tests, travel rerolls or campaign actions are applied to the created character.

entries.name: Bag of Tarrabeth Seed
entries.text: Leave the bag on your trail to distract tracking dogs. Each dog within 5 yards makes an Average (+2 SL) Willpower Test. Failure delays pursuit for D10 rounds; Astounding Failure (−6 SL or less) makes it abandon the original trail.
entries.conversion: Description: p. 32. The p. 32 prices and Availability are a rough guide for discreet artisan-made tools; ordinary market purchases may arouse suspicion.
entries.adaptation: Named Fourth Edition Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364).

entries.name: Bag of Soot
entries.text: Coat clothes, gear and exposed skin with soot to darken and dull them. In darkness, sight-based Perception Tests to spot you or identify your appearance suffer −1 SL.
entries.conversion: Description: p. 32. The p. 32 prices and Availability are a rough guide for discreet artisan-made tools; ordinary market purchases may arouse suspicion.

entries.name: Caltrops (12)
entries.text: Spend an Action to scatter 12 caltrops across a 2-yard-diameter area. Entering requires a Hard (−2 SL) Athletics Test, or Average (+2 SL) if aware of them and walking. Failure causes a Damage D10 hit to a random leg and one Surprised Condition.
entries.conversion: Description: p. 32. The p. 32 prices and Availability are a rough guide for discreet artisan-made tools; ordinary market purchases may arouse suspicion.
entries.adaptation: Named Fourth Edition Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364).

entries.name: Crampons (2)
entries.text: While worn: Climb Tests gain +2 SL on rock or wood and +1 SL on rope. Outside climbing, Athletics and Agility Tests suffer −1 SL; Stealth and all other movement Tests suffer −2 SL.
entries.conversion: Description: p. 32. The p. 32 prices and Availability are a rough guide for discreet artisan-made tools; ordinary market purchases may arouse suspicion.

entries.name: Glass Cutter
entries.text: Cut or bore glass with an Average (+2 SL) Art (Engraving) Test. Results (p. 33): +1 or more cuts safely; +0 cuts with normal breaking-glass noise; −0 bores a hole but deals Damage 3 to the primary hand; −1 or less shatters the pane noisily and deals Damage 3 to that hand.
entries.conversion: Description: p. 33. The p. 32 prices and Availability are a rough guide for discreet artisan-made tools; ordinary market purchases may arouse suspicion.
entries.adaptation: Named Fourth Edition Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364).

entries.name: Periscope
entries.text: Make sight-based Perception Tests around corners or over obstacles while your body stays hidden or in cover.
entries.conversion: Description: p. 33. The p. 32 prices and Availability are a rough guide for discreet artisan-made tools; ordinary market purchases may arouse suspicion.

entries.name: Smoke Bomb
entries.text: Throw as an incendiary. Smoke fills a large room or an outdoor area 10 yards across for 2D10 Rounds, doubled indoors. You cannot see through it; visibility inside is 1 yard. The air is unbreathable: characters inside test for Suffocation under Fourth Edition core p. 181.
entries.conversion: Description: p. 33. The p. 32 prices and Availability are a rough guide for discreet artisan-made tools; ordinary market purchases may arouse suspicion.

entries.name: Thin Jimmy
entries.text: Open a bolted door or a door with a keyed lock, excluding padlocks, with a Hard (−2 SL) Sleight of Hand Test. Results (p. 33): +1 or more opens it without damage and permits relocking; +0 opens it but visibly breaks the mechanism or bolt; −0 leaves it shut; −1 or less also makes scraping audible in adjoining rooms.
entries.conversion: Description: p. 33. The p. 32 prices and Availability are a rough guide for discreet artisan-made tools; ordinary market purchases may arouse suspicion. User-approved printed naming mismatch: table Thin Jimmy uses the description headed Steel Mummit. The naming correction alone is not a Legacy adaptation.
entries.adaptation: Named Fourth Edition Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364).

entries.name: Telescopic Pole
entries.text: Extends from a hooked cane to twelve feet. Use Dexterity to manipulate objects within 4 yards, with −2 SL on every Test using the pole.
entries.conversion: Description: p. 33. The p. 32 prices and Availability are a rough guide for discreet artisan-made tools; ordinary market purchases may arouse suspicion. User-approved printed naming mismatch: table Telescopic Pole uses the description headed Telescopic Stick. The naming correction alone is not a Legacy adaptation.

entries.name: Pickpocket Success Table
entries.text:
| Pickpocket’s SL | Result |
| --- | --- |
| +1 or more | Take the item without the victim noticing. |
| Success but no SL | Take the item; within D10 Rounds the victim notices and publicly calls out the theft. |
| Fail but no SL | Take nothing; the victim does not notice the attempt. |
| -1 or less | Take nothing; the victim notices the attempt. |

entries.name: Incriminating Artefact
entries.text:
| 2D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 2 | Chunk of Warpstone: Lead-lined case; Moderate Corrupting Influence, worth 3 GC. |
| 3 to 4 | Silver Badge: Proscribed cult or god symbol, potentially illegal to possess; worth 6/8 to a suitable buyer. |
| 5 | Seditionary Tract: Revolutionary political pamphlet. |
| 6 | Mysterious Document: A ciphered secret, potentially spy notes or a murder contract. |
| 7 to 9 | Laughing Powder: D10 doses of Ranald's Delight (WFRP page 306), worth 18/– each. |
| 10 to 12 | Hot Item: Stolen or dishonestly obtained sapphire ring, worth 5/–. |
| 13 to 15 | Silver Badge: Violent gang insignia, worth 6/8; displaying it may provoke fear or hatred. |
| 16 to 17 | Bone Relic: Possible trophy or necromantic component. |
| 18 | Mysterious Vial: Unidentified liquid, possibly spirits or a potion (Winds of Magic page 154). |
| 19 | Wayshard: Gem holding dead Elven essence, useful for navigation. Elves distrust outsiders holding one but may reward its return. |
| 20 | Vial of Black Lotus: 2 Blade Venom doses (WFRP page 306). |

entries.name: The Contents Of A Purse
entries.text:
| 2D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 2 | Something Incriminating: Roll Incriminating Artefact for a valuable but dangerous possession. |
| 3 to 4 | Moths: Empty purse. |
| 5 to 6 | Out of Pocket: One coin of the victim’s Status denomination. |
| 7 | Set of Bone Dice: Worth 10d. |
| 8 to 9 | Taffeta Handkerchief: Worth 1/–; D10 of 5 or more makes it monogrammed. |
| 10 to 12 | Payday: Twice the victim’s normal money. |
| 13 | Silver Ring with Griffon Decoration: Worth 3/–. |
| 14 | Silk Handerkerchief: Worth 3/6; D10 of 5 or more makes it monogrammed. |
| 15 | Leather Gloves: Worth 4/–. |
| 16 | Ruby Ring: Silver ring with red gem, worth 5/–. |
| 17 | Silver Hammer Badge: Sigmarite badge worth 6/8. |
| 18 | Big Spender: Coins equal to twice the owner’s Status, plus d10 more coins. |
| 19 | Bottle of Perfume: Silver-stoppered bottle worth 10/–. |
| 20 | String of Miraglianese Pearls: Tilean pearl necklace worth 10/–. |

entries.name: Victim Quirk Table
entries.text:
| 2D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 2 | Already Acquainted: The GM determines prior familiarity. Hard (-20) Perception notices recognition. |
| 3 | Uncanny Ability: A supernatural ability complicates theft, such as Psychometry (Winds of Magic page 47), divination or spellcasting. |
| 4 | Friends in Low Places: Criminal contacts or protectors may retaliate for the theft. |
| 5 | Amputated Part: Lost or unusable part; d10: 1–3 Leg, 4–6 Arm, 7–8 Eyes, 9 Tongue, 10 Ears. |
| 6 | Dummy Purse: Contains two pennies; larger coins are concealed elsewhere. On an additional D10 of 1, it contains a poisoned needle: taking it causes Poisoned unless Challenging (+0) Perception succeeds. |
| 7 | Unsuspecting: Perception suffers -1 SL. |
| 8 | Intoxicated: Roll Stinking Drunk (WFRP page 121) or apply Weirdroot (page 306). |
| 9 | Veteran: Add Elite (WFRP page 339). |
| 10 | Tough Customer: Add Brute (WFRP page 338). |
| 11 | Cautious: Give one Fortune Point usable to reroll one Test preventing a crime against them. |
| 12 | Quick Witted: Add Clever (WFRP page 338). |
| 13 | Feeling Peaky: Has early Itching Pox (WFRP page 187); Average (+20) Perception notices blisters before close approach. |
| 14 | Future Patron: May later offer employment, crucial help or information. |
| 15 | This One’s Jittery: Perception gains +1 SL. |
| 16 | Cutpurse: Also a thief and may steal from the pickpocket. |
| 17 | Friends in High Places: Powerful connections can make them useful to exploit but also support retaliation. |
| 18 | Vengeful: Devotes substantial resources to identifying and punishing thieves; this may be the default for Dwarfs. |
| 19 | Diseased: Has early Black Plague (WFRP page 186) and fleas. Challenging (+0) Perception notices symptoms before approach, avoiding a contraction Test. |
| 20 | Mutant: A concealed mutation may become apparent during theft. D10 (WFRP page 184): 1–2 Animalistic Legs, 3–4 Corpulent, 5–6 Emaciated, 7–8 Extra Leg Joints, 9–10 Patchy Feathers. |

entries.name: Endeavour Complications
entries.text:
| D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Ranaldans Take Note: Local Ranaldans may become allies if their code is respected, or deceive and prank you if offended. |
| 2 | Drawing the Heat: Verenan investigators may pursue you; otherwise apply Under Suspicion before determining other events next downtime. |
| 3 – 4 | Barred: The GM chooses at least one shop or lodging that refuses entry because of your theft reputation; clustered venues may ban you together. |
| 5 – 6 | Lucky Find: Receive normal income and roll Contents of a Purse once (page 28). |
| 7 – 8 | A Favour Owed: Someone knowing your crimes may demand a Minor Favour for silence. |
| 9 | Kingpin Takes Notice: A crime lord demands your service under threat (Organised Crime, page 57). |
| 10 | Rich Pickings: Receive normal income and roll Contents of a Purse twice (page 28). |

entries.name: The Income Endeavour
entries.text: Thief, Pickpocket and Burglar Characters taking Income may either receive normal money only, or also roll the accompanying Endeavour Complications table.

entries.name: Crypt Complications
entries.text:
| 2D10 | You Unearth… |
| --- | --- |
| 2 | Stake: An ash stake impales the corpse. Very Easy (+60) Lore (Undead) identifies its anti-Vampire purpose; the GM determines removal consequences. |
| 3 | Papers: No corpse; documents may reveal GM-chosen secrets or misconduct. |
| 4 – 6 | Mass Grave: Test for Black Plague exposure (WFRP page 186). |
| 7 – 9 | Fine Clothing: Jacket worth 9/- and clothes worth 5/-. |
| 10 – 12 | Pennies: Two burial pennies. Taking them may disturb the spirit and is considered abhorrent. |
| 13 – 15 | Rich Grave Goods: Coat worth 1 GC, fine clothes worth 10/-, gold rings worth 4 GC. |
| 16 – 18 | Ghouls: Disturb two feeding Ghouls; no valuables remain. |
| 19 | Sumptuous Grave Goods: Robes worth 4 GC, clothing worth 2 GC and jewellery worth 10 GC. |
| 20 | Notable Person: As Sumptuous Grave Goods; Hard (-20) Lore (Heraldry) identifies a notable local who recently vanished. |
| 2D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 2 | Presumptive Interment: The buried person is alive, incapacitated by stupor or catalepsy, and may react ambivalently to rescue by a corpse thief. |
| 3 | Stirring Cadaver: Corruption or a nearby magical miscast may animate it as a Zombie. |
| 4 – 7 | Suffuse with Shyish: Second Sight sees Shyish around it. Successful Lore of Death casting within 8 yards gains +1 SL; this bonus applies once regardless of nearby sources. |
| 8 – 14 | Familiar Face: Anyone who knew the person readily recognises the well-preserved corpse. |
| 15 – 17 | Bloated Corpse: Rapid decomposition makes it unsuitable for customers wanting fresh bodies. |
| 18 – 19 | Ransacked Remains: Internal organs are missing; unsuitable if the buyer requires them. |

entries.name: Black Market
entries.text: For illicit purchases, make Challenging (+0) Haggle. Success locates the item at a price increased by twice its usual value. Fences and Bawds may instead sell illicit goods: Challenging (+0) Haggle yields half standard value, increased by 10% for every additional 2 SL.

entries.name: Criminal Endeavours
entries.text: Any Character may take these between-adventure Endeavours to prepare resources for theft or assassination.

entries.name: Gambling Den
entries.text: Cannot follow Banking. Choose a gambling activity and stake, then make Hard (-20) Gamble. Success returns the stake plus one stake per +SL. Failure loses the stake and incurs a further stake of debt per -SL.

entries.name: Plant Identities
entries.text: Choose and spend time establishing a false identity. If its Status exceeds yours, pay your full Income Endeavour earnings per Status level. Pass Difficult (-10) Entertain (Acting) to gain +2 SL to Charm and Performance as that identity during the next adventure. If you lack Secret Identity, also count as having it next adventure, provided that adventure occurs in the region where the identity was established. Impersonating a famous person should make the Test substantially harder.

entries.name: Whisper Campaign
entries.text: Choose a rumour and target, then make Hard (-20) Charm. Success spreads the rumour locally, raising or lowering the target’s Status by one level for a week. Each additional +2 SL lets you add a detail. Each -2 SL of failure makes people believe the opposite, potentially raising a target’s Status when you intended to lower it. Impressive Failure or worse also gives you a reputation for gossip.

entries.name: New Endeavour: Establishing A Contact
entries.text: Between adventures, use this Endeavour to establish a Contact in consultation with the GM.

entries.text:
| D10 | Quality of Service | Quality of Relationship |

| 1 | Dreadful: Unreliable information, fragile tools, poor sales, uncomfortable or insecure hiding places and possible arrest. A defined profile suffers -2 SL to Tests; otherwise Test at 25. | Chilly: Serves grudgingly and will identify you under interrogation to protect themselves. |
| 2 – 3 | Poor: Mostly accurate but incomplete information and mediocre equipment; forgeries withstand casual inspection only. The Watch may be suspicious. A defined profile suffers -2 SL to Tests; otherwise Test at 35. | Iffy: Generally useful but occasionally unreliable, without personal affection. |
| 4 – 7 | Fair: Broadly accurate information, decent fencing prices and forgeries surviving ordinary inspection. | Average: Dependable but unwilling to take personal risks for you. |
| 8 – 9 | Superior: Comprehensive information, premium fencing prices and forgeries surviving close inspection. A defined profile gains +1 SL to Tests; otherwise Test at 55. | Good: Friendly and may volunteer help. |
| 10 | Awesome: Accurate information including unsolicited relevant details, superior equipment and secure comfortable hiding places. A defined profile gains +2 SL to Tests; otherwise Test at 65. | Solid: Always tries to help and never betrays you willingly. |

The GM rolls or selects service and relationship qualities appropriate to the Contact. Each additional Establish a Contact Endeavour improves Relationship one row, such as Iffy to Average.

entries.name: Endeavours in Gaol
entries.text: In gaol, Change Career permits only Agitator, Charlatan, Fence, Forger, Racketeer, Protagonist, Thief or Smuggler. Training permits only their Skills; Unusual Learning permits only their Talents. Pay tutors with a Major Favour instead of money. Study a Mark works normally, representing information obtained from prisoners.

entries.name: New Endeavour: Gaol Break
entries.text: GM permission required; some prisons cannot be escaped. One Character attempts it; assistants spend their own Endeavours. Use Stealth or Sleight of Hand: watch-post cell, Challenging (+0); Moderate Crimes, Extended Challenging (+0), 5 SL; Serious Crimes, Extended Difficult (-10), 7 SL; Heinous Crimes, Extended Hard (-20), 10 SL. Complete within five Rounds to free the prisoner. Failure may merely end the attempt; Impressive Failure or worse may cause assistants’ arrest. On discovery, the escapee is declared an Outlaw; recognised assistants may also be outlawed.

entries.name: Weather Table
entries.text:
Roll independently for each weather column. Change weather at GM discretion, normally once daily. Summer is unmodified; add 2 in spring or autumn, 4 in winter, and another 2 for colder climates or high altitude.

|  |  |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1D10 Roll | Temperature | Precipitation | Visibility | Wind |
| 1 | Sweltering | None | Clear | Still |
| 2 | Hot | None | Clear | Light |
| 3–5 | Comfortable | None | Clear | Medium |
| 6–8 | Comfortable | Light | Mist | Strong |
| 9–10 | Chilly | Heavy | Thick Fog | Very Strong |
| 11 | Chilly | Very Heavy | Mist | Medium |
| 13 | Bitter | Heavy | Mist | Light |
| 14+ | Bitter | None | Clear | Still |

Chilly: Without warm clothing, pass Challenging Endurance (+0) or suffer Cold Exposure (WFRP page 181). Without a good campfire, Test again overnight.

Bitter: Test Cold Exposure at least once, or twice with inadequate gear. Test again overnight without excellent shelter and fire. Gloves are required; wearing them imposes -2 SL on Dexterity tasks.

Undead and Constructs ignore temperature penalties.

| 10 | Orc Totem: Each evening, 10% chance of D10 Orcs and Goblins arriving to celebrate; add a Shaman if using Tribes and Tribulations. They attack Characters at the site. |

entries.name: Endeavours
entries.text: Normally each journey stage permits one Travel Endeavour en route and one Camp Endeavour afterwards. Other duties may prevent either at GM discretion. Doing both requires Hard (-20) Endurance; failure gives Fatigued. Peaceful uninterrupted sleep should allow recovery by morning.

entries.name: Factors Impacting Endeavours
entries.text: Apply weather, terrain and GM-chosen situational modifiers (pages 114 and 124), including wet clothing, hunger, thirst or extreme conditions. One Character may combine Map with Navigate at -1 SL to both, or any two of Water, Hunt, Forage and Scout at -1 SL each.

entries.name: Journey Endeavours
entries.text: Journey Endeavours operate separately from downtime Endeavours (WFRP page 195); their restrictions generally do not transfer and one type normally cannot substitute for the other. Planning is a party preparation before departure. Each Character may take Travel during each stage, though some require everyone. Camp follows completion of a stage. The extracted Camp definition is incomplete; consult the cited source.

entries.name: Planning Endeavour
entries.text:
With preparation time and access to prior travellers’ charts, journals or advice, each Character may attempt Challenging (+0) Outdoor Survival or Research. Spend each SL during the journey to require a Travel Event reroll, accepting the second result, or reroll a Journey or Camp Endeavour Test.

| JOURNEY ENDEAVOURS Planning Endeavour | JOURNEY ENDEAVOURS Planning Endeavour |
| --- | --- |
| Travel Endeavours | Camp Endeavours |
| Forage | Cook |
| Haste | Journal |
| Hunt/Fish | Make Camp |
| Map | Map |
| Navigate | Navigate |
| Scout | Recuperate |
| Track | Trap |
| Water | Watch |

entries.name: List Of Common Shortfalls
entries.text:
|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| The Party Lack... | Consequence |
| Food | Use Hunt, Fish or Forage during travel, or Trap in camp, to avoid Starvation. |
| Cooked Food | Use Cook or Test for Galloping Trots. |
| Adequate Shelter | Use Make Camp to avoid Heat or Cold Exposure and overnight Healing penalties. |
| Water | Use Water to avoid Thirst. |
| Rest and Recuperation | Take Recuperate to address Fatigued Conditions or Wounds. |

entries.name: Forage Endeavour
entries.text: Make Challenging (+0) Outdoor Survival, Lore (Herbs) or a similar Test to gather natural food. Each SL feeds one person for one day. A Fumble may produce tainted or misidentified food; anyone eating it gains Poisoned. Use Cook before eating to avoid Galloping Trots risk.

entries.name: Haste Endeavour
entries.text: Double distance for the stage. Everyone must take Haste to remain together, preventing other Travel Endeavours. Each traveller passes Challenging (+0) Endurance or starts Camp with Fatigued.

entries.name: Hunt (or Fish) Endeavour
entries.text: Make Challenging (+0) Outdoor Survival; each SL feeds two people for a day. Apply normal Hunter’s Eye or Fisherman bonuses in Light Woodland, Hills, Deep Forest, Temperate Plains and Wetland. Use Cook before eating to avoid Galloping Trots risk.

entries.name: Navigate Endeavour
entries.text: Each stage requires at least one navigator to make Challenging (+0) Navigation, unless using a local guide. Following a guide makes the party dependent on their route; independent checks remain possible. Double Endeavour devotes both Travel and Camp to navigation, granting +1 SL but preventing other Endeavours.

entries.name: Navigation Endeavour Outcomes
entries.text:
|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| SL | Result |
| +3 or more | Find a shortcut: reduce remaining journey Stages by one. |
| +0 to +2 | Complete the current Stage on course. |
| -0 to -2 | Add one Stage; generate a Travel Event for the next Stage. |
| -3 or less | Add one Stage and a next-Stage Travel Event. Future Navigate suffers -3 SL until a Navigate Endeavour succeeds. |

entries.name: Cook Endeavour
entries.text: Cook fresh gathered or hunted food to avoid Galloping Trots contraction Tests. Usually make Average (+20) Trade (Cook) or Challenging (+0) Outdoor Survival. Success produces a meal, with quality reflected by SL. Failure spoils one person-day of food per failure level; preparing extra food can offset losses. On Critical Failure, the GM may roll Cooking Critical Failure.

entries.name: Cooking Critical Failure Table
entries.text:
| D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 1-3 | Disgusting: Pass Average (+20) Endurance to eat the barely edible food. |
| 4-5 | Spoiled: All food is unusable; find and prepare replacements. |
| 6-7 | Burned: All food is unusable; nearby enemies can clearly see its smoke. |
| 8 | Food Poisoning: Eaters gain Poisoned Conditions equal to the cooking Test’s failure level. |
| 9 | The Bloody Flux: Fail Easy (+40) Endurance and contract Bloody Flux (WFRP page 186). |
| 10 | Galloping Trots: Fail Average (+20) Endurance and contract Galloping Trots (WFRP page 187). |

entries.name: Map Endeavour
entries.text: Test Average (+20) Trade (Cartography) or Challenging (+0) Art (Drawing) at every journey stage to create a useful map. Success also grants +1 SL to next stage’s Navigate. Usually a Travel Endeavour; Double Endeavour uses Travel and Camp, blocks other Endeavours and grants +1 SL. A basic map may sell for 3 shillings per stage covered; SL above the minimum doubles this. An established reputation for accuracy may command more.

entries.name: Scout Endeavour
entries.text: Make Challenging (+0) Perception. Success warns of adverse Travel Events. A threat avoidable by changing route may be bypassed by adding two Stages.

entries.name: Track Endeavour
entries.text: Follow a quarry with Average (+20) Tracking if they are unaware or leave their trail unconcealed. An aware quarry may oppose with Stealth (Rural). After failure, retrace to the last reliable location for another attempt once you realise the trail is lost.

entries.name: Water Endeavour
entries.text: Make Challenging (+0) Outdoor Survival to refill the whole expedition’s water. Critical Failure may produce contamination, detectable with Challenging (+0) Perception. Drinking contaminated water requires a Bloody Flux contraction Test (WFRP page 186).

entries.name: Journal Endeavour
entries.text: Requires Read/Write. Keep an expedition account useful for records or later travellers. The GM may assess writing quality and errors with Average (+20) Art (Writing) for an engaging narrative, or Language (Any) for a factual account. This has little direct effect on the current expedition.

entries.name: Make Camp Endeavour
entries.text: Make Challenging (+0) Outdoor Survival to establish shelter. Success allows restful sleep and protects against Heat or Cold Exposure in sweltering or chilly conditions. Overnight Healing normally uses Average (+20) Endurance, but a makeshift camp makes it Challenging; Critical Success restores Average. Failure prevents restful sleep. A Fumble lets the GM add a serious flaw, such as damaged equipment, flooding or predators.

entries.name: Recuperate Endeavour
entries.text: Spend a day resting in an established camp in suitable conditions to recover from exertion, Fatigued Conditions and injuries. Gaining Fatigued or exerting yourself significantly spoils Recuperate. Other party members may perform Camp Endeavours while you rest.

entries.name: Trap Endeavour
entries.text: Camp only. Make Challenging (+0) Set Trap; each SL provides one person-day of food by morning. Critical Success may double this; a Fumble may attract a large predator. Use Cook before eating to avoid Galloping Trots risk.

entries.name: Watch Endeavour
entries.text: Keep watch for some or all of the night. You may add Watch to Travel and Camp, but gain an extra Fatigued during the watch. Three hours or less leaves enough sleep to remove fatigue; longer watches do not. Starting watch while Fatigued requires Average (+20) Willpower to avoid falling asleep.

entries.name: Hunting As Endeavour
entries.text: Travel hunting normally gathers small game (page 125). Larger game uses the terrain and Difficulties on page 124; hounds and hawks may assist. Hunting as a downtime General Endeavour (WFRP page 196) permits three Tests with cumulative results.

entries.name: Charlatan Income Endeavour Complications
entries.text:
| D10 | Result |

| 1 | Ranaldans Take Note: Followers of Ranald the Deceiver may cooperate if you follow their code; otherwise they may steal from or deceive you. |

| 5 – 6 | Rumour: The GM supplies an opportunity or scam untried locally; see page 40. |

entries.name: Arboreal
entries.text: In woodland, add Agility Bonus SL to the creature's Stealth and Climb Tests.

entries.name: Bilebrew
entries.text: Drink a mixture of spleen and gall. You and friendly Ogres in the area gain Hatred of a target or group you choose.

entries.name: Bloodgruel
entries.text: Suck blood and marrow from a severed limb, then Test Easy (+4 SL) Endurance. Success heals 1 Wound plus 1 per SL; failure gives you Bloody Flux.
entries.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty converted to Fifth Edition SL (core Appendix I p. 364).

entries.name: Get Some Guts
entries.text: Consume a male Mournfang’s large intestine. Targets ignore Broken Conditions for the duration.

entries.name: Toothcracker
entries.text: Chew earth-encrusted bedrock from a mountain peak, then Test Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance; failure costs one tooth per −1 SL. Successful casting gives you and friendly Ogres in the area +20 to Endurance and Cool Tests and +1 AP at every location for the duration.

entries.name: Behave!
entries.text: An affected Squig, Giant Wolf, Spider of any Size, or Snotling obeys the Shaman like a trained dog.

entries.name: Cunnin’ Words
entries.text: The Shaman speaks a language understood by the listener.

entries.name: Curse of Da Bad Moon
entries.text: Enemies in the area gain +1 Fatigued Condition and cannot spend Fortune Points for the duration.

entries.name: Gift of the Spider-God
entries.target: Forest Goblins in AoE (Willpower Bonus yards)
entries.text: Affected allies gain Venom at Challenging (+0 SL) potency. Existing Venom becomes Difficult (−1 SL) potency instead.
entries.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty converted to Fifth Edition SL (core Appendix I p. 364). Use current core Venom: Wounds inflict Poisoned; Challenging or Difficult specifies recovery Difficulty.

entries.name: Gork’ll Fix It
entries.text: The target suffers one Fatigued Condition for the duration.

entries.name: The Great Green Spite
entries.text: During the spell, every successful Goblin melee or ranged strike against an enemy in the area counts as a Critical Hit. A Hobgoblin caster grants this effect to Hobgoblins instead.

entries.name: Itchy Nuisance
entries.text: The target takes −1 SL to every Test for the duration, increased to −2 SL while wearing metal armour.

entries.name: Mork Wants Ya!
entries.text: The target must win an Opposed Strength Test against Strength 80 to escape a giant hand. Failure causes a 10 Damage body hit, then a fall from 2d10 yards.

entries.name: Night Shroud
entries.text: Throw a black-capped nightshade mushroom to create a cloud. Everyone inside gains Blinded and must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Perception when trying to move or gain Prone. Night Vision or Dark Vision makes a character immune to both effects.

entries.name: Nikkit!
entries.text: Attempt to pick a pocket in range using Sleight of Hand 55. After a successful theft, the victim may pass Challenging (+0 SL) Perception to see the conjured hands returning the loot to the Shaman.

entries.name: Sneaky Stabbin’
entries.target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Orcs and Goblins
entries.text: Affected targets’ blows gain Impale and Penetrating.

entries.name: Vindictive Glare
entries.text: A Damage +4 magic missile strikes everyone in the area. Targets taking Damage must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool or gain Stunned.

entries.name: ‘Ard as Nails
entries.text: The target gains Hatred of all enemies, ignores harmful effects of Conditions and Diseases, and adds +2 SL to Toughness-based Tests.

entries.name: Bash ‘Em Lads!
entries.text: Allocate one Momentum per Casting SL among allied Orcs, Goblins and Hobgoblins in range. Multiple points may go to one target.
entries.adaptation: Printed individual Advantage uses Momentum; the Fourth Edition Group Advantage alternative is omitted.

entries.name: Brainbursta
entries.text: The target immediately gains Prone and Stunned, plus one additional Stunned per Casting SL. If its Stunned Conditions exceed Toughness Bonus, it must immediately pass Average (+2 SL) Cool or take a Critical Hit to the head.
entries.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty converted to Fifth Edition SL (core Appendix I p. 364).

entries.name: ‘Eadbutt
entries.text: A Damage +1 magic missile always hits the head. Damage becomes +6 against a target with Aethyric Attunement or Second Sight.
entries.adaptation: Legacy: user-approved Target 1 resolves printed Target You conflicting with the magic-missile effect.

entries.name: ‘Ere We Go!
entries.text: Targets in the area gain +2 Momentum for Melee Tests. For a Hobgoblin caster, the spell targets Hobgoblins instead of Orcs.
entries.adaptation: Printed individual Advantage uses Momentum; the Fourth Edition Group Advantage alternative is omitted.

entries.name: The Evil Sun
entries.text: Each Round, targets in the area suffer 8 + SL Damage and must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or gain an Ablaze Condition.

entries.name: Fists of Gork
entries.text: Drop everything held and attack only with fists for the duration, using Melee (Brawling) 55 and Weapon (Fists) +9.

entries.name: Foot of Gork
entries.text: All targets in the area gain Prone and take an 8 Damage hit to a random location, ignoring AP. Passing Difficult (−1 SL) Dodge reduces Damage to 4.
entries.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty converted to Fifth Edition SL (core Appendix I p. 364).

entries.name: Gaze of Mork
entries.text: A Damage +4 magic missile hits every living creature on a straight line along the blast. Structures of Toughness 65 or less also take Damage.

entries.name: The Hand of Gork
entries.text: Move 1d10 targets to a place in range. They must begin within Willpower Bonus yards of each other. On landing, targets immediately entering Melee gain +1 Momentum in combat.
entries.adaptation: Printed individual Advantage uses Momentum; the Fourth Edition Group Advantage alternative is omitted.

entries.name: Mork Save Us!
entries.text: For each Casting SL, give one allied Orc, Goblin or Hobgoblin in range Ward 10. An existing Ward improves by 1 instead, but cannot reach 7+ or better this way.

entries.name: WAAAGH!
entries.target: AoE (Willpower yards) all Orcs, Goblins, and Related Creatures within range — not just allies
entries.text: Orcs, Hobgoblins and Goblins in the area gain 1 Momentum usable for Melee and Ranged Tests, remove all Broken Conditions, and gain +2 SL to Cool and Endurance for the duration.
entries.adaptation: Printed individual Advantage uses Momentum; the Fourth Edition Group Advantage alternative is omitted.

entries.name: Copper Staff
entries.text: While holding it, a Shaman counts as isolated from Orcs and Goblins: −2 SL to Channelling or Casting Tests, and ignore Orcs, Hobgoblins and Goblins when rolling Waaagh! Miscasts. No price or Encumbrance supplied; acquired/reference only.

entries.name: Dangly Wotnotz
entries.text: A Shaman carrying this may reroll a successful Casting Test, but must use the second result. No price or Encumbrance supplied; acquired/reference only.

entries.name: Effigy of Mork
entries.text: A Shaman carrying this may reroll Dodge or Melee Tests to Oppose attacks, accepting the second result even if worse. No price or Encumbrance supplied; acquired/reference only.

entries.name: Effigy of Gork
entries.text: A Shaman carrying this may reroll Melee attacks, accepting the second result even if worse. No price or Encumbrance supplied; acquired/reference only.

entries.name: Glowy Green Amulet
entries.text: Grants Magic Resistance. Whenever the bearer is targeted by a spell, roll 1d100: on 01, the amulet deals 1d10 Wounds, ignoring TB and armour, and causes Prone. No price or Encumbrance supplied; acquired/reference only.
entries.adaptation: Legacy: printed Magic Resistance 2 becomes one core Talent rank; its fixed Fifth Edition effects apply.

entries.name: Shaman Staff
entries.text: Roll 1d10 once for this staff. For Channelling, Casting and Waaagh! Miscast rolls, the Shaman always counts as having that many Orcs within Willpower Bonus yards. No price or Encumbrance supplied; acquired/reference only.

entries.name: War Machine Bolt
entries.text: Printed name: Bolt. Range: as weapon; Damage: —; Impale, Penetrating. No price supplied.

entries.name: War Machine Stone
entries.text: Printed name: Stone. Range: as weapon; Damage: —; Damaging, Impact. No price supplied.

entries.name: Wulfang’s Pelt
entries.text: While worn, grants one core Rough Rider rank and gives the wearer’s mount +1 Movement. The printed Roughrider name follows the documented core spelling. Neither benefit is permanent. No price or Encumbrance supplied; acquired/reference only.

entries.name: Die Hard
entries.text: Any Critical Wound can heal. For TB Rounds after death, attempt Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance at each Round's start; success restores life at 1 Wound.
entries.adaptation: User-supplied older-edition definition retained; no direct Fifth Edition equivalent.

entries.name: Corrupting Vomit
entries.text: Being hit by Chaos Troll vomit exposes the target to Moderate Corruption.

entries.name: Rotten Regeneration
entries.text: Follow core Regeneration, replacing restored Wounds with half of 1d10, rounded down (p. 88).

entries.name: Bileful Vomit
entries.text: Use Stream of Corruption (CN 9; special Range/Target; Instant). Immediately make an Unopposed Acid- and Poison-type Breath attack. It is a magic missile dealing TB Damage that ignores AP. Targets losing more than their TB in Wounds must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or contract Blood Rot.

entries.name: That’s No Mound
entries.text: Stealthy applies only until the Troll moves or takes an Action.

entries.name: Sated
entries.text: Eating an Average-or-larger creature undisturbed removes the Hungry Troll template.

entries.name: Starving
entries.text: After 24 hours without food, the Hungry Troll begins suffering Starvation.

entries.name: Water Wise
entries.text: The River Troll Hag ignores Stupid while in a body of water; elsewhere it still applies.

entries.name: Purple Skullback Bite
entries.text: Being wounded and Poisoned by the bite requires Average (+2 SL) Cool; failure gives 1 Corruption. Forest Goblin Shamans still suffer damage/poison, but gain the printed +2d10 to Channelling and Language (Magick) for 2d10 hours and may reroll Waaagh! Miscasts. These bonuses are temporary.
entries.adaptation: Printed Average (+20) uses core Average (+2 SL); current Venom inflicts Poisoned on Wounds without an avoidance Test.

| 16–20 | Gobstopper: fail Hard (−20) Endurance and lose speech, including Gut Magic casting, for 1d10 Rounds. |
| 21–30 | Rage of the Maw: become subject to Frenzy. |
| 31–35 | Green Around the Gills: Nausea for 1d10 hours. |
| 36–40 | Dental Mishap: lose one tooth. |
| 41–45 | Runny Guts: immediately contract Bloody Flux. |
| 46–50 | Famishing: eat one pound of flesh within 2d10 Rounds or suffer Starvation as after 2 foodless days. |
| 51–55 | Rampant Ravenous Rage: all creatures within 3d10 yards gain Hungry. Those already Hungry must pass Challenging (+0) Cool or eat the closest edible creature or object. |
| 56–60 | Roiling Reflux: for 1d10 Rounds, gain Vomit and test Challenging (+0) Endurance each Turn, losing 1 Wound per failure. |
| 61–65 | Flatulent Eruption: characters within 20 yards must pass Challenging (+0) Endurance or have Nausea for 1d10 hours. |
| 66–70 | Shattered Teeth: lose 1d10 teeth. |
| 71–75 | Trapped Wind: gain three Poisoned Conditions, removed normally. Removing the final one triggers Flatulent Eruption. |
| 76–80 | Displeasure of the Maw: take a 1d10 Damage Body hit. |
| 81–85 | Corpomantic Maelstrom: for 1d10 Turns, test Difficult (−10) Endurance each Turn. Failure causes vomiting; every character within 5 yards must pass Hard (−20) Dodge or suffer a TB +4 Weapon Damage hit and Stunned. |
| 86–90 | Maimed Tongue: lose 1 Wound and cannot speak or cast Gut Magic for 1d10 days. Afterwards, suffer −2 SL to Language and other speech Tests. |
| 91–95 | Gastromantic Ravaging: take a 2d10 Damage Body hit. |
| 96–100 | Jawbreaker: Broken Jaw Critical Wound gives 3 Stunned Conditions, Broken Bone (Major), and Unconscious unless Challenging (+0) Endurance succeeds. |
| 101–115 | Suppurating Ulcers: take a 3d10 Damage Body hit. |
| 116–120 | Thaumaphagic Catastrophe: Butcher dies. Everyone within 10 yards must pass Hard (−20) Dodge or take TB +6 Weapon Damage and Stunned. |

entries.name: Waaagh! Miscast Table
entries.text:
| Roll | Waaagh! Miscast |
| --- | --- |
| 01–10 | Green Haze: musty green fog surrounds the Shaman. |
| 11–15 | Mad Yatterin’: for 1d10 Rounds, cannot communicate verbally, Cast or Channel. |
| 16–20 | Ungodly Racket: Shaman and everyone with Acute Sense (Hearing) within 10 yards gain Deafened. |
| 21–25 | Shroom Spurt: gain Fatigued. A Night Goblin under Shaman Shrooms must pass Challenging (+0) Endurance or turn into a patch of those mushrooms. |
| 26–30 | Fzzzaap!: gain Stunned. |
| 31–35 | Body Shock: lose 2 Wounds, ignoring TB/AP; fail Average (+20) Endurance and also gain Stunned. |
| 36–40 | Squig Magnet: a squig appears at the Shaman’s feet and attacks them (WFRP p. 318 profile). |
| 41–45 | Whoops!: spell targets a random creature within 10 yards, possibly the Shaman. |
| 46–50 | Yuuurgh!: gain Stunned Conditions equal to the last Channelling or Casting Test’s SL, minimum 1. |
| 51–55 | Get Angry!: Shaman loses 3 Wounds ignoring TB/AP. Orcs, Goblins and Hobgoblins within 5 yards must pass Challenging (+0) Endurance or lose 1 Wound ignoring TB/armour and enter Frenzy. |
| 56–60 | Flying Rocks: Shaman takes 1d10 hits at Weapon Damage 2; everyone within 10 yards takes one Weapon Damage 2 hit. |
| 61–65 | Pretty Colours!: gain Blinded for 2 Rounds and 1 Fatigued Condition. |
| 66–70 | I’z Gone on Fire!: gain Ablaze. |
| 71–75 | Gertcha!: lose 1d10 Wounds ignoring TB/armour and gain Prone. |
| 76–80 | Sorcerous Spew: gain 3 Stunned Conditions. |
| 81–85 | Weird Flailing: gain 2 Stunned; everyone within 1d10 yards must pass Challenging (+0) Dodge or take Damage 3 to a random location. |
| 86–90 | Me ’Ead ’Urts!: gain 2 Stunned and take 1d10 Wounds to the head, ignoring TB/armour. |
| 91–95 | I’ve Forgot!: permanently lose one random spell and gain Blinded. |
| 96–100 | I Fink I’m Gonna…: gain Unconscious. Orcs and Goblins within 10 yards gain Stunned. |
| 101–105 | Eye Melta: both eyes are amputated; take 1d10 +3 Wounds to the head. |
| 106–110 | ’EADBANG!: Shaman dies. |
| 111 or more | ’EADBANGERZ!: Shaman dies; Orcs, Hobgoblins and Goblins within 10 yards also die unless they pass Very Hard (−30) Cool. |

songs.name: We’re all in this together so, heave ho, heave ho…
songs.text: Crew members gain +10 to their individual Tests within a Crew Test.

songs.name: Jacques Bret came sailing to meet our steel!
songs.text: Each crew member gains +1 SL on successful Melee Tests.

songs.name: Of all the terrors upon the sea…
songs.text: Crew members gain +1 SL to Cool Tests.

songs.name: You band of shipmates gather round…
songs.text: Crew members gain +1 SL to Fellowship Tests intended to befriend or calm fellow crew.

songs.name: All arise, for the night has eyes…
songs.text: Those trying to stay awake gain +20 to Tests that could make them fall asleep and +10 to Perception Tests.

songs.name: The ladies of L’Anguille…
songs.text: Anyone singing along may ignore one Condition.

songs.name: They do say do as the Captain do say…
songs.text: The Captain or another onboard authority gains +20 to Fellowship Tests targeting the crew.

entries.text: Each purchase teaches a different p. 67 chanty. Perform an Entertain (Singing) Test where the crew can hear you. Establishing it takes 30 seconds; its effect then lasts three minutes plus SL minutes and affects the crew. Dodge is your only combat action while singing; the GM may permit other actions such as Perception or Cool Tests. Damage or any failed Opposed Test ends it. Sing one chanty each watch.
entries.adaptation: User-approved printed Intelligence Bonus limit and effects; old default per-rank Test bonuses omitted. Songs use their printed effects as references only.

entries.name: Master and Commander
entries.text: Appropriate Leadership Tests aboard your ship or involving your crew gain +1 SL per Master and Commander level. Applies to individual Leadership and Crew Tests.
entries.adaptation: User-approved printed Fellowship Bonus limit and explicit per-rank Leadership effect retained. No additional old default Test bonus; situational effect is not automated.

entries.name: Blessings of Bel Shanaar
entries.text: Cast while travelling towards a fixed destination whose location you know. For the duration, your Navigation Tests, including Crew Tests involving you, gain +2 SL.

entries.name: Niezlib’s Optimal Firing Solution
entries.text: Cannon-firing Tests gain +1 SL for the duration.

entries.name: Sea of Glass
entries.text: Ask everyone aboard to be silent, then close your eyes. Apply Doldrums from the Wind Effect Table (p. 107) for the duration.
entries.conversion: Printed WiIlpower spelling normalised to Willpower; no rule change.

entries.name: Living Mire
entries.text: Ensnare a ship at sea in seaweed, giving −2 Movement and −3 SL Manoeuvre. Its crew can cut it free with an Extended Challenging (+0 SL) Boat Handling Test requiring your Willpower Bonus + casting SL.

entries.name: Water Water Everywhere
entries.text: Purify seawater and direct it into the ship’s stores to refill empty water barrels.

entries.name: Whirlpool
entries.text: Create Gentle Rotation in the target area (whirlpools, p. 114). Normal Overcasting can enlarge it. Strength options: 5 SL — Whirlpool; 8 SL — Powerful Vortex; 13 SL — A Maelstrom; 21+ SL — The Maelstrom.

entries.name: Breathe Water
entries.text: The target breathes water and ignores Suffocation from drowning in water (WFRP p. 181) for the duration. You cannot invoke this while your own mouth is underwater.

entries.name: Quell Waters
entries.text: Reduce a strait or whirlpool’s M rating to 0 for the duration.

entries.name: Sea Curse
entries.text: Target a ship crewed by those unworthy of Manann’s respect, including Chaos followers, Stromfels worshippers, Orcs and Goblins, Skaven or a crew with negative Manann’s Mood. For the duration, every hit received by that crew gains +2 Damage.

entries.name: Repel Sea Beast
entries.target: 1 creature with the Aquatic Trait (see Death on the Reik Companion, page 90) or the Marine Creature Trait (see page 140)
entries.text: A sea creature takes no hostile actions for the duration, unless it suffers Damage or harmful Conditions.

entries.name: Rip Tides
entries.text: A visible ship takes −1 M and −1 SL Man.

entries.name: Blessed Voyage
entries.text: Invoke when calculating Manann’s Mood. Improve it by 2d10 minus your current Sin Points.

entries.name: Blessing of the Albatross
entries.text: An albatross arrives and waits up to 1 hour for sailing, then follows the ship for the duration. While it remains, the ship cannot sink regardless of Damage. Killing it gives the ship −d10 Morale and −2d10 Manann’s Mood. If needed, use the pigeon profile (WFRP p. 316), changed to Small Size and 3 Wounds.

entries.name: Blessing of the Mariner
entries.text: The target gains +1 SL on Row, Sail and Swim Tests.

entries.name: Raging Seas
entries.text: Strike a specific target in the sea or on shore with a wave of CR 15.

entries.name: Send ‘em to Stromfels
entries.text: Double the target ship’s Holed Rating (p. 117).

entries.name: Storm Winds
entries.text: Increase wind intensity for one ship by one step for the duration (p. 107), without changing direction.

entries.name: Blood Trail
entries.text: Track an injured person over land or water with Easy (+4 SL) Track, smelling even tiny or partially removed blood traces.
entries.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364).

entries.name: Curse of the Harsh Mistress
entries.text: The target suffers nightmares. Whenever resting to remove Fatigued Conditions, they must pass Difficult (−1 SL) Cool or retain the Fatigued Condition.
entries.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364).

entries.name: Manann’s Mood Made Meaningless
entries.text: For your current ship, roll on the Manann’s Mood table below, adding 1 per Sin Point. 1 to 4: Stromfels Triumphant! Treat Mood as 0 for the duration. 5 to 8: Stromfels Ascends! Roll 5d10, adding it to negative Mood or subtracting it from positive Mood. 9: No effect; calculate Mood normally. 10 or more: Manann Provoked! Subtract 5d10 from Mood (p. 130).

entries.name: Seasickness
entries.text: Give the target Seasickness for the duration, using Sea of Claws p. 125.
entries.conversion: User chose the printed Duration field (Strength Bonus hours) over the description's contradictory one hour; both source statements are documented.

entries.name: Norse Dwarf Bolt
entries.text: Ballista ammunition with Hullbreaker: against wooden structures, adds +2 Damage and gains Damaging. It is not automatically loaded.

entries.name: Bomb (Mortar)
entries.text: Mortar ammunition. The source specifies no unit or bundle quantity.

entries.name: Incendiary (Mortar)
entries.text: Distinct from core Incendiary weapons. Mortar ammunition causing 1 + SL Ablaze Conditions; unit or bundle quantity is unspecified.

entries.name: Lure of the Lurkerfish
entries.text: Hard (−2 SL) Lore (Riverways) identifies the light as a Lurkerfish lure. Failure requires Easy (+4 SL) Cool; fail again and become effectively Unconscious, able only to move towards the light.
entries.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers.

entries.name: Slimy
entries.text: When Grappled, a successful Toughness Test gives the Latch-eel +4 SL on later escape Tests. The opponent must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Athletics or either release it or begin Suffocating.

entries.name: Love the Light
entries.text: Light/fire attracts Daggerfish rather than deterring them. Despite Bestial, they neither shy from fire nor gain Broken from flaming attacks.

entries.name: Immersion
entries.text: Inflicting Entangled through a Grapple pulls the victim inside the Sea Elemental, causing Suffocation. Escape by removing Entangled through Opposed Strength against its Strength 59. The Elemental need not maintain the Grapple, remains free to act and is not Engaged by that victim.

entries.name: Fire Resistant
entries.text: Cannot gain Ablaze.

entries.name: Mindless Spellcaster
entries.text: Use Strength when Casting or Channelling.

entries.name: Boat Crusher
entries.text: Can constrict vessels of Size Large or less. First spend 1 turn wrapping per 10 vessel Size, then Extended Opposed Strength against the vessel's Toughness; SL reaching its Wounds destroys it. Crew may attack or lever it off. A hit inflicting over 7 Wounds forces Average (+2 SL) Cool; failure releases the vessel. Levering uses Opposed Strength: 0–4 SL prevents squeezing that turn; 5+ forces release.
entries.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers.

entries.name: Electrical Discharge
entries.text: At the start of a turn after Grappling, spend 1 Momentum to shock the victim: 10 Damage, ignoring non-magical metal armour. If Wounds are lost, Difficult (−1 SL) Endurance or 1 Stunned. Each discharge also requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance from the Gargantuan; failure gives 1 Fatigued. While Fatigued, its shock deals 6 Damage. Shocking a Grappled boat harms no hull, but every crew member takes 6 Damage, or 3 while the Gargantuan is Fatigued.
entries.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers. Printed Advantage uses Momentum.

entries.name: Whale Bane
entries.text: Fanged Maw attacks use Venom with Difficult (−1 SL) recovery. Causing Wounds applies Poisoned; the Test Difficulty governs recovery rather than avoiding the poison.
entries.adaptation: Uses full Fifth Edition Venom rather than the older on-hit interpretation.

entries.name: Syreen’s Call
entries.text: Spend an Action singing. Anyone within the Syreen's Initiative in yards must pass Difficult (−1 SL) Cool or become effectively Unconscious and able only to move towards it.
entries.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers.

entries.name: Resistant to Cold
entries.text: An Endurance Test may negate the ill effects of cold/ice weapons, spells or other sources.

entries.name: Lure of the Leviathan
entries.text: Hard (−2 SL) Lore (Oceans) recognises the underwater light as a lure and allows looking away. Failure requires Easy (+4 SL) Cool or 1 Stunned.
entries.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers.

entries.name: Devastating Assault
entries.text: Charging a ship causes a collision at CR 50.

entries.name: On a Different Scale
entries.text: Although Bestial, the Black Leviathan fears only flames at least as large/intense as a large bonfire. The GM similarly judges Fear/Terror by whether the source's size warrants its respect; insignificant threats do not concern it.

entries.name: Marine Creature
entries.text: The printed profile assumes water, where full Movement applies. On land, Movement becomes 1 and all Tests suffer −2 SL. Without regular dousing, it begins Suffocating.

entries.name: Bjornling Norse
entries.text: Suggested surnames join a printed Norse parent’s name to core Dwarf sson/dottir endings (Sea of Claws p. 56). Enter nicknames freely.
entries.conversion: Core Human physical attributes, Fate/Fortune and creation limits. Native Norse replaces native Reikspiel; Reikspiel remains a selectable printed Species Skill. Five Species Skills at +5.
entries.adaptation: User-approved Fifth Edition starting Skill allocations and native-language handling replace old +5/+3 allocations.

entries.name: Sarl Norse
entries.text: Suggested surnames join a printed Norse parent’s name to core Dwarf sson/dottir endings (Sea of Claws p. 56). Enter nicknames freely.
entries.conversion: Core Human physical attributes, Fate/Fortune and creation limits. Native Norse replaces native Reikspiel; Reikspiel remains a selectable printed Species Skill. Five Species Skills at +5.
entries.adaptation: User-approved Fifth Edition starting Skill allocations and native-language handling replace old +5/+3 allocations.

entries.text: Fair price: 2d. A snacks-only diet lasts Toughness Bonus days before Starvation Tests are required if proper food remains unavailable.

entries.name: Tavern board: Large Room
entries.text: A larger standard room with 2 additional single beds or an additional double. Brackets show the number of large rooms. Fair price: 14/– per room per night.

entries.name: Tavern board: Fine Room

entries.name: Uproot the Mountains
entries.text: Shake a hill or mountain. At the start of each target’s Round, Very Hard (−3 SL) Athletics is required to avoid Prone and losing all actions and movement. Overcasting: each extra Round of Duration lets you move the terrain Willpower Bonus yards; anyone in its path must pass Average (+2 SL) Athletics or take 10 Damage to a random location. +5 SL can trigger an avalanche, requiring Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge from anyone in its path to avoid 15 Damage to a random location.
entries.adaptation: Printed named Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers; existing High Magic definitions and learning rules are preserved.

entries.name: Earth Line
entries.text: Slann only; requires a geomantic nexus or leyline within Willpower Bonus miles. Send energy along a leyline in your chosen direction to the next nexus. Anyone on it must pass Hard (−2 SL) Endurance or take 15 body Damage, reduced by Toughness Bonus but ignoring Armour. Overcasting: +4 SL creates an undispellable bridge 8 yards wide along the leyline, of any length across water of any depth, lasting Willpower Bonus hours; +6 SL clears an 8-yard-wide path through forest or jungle along the line.
entries.adaptation: Printed named Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers; existing High Magic definitions and learning rules are preserved.

entries.name: Ruination of Cities
entries.text: Slann only; requires a geomantic nexus or leyline within Willpower Bonus miles. Collapse an unfortified building, wall or bridge into Difficult terrain. Occupants must pass Hard (−2 SL) Dodge or take 20 body Damage and become buried, suffering Suffocation (WFRP p. 181). Overcasting extra targets must select those nearest the first. Ground between them opens into a crevasse 2 yards wide and 4 yards deep; Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge avoids falling, while a Marginal Failure permits grabbing the edge. +6 SL permits fortified targets such as castle walls or towers.
entries.adaptation: Printed named Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers; existing High Magic definitions and learning rules are preserved.

entries.name: Mental Blast
entries.text: Slann only; requires a geomantic nexus or leyline within Willpower Bonus miles. Enemies take Intelligence Bonus + 6 Damage, plus 6 if Daemonic or Undead, allowing Toughness Bonus but ignoring Armour. Average (+2 SL) Intelligence is also required to avoid Stunned. Overcasting: +6 SL, The Deliverance of Itza, changes Target diameter to AoE (Half Willpower yards), centred on the caster and expandable normally. +9 SL, The Great Leveller, sacrifices the Slann to kill enough outnumbering enemies in line of sight to equal the Slann’s allies in number, taking lowest Intelligence first. Only spending a Fate Point prevents a Character’s resulting instant death.
entries.adaptation: Printed named Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers; existing High Magic definitions and learning rules are preserved.

entries.name: Waterlungs (Mathlann)

entries.text: Spotting it with Perception suffers −4 SL, or −2 SL while it moves. Ranged attacks against it suffer −2 SL.

entries.name: Flammable
entries.text: Tests to avoid Ablaze suffer the printed −20. Ablaze inflicts twice the Wounds it normally would.

entries.name: Grim (Lustria)
entries.text: At Turn start, raise Advantage to Grim Rating if currently lower. Entangled, Surprised or Unconscious prevents this gain. Under Up in Arms Group Advantage, instead generate Rating Advantage for the Adversary pool.
entries.notes: Printed Fourth Edition rule for reading; current core Grim remains the creator definition.

entries.name: Stationary Attacker
entries.text:
Immune to Psychology. Cannot relocate, pursue, manoeuvre, Charge, Flee, Leap, Run or Climb; only attack/Trait actions are available. An unaware target entering reach becomes Engaged and may be attacked with Surprised. Recognising the danger requires Challenging (+0) Perception to notice it, then suitable Lore to identify it; failing either leaves the threat unrecognised. Reach follows Size:

| Size | Reach |
| --- | --- |
| Tiny or Little | Very Short |
| Small | Short |
| Average | Medium |
| Large | Long |
| Enormous | Very Long |
| Monstrous | Massive |

entries.name: Apotheosis — Lustria version
entries.text: CN: 4 Range: Half Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: 1 Round. The target heals Willpower Bonus Wounds and gains Fear 1 temporarily. Overcasting: each +3 SL heals another Willpower Bonus Wounds; +6 SL heals a Critical Wound. Slann: each +2 SL can increase the target’s Fear rating by 1.
entries.notes: Printed Lustria version for reading, including species-specific Overcasting. Existing High Elf spell definitions remain the creator options.

entries.name: Arcane Unforging — Lustria version
entries.text: CN: 9 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant. Deal 1 Damage to the body per 2 AP worn across all locations, allowing Toughness Bonus but ignoring AP. Challenging (+0) Willpower also destroys one random magic item. Overcasting: each +1 SL can destroy 1 AP of metal or leather armour; +8 SL increases Damage to 1 per AP. Slann: each +5 SL permits another destruction Test against a random magic item.
entries.notes: Printed Lustria version for reading, including species-specific Overcasting. Existing High Elf spell definitions remain the creator options.

entries.name: Drain Magic — Lustria version
entries.text: CN: 6 Range: Half Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus Yards) Duration: Instant. Dispel all persistent spells in the area without an Extended Test. Magic items and innate magical auras are unaffected. Overcasting: +5 SL expands the area to Willpower yards; +7 SL also dispels persistent Divine Blessings and Miracles. Slann: each +4 SL can desaturate one leyline nexus or reduce environmental saturation by one level in the area (Winds of Magic p. 189).
entries.notes: Printed Lustria version for reading, including species-specific Overcasting. Existing High Elf spell definitions remain the creator options.

entries.name: Walk Between Worlds — Lustria version
entries.text: CN: 7 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus Yards) Duration: 1 Round. Selected targets gain Ethereal and double Movement. Overcasting: Slann +4 SL, or High Elves +8 SL, lets targets at a suitable geomantic nexus traverse the Paths of the Old Ones to another nexus you choose, without a distance limit. Wood Elves +6 SL lets targets in a magical forest enter the Worldroots and reach another Weave; they choose paths but may become lost without guidance.
entries.notes: Printed Lustria version for reading, including species-specific Overcasting. Existing High Elf spell definitions remain the creator options.

entries.name: Enchanted Masks
entries.text:
Choose a personality-matched mask or roll d10.

| d10 | Personality; aspect | Example masks | Effects |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1–2 | Angry, warlike, proud; Kharnath | Hound, Bold Man, Enraged Woman, Bull, Spiked Mask | Frenzy and Magic Resistance; cannot cast spells or pray for Blessings/Miracles; +30 WS, +10 I, −20 Fel. |
| 3–4 | Humorous, pessimistic, kindly; Neiglen | Crow, Smiling Man, Starving Woman, Pitted Wood | Hardy; −20 to resist Disease; +20 T, −10 Ag, +5 Fel. |
| 5–6 | Greedy, lustful, friendly; Shornaal | Beautiful Man, Leering Woman, Serpent, Dragonfly | Ambidextrous and Distract; +10 I, +20 Ag, +10 Fel, −15 WP. |
| 7–8 | Cautious, cunning, patient; Tchar | Eagle, Sly Woman, Trickster, Swirling Patterns, Faceless | Scheming and Second Sight; +20 Int, +10 WP; +1 Corruption point on a failed exposure Test. |
| 9–10 | Moody, acquisitive, flexible; Mermedus | Fish, Drowned Man, Carved Scales, Eel, Seaweed-covered Face | Furious Assault and Sea Legs; +50 to Swim Tests; breathe underwater. |

Wearing one for over an hour or using any effect causes Moderate Corruption Exposure. Removing it leaves effects lasting d10 + 4 days; the removed mask loses its magic.
entries.notes: Printed magical rewards for reading only; no price, Encumbrance or automatic mask effects are invented. Older Talent names/bonuses remain source wording.

entries.name: Chokan’s Fate rewards
entries.text:
Offer a shiny object and pray for a 5% chance of a reward, then roll d100.

| d100 | Reward | Later cost |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 01–33 | A pivotal moment: gain 2 Fortune, even above maximum; at next session’s refresh, Fortune returns to Fate as usual. | Next Fortune spent causes 1 Corruption point without a resistance Test. |
| 34–66 | Clear foresight: gain Luck. | Next Fortune spent causes 1 Corruption point; test Cool normally to avoid another. |
| 67–00 | Fate revealed: gain 1 Fate. | Next Fate spent causes 2 Corruption points without a resistance Test. |
entries.notes: Printed Fourth Edition reward/refill rules are references only; Fifth Edition Fate and Fortune are separate. No creator rewards are granted.

entries.name: Dooming — Spite ability
entries.text: Innately gains the equivalent of Blessed (Morr) and the Dooming Miracle, without allegiance to a Human god. Uses Willpower for Dooming, not Invoke.

entries.name: Prospecting Factors
entries.text:
| Prospecting factor | Modifier |
| --- | --- |
| You or a companion pass an initial Challenging (+0) Lore (Geology) Test | +1 SL |
| You or a companion have Second Sight and recognise Chamon | +1 SL |
| You or a companion pass an initial Difficult (−10) Lore (Local) Test | +1 SL |

| Gnistre was recently nearby or beneath the area | +2 SL |

entries.notes: The source prints Challenging (−20) Gossip, an inconsistent label/modifier. This reference preserves that ambiguity; the creator does not resolve or roll prospecting.

entries.name: Size of Strike
entries.text:
| SL | Result |
| --- | --- |
| +6 or more | Motherlode: supports up to twenty miners. |
| +4 to +5 | Rich Vein: supports up to ten miners. |
| +2 to +3 | Lucky Strike: supports up to five miners. |
| +0 to +1 | Hardscrabble: supports up to two miners. |
| −0 to −1 | Nothing; search elsewhere. |
