rows.name: Blessing of Battle
textFields:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Weapon Skill.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of Breath
textFields:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

The target needs no air and ignores Suffocation.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of Charisma
textFields:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Fellowship.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of Conscience
textFields:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Breaking any stricture of your deity requires Average (+2 SL) Cool. Failure prevents that action through shame.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of Courage
textFields:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Willpower.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of Finesse
textFields:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Dexterity.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of Fortune
textFields:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

The target may reroll its next failed Test and must accept the new result.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of Grace
textFields:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Agility.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of Hardiness
textFields:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Toughness.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of Healing
textFields:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Restore 1 Wound to the target.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of The Hunt
textFields:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Ballistic Skill.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of Might
textFields:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Strength.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of Protection
textFields:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Before attacking the target, enemies must pass Average (+2 SL) Cool. Failure forces a different target or Action.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of Recuperation
textFields:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Reduce one disease’s duration by 1 day. Only one attempt is allowed for each instance of disease in each person.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of Righteousness
textFields:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

The target’s weapon becomes Magical.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of Savagery
textFields:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

For the target’s next Critical Wound inflicted, roll twice and use the better result.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of Tenacity
textFields:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Remove one Condition other than Besmirched from the target.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of Wisdom
textFields:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Intelligence.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of Wit
textFields:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Initiative. Cults may use different names and wording for the same Blessing without changing its effect.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Becalm
textFields:
Range: Fellowship Bonus miles Target: 1 sailing vessel within line of sight Duration: 1 hour

Remove a sailing vessel’s wind and surround it with calm water and weather out to Fellowship yards, even in a storm. The calm moves with it if oars or another means propel it.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Drowned Man’s Face
textFields:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

The target gains Fatigued and drowns for the duration (p. 169), including Daemons and Undead. When it ends, gain Stunned for 1 Round while expelling saltwater.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Fair Winds
textFields:
Range: Initiative Bonus miles Target: 1 sailing vessel within line of sight Duration: 1 hour

The vessel travels at top speed regardless of wind, tide or current. Sail Tests to control it gain +1 SL.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Manalt’s Bounty
textFields:
Range: Special Target: Special Duration: Instant

Reach into water to catch fish feeding one person, or two if it is seawater. Each +2 SL feeds another person.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Sea Legs
textFields:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

The target gains one each of Blinded, Deafened and Fatigued. To use its Move, it must Test Average (+2 SL) Athletics; failure also causes Prone.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Waterwalk
textFields:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus minutes

Walk on water as on solid ground, but only on bodies at least 10 yards wide.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Death Mask
textFields:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Gain Fear. Undead remain vulnerable to it despite any Talents, Traits, including Construct, or other effects.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Destroy Undead
textFields:
Range: Yo Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Undead in the area lose 1d10 Wounds plus 1 per SL, ignoring Toughness Bonus and AP. Under normal circumstances, those destroyed can never again be raised through Necromancy.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Dooming
textFields:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

See a vision of the target’s Doom, almost always concerning its death. Each character may receive this Miracle only once; afterwards it may purchase Doomed with XP as a Career Talent.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Last Rites
textFields:
Range: 1 yard Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Send a corpse’s soul to Morr and permanently protect the body from Necromantic spells. A foe with both Construct and Undead is destroyed.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Portal’s Threshold
textFields:
Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Until sunrise

Draw a line up to 8 yards long. Undead need Challenging (+0 SL) Cool to cross; those also having Construct cannot cross at all.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Stay Morr’s Hand
textFields:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus hours

A willing target at 0 Wounds becomes Unconscious and stops deteriorating for the duration, suspending diseases, Critical Wounds, poison and similar effects. Appropriate healing ends the Miracle. You may also end it with last rites taking about a minute, ensuring passage to Morr at death and permanently preventing Necromancy on the corpse.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blazing Sun
textFields:
Range: Special Target: Special Duration: Instant

Non-Myrmidians looking towards you gain 1 Blinded, plus another per +2 SL.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Eagle’s Eye
textFields:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Create an invulnerable spectral eagle that cannot physically affect the world. Control its flight and replace your own sight with its Perception 55, Acute Sense (Sight) and Fly 80. While using its eyes you cannot see through yours.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Fury’s Call
textFields:
Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Allies in the area gain Frenzy (p. 358).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Inspiring
textFields:
Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Allies in the area gain +1 Drilled.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Shield of Myrmidia
textFields:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: Fellowship Bonus Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Allies gain +1 AP at every Hit Location.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Spear of Myrmidia
textFields:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

A spear you wield gains Impact and becomes Magical.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: An Invitation
textFields:
Range: 1 yard Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Undo one fastening on a chosen door, window or hatch, such as a lock, latch or rope. Each +2 SL undoes one additional fastening.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Cat’s Eyes
textFields:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Control an invulnerable cat with normal cat abilities and share all its senses, replacing your own. Your own sense-enhancing Talents, including Night Vision, do not apply, and you cannot perceive through your body.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Cheat the Odds
textFields:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Special

Gain 1 Fortune Point until session’s end, plus another per +2 SL. You cannot invoke again until your Fortune reaches 0.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Ranald’s Grace
textFields:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

The target gains +10 Agility, +10 Stealth and +1 Catfall.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Trickster’s Glamour
aliases: Rich Man, Poor Man, Beggar Man, Thief
textFields:
Range: 1 yard Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus minutes

For each target choose one: its purse appears empty or full; its clothing appears cheap and plain or rich and finely made; or one valuable item cannot be perceived. Each +2 SL adds one further effect to one target.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: You Saw Nothing
textFields:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

The target remains unnoticed unless it attracts attention, for example by touching, attacking, speaking to someone, spellcasting or making loud noise. Invoke only when no one is looking directly at you.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Rhya’s Children
textFields:
Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship yards) Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Only usable outdoors beyond settlements. Touch earth to sense the presence and passage of all living creatures in the area.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Rhya’s Harvest
textFields:
Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: 1 Round

Food plants or fungi suited to the location grow where you touch. Each Round produces enough for one person.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Rhya’s Shelter
textFields:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Special

Only usable outdoors beyond settlements. Find natural shelter against all ordinary wind and rain, lasting as long as you camp there. It holds one person plus another per +2 SL. After breaking camp you cannot find it again.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Rhya’s Succour
textFields:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: Fellowship Bonus Duration: Instant

Each target removes 1 Condition. A target left with no Conditions also gains +1 SL on all Tests during its next Turn and feels fully rested.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Rhya’s Touch
textFields:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Special

Choose to heal Fellowship Bonus Wounds or cure one natural disease. Each +2 SL repeats either effect, including the same one. It takes at least 10 minutes; interruption requires a fresh attempt.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Rhya’s Union
textFields:
Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Fellowship Bonus hours

Consecrate two people’s union. They conceive during the duration if biologically possible.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Anchorite’s Endurance
textFields:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

The target gains Painless, feels no pain and ignores all Condition penalties.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Balm to a Wounded Mind
textFields:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus minutes

Suppress all Psychology Traits for the duration. Afterwards the target sleeps deeply until next sunrise unless disturbed. An unwilling target may resist sleep with Challenging (+0 SL) Cool.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Bitter Catharsis
textFields:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Remove one poison or disease, plus another per +2 SL. You lose 1d10 − Fellowship Bonus Wounds for each removed.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Martyr
textFields:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

You take all Damage dealt to the target instead, adding your Fellowship Bonus to your Toughness Bonus when calculating Wounds from it.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Shallya’s Tears
textFields:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Special

Pray uninterrupted for 10 − Fellowship Bonus Rounds to heal one Critical Wound, plus another per +2 SL. Interruption gives no benefit. Amputated parts cannot be reattached.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Unblemished Innocence
textFields:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Remove 1 Corruption Point gained within the last hour, plus another per +2 SL. A Fumbled invocation gives both you and the target 1d10 Corruption Points in addition to other effects.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Beacon of Righteous Virtue
textFields:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

All allies who see you immediately remove all Broken and gain Fearless (Everything) while the Miracle lasts and you stay in their sight. Orcs and goblins treat you as causing Fear.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Heed Not the Witch
textFields:
Range: You Target: You with AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Casting Tests for spells targeting any creature or place in the area take an additional −2 SL.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Sigmar’s Fiery Hammer
textFields:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

A warhammer you wield becomes Magical, adds Fellowship Bonus Damage, and gives each struck target +1 Ablaze.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Soulfire
textFields:
Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Everyone around you in the area loses 1d10 Wounds ignoring Toughness Bonus and AP. Daemon or Undead targets also gain Ablaze. Each SL may add 1 Wound against orcs, goblins, undead or Ruinous Powers servants.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Twin-tailed Comet
textFields:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards, maximum) Duration: Instant

Choose an outdoor area in sight and Range containing Sigmar’s enemies. Everything there except invalid creatures takes 1d10 + SL Wounds ignoring Toughness Bonus and AP, and gains Ablaze. If Sigmar finds no enemies, he strikes you instead.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Vanquish the Unrighteous
textFields:
Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Chosen allies gain Hatred towards orcs, goblins, undead and Chaos associates (p. 184). After killing such an enemy, Hatred gives +2 SL on combat Tests rather than +1 SL.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Animal Instincts
textFields:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus hours

Gain +1 Acute Sense (Any One). While resting, automatically wake if a threat approaches within Perception yards.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: King of the Wild
textFields:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus minutes

Summon an animal suitable for the area that follows your wishes for the duration. See Beasts of the Reikland, pp. 325–327.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Leaping Stag
textFields:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Gain +1 Movement and +1 Strong Legs. Automatically pass Athletics Tests for Leaping.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Lord of the Hunt
textFields:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus hours

Choose an animal you have seen or an individual you know, subject to the GM. Its trail cannot be lost except through supernatural means, but ends on entering a settlement. Gain +1 SL on all Tests concerning that quarry.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Tanglefoot
textFields:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Everyone in the area gains one Entangled at Strength equal to your Fellowship.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Tooth and Claw
textFields:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Gain Bite (Strength Bonus + 3) and Weapon (Strength Bonus + 4), both with Magical attacks.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Hoarfrost’s Chill
textFields:
Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship yards) Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Gain Fear (p. 183). Everyone else in the area loses Advantage at each Round’s start.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Howl of the Wolf
textFields:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: Special Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Summon a white wolf to fight your enemies until expiry. Use Wolf (p. 327), with WS 45, Willpower 35, Bite +6, Frenzy, Magical and Size (Large).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Pelt of the Winter Wolf
textFields:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus hours

The target ignores mechanical penalties from cold and winter weather, but still feels discomfort and pain.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: The Snow King’s Judgement
textFields:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Deal 1d10 Wounds plus 1 per SL, ignoring Toughness Bonus and AP. If the GM finds the target neither weak, cowardly nor deceitful, you suffer this instead.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Ulric’s Fury
textFields:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

An ally may make a free Frenzy Test on each Turn (p. 184). Replace Frenzy’s free attack with +1d10 Damage on its first melee hit that Turn. A 10 adds another d10 repeatedly until a result below 10.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Winter’s Bite
textFields:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

An axe you wield becomes Magical and adds SL Damage. Struck targets gain Fatigued and lose all Bleeding. Your axe cannot cause Bleeding.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: As Verena Is My Witness
textFields:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

While you speak only truth, everyone listening believes you are truthful, though they may disagree with your conclusions.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blind Justice
textFields:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Pass Challenging (+0 SL) Perception to see through illusion or misdirection Spells and Miracles. Average (+2 SL) Intuition detects whether someone speaking to you is lying, but cannot detect an honestly held mistake.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Shackles of Truth
textFields:
Range: Fellowship Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

A target denying a crime it committed gains an Entangled that cannot be removed during the duration. A false accusation instead makes you roll immediately on Wrath of the Gods.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Sword of Justice
textFields:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

A sword you wield becomes Magical and ignores AP. Struck criminals, as the GM determines, must pass Average (+2 SL) Endurance or gain Unconscious for at least Fellowship Bonus Rounds. Every crime against an unconscious target gives you +1 Sin Point.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Truth Will Out
textFields:
Range: Fellowship Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Ask one question for an immediate complete truthful answer. The target can Oppose your SL with Average (+2 SL) Cool: winning permits silence; +2 SL permits withholding minor detail, +4 SL significant detail, and +6 SL a lie. You know successful resistance occurred, but gain neither specific knowledge of the deceit nor proof.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Wisdom of the Owl
textFields:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Gain +20 Intelligence and +1 Acute Sense (Sight), Menacing and Night Vision. Ask the GM the most likely result of one immediate decision using facts currently available to you.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Animal Friend
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: 1 yard Target: 1 Duration: 1 hour

A Bestial creature smaller than you becomes completely trusting and treats you as a friend.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Bearings
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Instant

Know the direction of north.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Careful Step
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Agility minutes

Organic matter remains unharmed under your steps. Track Tests to follow you through rural terrain suffer -3 SL.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Conserve
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: 1 yard Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus days

Preserve up to a day’s rations against rot, mould and staleness. External damage, including water, fire and poison, still affects them.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Dart
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Fire a magic missile with Damage +0.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Dazzle
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Give the target 1 Blinded Condition immediately and another 1 at the start of every Round for the Spell’s duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Drain
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Touch the target to deal a Damage +0 magic missile that ignores Armour Points, then heal yourself 1 Wound.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Eavesdrop
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: Initiative yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus minutes

Hear the target’s speech as though beside them.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Gust
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant

Create a momentary gust able to extinguish a candle, slam an open door or scatter a few pages.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Light
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower minutes

Produce torch-strength light from your hand, staff or another part of your person. While active, an Average (+2 SL) Willpower Test lets you brighten it to lantern strength or dim it to candle strength.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Magic Flame
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Create a small flame in your palm. It cannot burn you, but gives off heat and ignites flammable material as ordinary fire does.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Marsh Lights
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower minutes

Create up to Intelligence Bonus lights resembling torches or hooded lanterns. While they remain in line of sight, spend an Action and pass Average (+2 SL) Willpower to direct them. They travel at walking pace in a straight line through objects and creatures; another Test is needed to change direction.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Murmured Whisper
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Make your voice sound from any point within Willpower yards, even outside line of sight. Everyone within earshot of that point can hear it.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Open Lock
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Open one non-magical lock by touching it.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Produce Small Animal
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Instant

Produce a small local animal from a bag, pocket, hat, or beneath a rock, bush or burrow. The animal must be a type found nearby; with no suitable local animal, the Spell fails. Its temperament is uncontrolled.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Protection from Rain
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus hours

Keep yourself and your possessions dry in any precipitation, including rain, hail, sleet, snow and similar falling water. Standing water is unaffected.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Purify Water
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: 1 yard Target: Special Duration: Instant

Remove every non-magical impurity, including poison and contaminants, from water in one container, making it drinkable. Liquids made mostly of water, including ale and wine, become pure, non-alcoholic water.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Rot
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: 1 yard Target: Special Duration: Instant

Rot about a fist-sized volume of organic material. Food spoils, fabric disintegrates and leather loses 1 Armour Point at 1 Hit Location; the GM determines similar effects.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Shock
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Give the target 1 Stunned Condition.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Sleep
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Touch a Prone target to make them Unconscious for the duration; loud noise, movement or jostling wakes them immediately. A standing or seated target instead falls Prone and wakes on impact, remaining conscious. A willing, suitably tired target falls into deep, restful sleep.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Sly Hands
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Instant

Teleport an object no larger than your fist from elsewhere on your person into your hand.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Sounds
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Produce quiet, indistinct sounds at a point in range, even outside line of sight. They may suggest footsteps, whispers or animals, but cannot be clear enough to communicate a message. While active, pass Average (+2 SL) Willpower to move the sounds within range or adjust their volume.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Spring
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Touch the ground to produce water at 1 pint per Round, up to Initiative Bonus pints in total.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Twitch
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: Half Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Move a small object slightly, such as tipping it from a shelf or shutting a book. A holder must pass Average (+2 SL) Dexterity or drop it.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Warning
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: 1 yard Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Immediately detect whether the object is poisoned, infected or trapped.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Aethyric Armour
textFields:
CN: 2 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain +1 Armour Point at every Hit Location.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Aethyric Arms
textFields:
CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Conjure a Magical melee weapon chosen from page 301.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Arrow Shield
textFields:
CN: 3 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Destroy missiles containing organic material whenever they enter the area, preventing their damage. Wholly inorganic missiles, including throwing knives and pistol shots, pass through normally.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blast
textFields:
CN: 4 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Deal a Damage +3 magic missile to everyone in the area.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Bolt
textFields:
CN: 4 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Fire a magic missile with Damage +4.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Breath
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: Special Target: Special Duration: Instant

Choose a target within 20 + Willpower Bonus yards and make Challenging (+0 SL) Ballistic Skill. That target and every creature within Initiative Bonus yards of them may oppose with Dodge; anyone who does not beat your result is hit for Willpower Bonus Damage. The casting Lore determines additional effects:
- Acid (Metal): +4 Damage; each weapon and armour item carried by a victim suffers 1 Damage.
- Cold (Beasts, Light, Necromancy): +2 Damage and 1 Fatigued Condition. Until that Condition is removed, the victim’s weapons have Slow.
- Electricity (Heavens): +2 Damage, ignores metal armour, and gives 1 Stunned Condition.
- Fire (Fire, Daemonology, Waaagh!, and Tzeentch Chaos Lores): +5 Damage and 1 Ablaze Condition.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Bridge
textFields:
CN: 4 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Create a magical bridge up to Willpower Bonus yards long and wide. Each +2 SL can add Willpower Bonus yards to either length or width.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Chain Attack
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant

Strike with a Damage +4 magic missile. If it causes more Wounds than the victim’s Toughness Bonus, it jumps to the nearest other target within Willpower Bonus yards of that victim. Reduce Damage by 1 with each jump. Allow up to Willpower Bonus jumps, plus one additional target per +2 SL.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Corrosive Blood
textFields:
CN: 2 Range: You Target: You Duration: Toughness Bonus Rounds or hours

Gain Corrosive Blood (page 357) for Toughness Bonus Rounds. Alternatively, for Toughness Bonus hours, biting small parasites such as fleas and leeches die immediately without transmitting disease. Blood Rot and similar diseases are purged from your body.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Dark Vision
textFields:
CN: 1 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative Bonus Rounds

Gain Dark Vision (page 357) while the Spell lasts.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Distracting
textFields:
CN: 4 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain Distracting (page 358) for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Dome
textFields:
CN: 7 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Everyone in the area gains Ward 6+ (page 363) against Magical or ranged attacks coming from outside the dome. Attacks from inside can pass out normally, and movement is unrestricted.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Drop
textFields:
CN: 1 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Force a creature to release a held object, including a weapon, rope or another person’s hand, unless it passes Challenging (+0 SL) Dexterity. Each +2 SL may impose -1 SL on that Test.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Entangle
textFields:
CN: 3 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Give the target 1 Entangled Condition whose Strength equals your Willpower; its appearance suits your Lore.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Fearsome
textFields:
CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain Fear 1; each +3 SL may raise its value by 1.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Flight
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain Fly (Athletics), allowing flight (page 358).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Magic Shield
textFields:
CN: 4 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Add +Willpower Bonus SL to your dispel attempts for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Move Object
textFields:
CN: 4 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: 1 Round

Move one non-sentient object no larger than 1 + SL yards in any dimension. The moving force has Strength equal to your Willpower and moves it up to Willpower Bonus yards, plus another Willpower Bonus yards per +2 SL. Resolve resistance to its movement with Opposed Willpower/Strength.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Mundane Aura
textFields:
CN: 4 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower minutes

Suppress magical auras on yourself and your possessions. Magical Sense and similar abilities see you as mundane, and no method can detect your magical nature. You have no effective magical ability and cannot cast other Spells. A Channelling Test ends this Spell immediately.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Push
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards, maximum) Duration: Instant

Push every target in the area away by Willpower Bonus yards, inflicting 1d10 Damage that ignores Armour Points and making them Prone. A collision makes another creature of the same or smaller Size Prone without damaging it. Each +2 SL may extend the push by Willpower Bonus yards.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Silence
textFields:
CN: 4 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus minutes

No sound is audible inside the zone or can pass into or out of it. Casting Tests within it become one Difficulty step harder.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Teleport
textFields:
CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Instant

Teleport up to Willpower Bonus + SL yards, crossing gaps, bypassing hazards and ignoring obstacles.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Terrifying
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain Terror 1 (page 362); each +3 SL may increase its value by 1.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Ward
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain Ward 7+ (page 363) for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Amber Talons
textFields:
CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Your unarmed attacks lose Undamaging, gain Magical, deal SB + 4 Damage and cause 1 Bleeding Condition whenever they inflict Wounds. Also gain Scale Sheer Surface (page 125).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Beast Form
textFields:
CN: 5 Range: You Target: You Duration: Toughness minutes

Take the form of any animal in Beasts of the Reikland (pages 325–327), appearing as an ordinary amber-and-brown specimen. Gain its standard Traits except Bestial and Skittish, and replace Movement, Strength, Toughness, Agility and Dexterity with its values; recalculate Wounds. Each +2 SL allows 1 Optional Creature Trait, excluding Size (Enormous). You cannot speak, cast or dispel in this form. On reverting, retain Critical Wounds and lost Wounds, but this carryover cannot lower you below 0 Wounds.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Beast Master
textFields:
CN: 10 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus days

A creature with Bestial and Size (Small, Average or Large) accepts you as pack master, understands and obeys simple commands, and fights to the death to defend you. After the Spell ends, it will not attack you unless compelled, but this protection does not extend to allies.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Beast Tongue
textFields:
CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower minutes

Speak with creatures that have Bestial; they usually listen but need not answer or obey. Gain +2 SL to Animal Training and Charm Animal Tests. You can speak only to beasts, communicate with companions only by gestures, and cannot cast or dispel.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Flock of Doom
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Summon local birds to attack everyone in the area who lacks Arcane Magic (Beasts). Each suffers a Damage 7 hit to the head at each Round’s end and 1 Blinded Condition while inside. Spend an Action and pass Average (+2 SL) Charm Animal to move the flock to another area in range.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Hunter’s Hide
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain +20 Toughness, Acute Sense (Smell) (page 114), Dark Vision and Fear 1 (page 358).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: The Amber Spear
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: Strength yards Target: 1 (maximum) Duration: Instant

Fire a Damage +12 magic missile, ignoring AP from leather, fur, scales and similar armour. Choose its Hit Location; it also causes +1 Bleeding Condition.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Wyssan’s Wildform
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain +1 Movement, +30 Strength and Toughness, and Belligerent, Bite (Strength Bonus + 1), Fear 1, Frenzy, Magical and Striding Gait (Woodland) (pages 356–361). You cannot use Language or Lore Skills for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Caress of Laniph
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: 1 (maximum) Duration: Instant

Touch with your hand, not an enchanted staff, to deliver a Damage +6 magic missile that ignores TB and AP. Every 2 Wounds inflicted permanently lowers the victim’s maximum Wounds by 1 and lets you add 1 SL to your channelling pool.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Dying Words
textFields:
CN: 2 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Touch a body whose owner died within the last day to speak with their soul for the duration. The soul can only talk, need not answer, and cannot lie.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Purple Pall of Shyish
textFields:
CN: 9 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain +WPB Armour Points at every Location and Fear 1 (page 358). Each +2 SL may raise Fear by 1.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Sanctify
textFields:
CN: 10 Range: Touch Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower minutes

Inscribe a circle that creatures with Undead cannot cross in either direction.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Scythe of Shyish
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Create a Magical Halberd in scythe form with Damage SB + WPB + 4. Undead foes gain no Advantage while Engaged with you.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Soul Vortex
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Give everyone in the area +1 Broken Condition. Those with Undead also suffer a Damage +10 magic missile hit that ignores Toughness Bonus and Armour Points.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Steal Life
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Deal a Damage +6 magic missile that ignores Armour Points. Remove all your Fatigued Conditions and heal yourself 1 Wound per 2 Wounds inflicted.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Swift Passing
textFields:
CN: 2 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Instant

Touch one creature with 0 Wounds to kill it. It cannot subsequently be raised as Undead.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Aqshy’s Aegis
textFields:
CN: 5 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Take no damage from non-magical fire and ignore any Ablaze Conditions received. Gain Ward 7+ (page 363) against magical fire attacks, including warpfire and Lore of Fire Spells.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Cauterise
textFields:
CN: 2 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Touch an ally to heal 1 Wound, or 1 + SL Wounds if they have Arcane Magic (Fire), and remove all their Bleeding Conditions. The wounds cannot become infected. A target without Arcane Magic (Fire) must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or scream; an Astounding Failure also gives 1 Stunned Condition and permanent scars.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Crown of Flame
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain +1 War Leader (page 128) and the Fear Trait (page 358). Each +2 SL may add 1 to Fear or another purchase of War Leader. Gain +1 SL to every Channelling and Casting Test using Aqshy.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Firewall
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Special) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Create a wall of fire Willpower Bonus yards long, 1 yard high and 1 yard deep. Crossing it causes 1 Ablaze Condition and a Damage +WPB magic missile hit. Overcasting for extra Area of Effect multiplies its length.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Flaming Hearts
textFields:
CN: 5 Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Allied characters in the area remove every Broken and Fatigued Condition and may make a Frenzy Test (page 184).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Flaming Sword of Rhuin
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 sword (Hand Weapon) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Give a sword Damage SB + 6, Damaging and Magical (page 304). Every hit causes 1 Ablaze Condition. A wielder without Arcane Magic (Fire) gains 1 Ablaze Condition if they Fumble an attack with it.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Great Fires of U’Zhul
textFields:
CN: 10 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 (maximum) + AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

The central target suffers a Damage +10 magic missile hit that ignores AP, 2 Ablaze Conditions and Prone. Everyone else in the area suffers a Damage +5 magic missile hit ignoring AP. Fire then persists for the duration, no longer acting as a magic missile: anyone in the area at a Round’s end suffers WPB + 5 Damage ignoring AP and gains 1 Ablaze Condition.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Purge
textFields:
CN: 10 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Ignite all flammable material in the area and give creatures +SL Ablaze Conditions. Corrupting Influences, including Dhar, warpstone and Chaos-tainted objects, begin burning away. In subsequent Rounds, maintain the Spell with your Action and a Challenging (+0 SL) Channelling (Aqshy) Test. Every 30 minutes, pass Difficult (-1 SL) Endurance or gain 1 Fatigued Condition; failure (-1 SL or worse) also ends the Spell. The GM sets the time to remove corruption: as guidance, warpstone smaller than an acorn or a minor tainted object takes 10 - Willpower Bonus Rounds (minimum 1 Round); a fist-sized piece or more potent tainted object takes twice as long; a powerful Chaos artefact may take hours or longer. See Corrupting Influences, page 187.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Cerulean Shield
textFields:
CN: 7 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain +3 Armour Points at all Locations against metal weapons, including metal-tipped arrows. Anyone striking you with a metal melee weapon takes 6 Damage to the arm used.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Comet of Casandora
textFields:
CN: 16 Range: Initiative yards Target: AoE (2 x Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Special

Choose the impact area. At the end of the following Round, make Very Hard (-3 SL) Ballistic Skill or Average (+2 SL) Lore (Astronomy). Each +SL lets you shift the impact by Willpower Bonus yards; for each -SL, the GM shifts it 1d10 yards in a random direction. Then every target in the area suffers a Damage +18 magic missile hit, 1 Ablaze Condition and Prone.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Coruscating Arc
textFields:
CN: 12 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant

Use Chain Attack (page 243), with Damage +10 and 1 Blinded Condition in addition to its usual effects.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Fate’s Fickle Fingers
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: AoE (Initiative Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

All allies in the area except those with Arcane Magic (Heavens) combine their Fortune Points into one shared pool. Any participant may spend them in the order claimed. When the Spell ends, divide the remaining points as fairly as possible.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Starcrossed
textFields:
CN: 7 Range: Initiative yards Target: 1 Duration: Initiative Bonus Rounds

Spend your Fortune Points to make the target reroll Tests.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: The First Portent of Amul
textFields:
CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative Bonus Rounds

Gain +1 Fortune Point for the duration, plus another +1 per +2 SL.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: The Second Portent of Amul
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative Bonus Rounds

Gain 1 + SL Fortune Points for the duration; each +2 SL may grant an additional +1 Fortune Point.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: The Third Portent of Amul
textFields:
CN: 12 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative Rounds

Gain +1 Fate Point for the duration.

Mystics may gain Arcane Magic (Heavens), but can learn only Fate’s Fickle Fingers, Starcrossed and the First, Second and Third Portents of Amul through that career. Access to other Heavens Spells requires entering an appropriate spellcasting career.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Barkskin
textFields:
CN: 3 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

The target gains +2 Toughness Bonus and suffers -10 Agility and Dexterity.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Earthblood
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Casting requires direct contact with earth, either by touch or bare feet. At the start of every Round, living creatures in the area that directly touch the earth heal WPB Wounds.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Earthpool
textFields:
CN: 7 Range: Willpower yards Target: You Duration: Instant

On casting, sink into the ground and emerge at any point in range at the start of the next Round. A creature directly above your emergence is pushed 1 yard in a random direction and falls Prone. You may pass through water but cannot travel through solid rock.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Fare of the Land
textFields:
CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus days

The target needs no food or drink for the duration. Excretion continues normally, with green waste.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Forest of Thorns
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Target only earth to grow thorny brambles and vines throughout the area. Anyone without Arcane Magic (Life) who crosses on foot must pass Hard (-2 SL) Athletics or gain 1 Bleeding Condition and 1 Entangled Condition with Strength equal to your Willpower. The plants remain after the Spell ends, but lose their magic.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Lie of the Land
textFields:
CN: 5 Range: Initiative Bonus miles Target: You Duration: Special

Touch earth and commune for 1 minute to learn a mental map of natural features in range, including terrain, forests and rivers. Settlements may appear indirectly as cleared ground or trenches. Extending range by Overcasting adds 1 minute of communion per SL.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Lifebloom
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: Special Duration: Instant

Restore a blighted or desolate target. Examples: restart a dry river; cleanse and refill a dry or polluted well; instantly ripen every crop in a planted field, vineyard or orchard; or cure all diseases in a sick or unproductive domestic animal and restore its vigour.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Regenerate
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Give the target Regeneration (page 360).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Banishment
textFields:
CN: 12 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Affect creatures in the area only if their Toughness is below your Willpower. Those with Daemonic or Undead gain Unstable (page 363); if already Unstable, reduce them to 0 Wounds instead.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blinding Light
textFields:
CN: 5 Range: You Target: You Duration: Instant

Everyone looking at you within WPB yards gains 3 Blinded Conditions, except those with Arcane Magic (Light).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Clarity of Thought
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Intelligence minutes

The target ignores penalties affecting mental processes for the duration, including those from Stunned, Mental Mutations and Psychologies.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Daemonbane
textFields:
CN: 10 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Daemon Duration: Instant

If the Daemon’s Toughness is higher than your Intelligence but less than double, halve its maximum Wounds until the encounter ends. If lower, banish it. Everyone looking at a banished Daemon from Willpower yards away gains 3 Blinded Conditions unless they have Arcane Magic (Light).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Healing Light
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Heal the target Intelligence Bonus Wounds and remove poisons and intoxicants. Passing Very Hard (-3 SL) Channelling (Hysh) also removes 1 Corruption Point gained during the past hour.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Net of Amyntok
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: Intelligence Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Intelligence Bonus Rounds

The target loses its Move and gains +1 Stunned Condition that cannot be removed while the Spell lasts. Use Intelligence rather than Endurance when recovering from that Condition. Bestial creatures are immune.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Phâ’s Protection
textFields:
CN: 10 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Creatures with Daemonic, Undead or mutations cannot enter the area. Any already inside gain 1 Broken Condition until they leave. No creature in the area can gain Corruption Points while the Spell lasts.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Speed of Thought
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain +20 Intelligence and Initiative for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Crucible of Chamon
textFields:
CN: 7 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 object Duration: Instant

Melt one non-magical metal object, such as a weapon or armour piece covering one body part; it cools almost at once. Held objects are dropped. If worn, it deals its wearer a Damage +WPB magic missile-like hit that ignores Armour Points. The object is destroyed, but its metal retains its base value and remains usable as a smith’s raw material.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Enchant Weapon
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: 1 yard Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Give one non-magical weapon +WPB Damage, Magical and Unbreakable (pages 304–305) for the duration. Each +3 SL may also add 1 Weapon Quality or remove 1 Weapon Flaw until the Spell ends.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Feather of Lead
textFields:
CN: 5 Range: Willpower yards Target: Area of Effect (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Choose one effect for everyone in the area: count as two steps more Overburdened, or ignore being Overburdened. See Encumbrance, page 299.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Fool’s Gold
textFields:
CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower minutes

Turn all metal in one non-magical metal object into real gold for the duration, then restore the original metal. The change may ruin weapons, make armour unwearably heavy or alter the apparent value of lead coins.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Forge of Chamon
textFields:
CN: 9 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower minutes

Add 1 Item Quality to a metal item or remove 1 Item Flaw. Each +2 SL allows another Quality added or Flaw removed.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Glittering Robe
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Shed candelabra-strength light and gain +2 AP at all Locations. Enemies Engaged with you must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or gain 1 Blinded Condition.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Mutable Metal
textFields:
CN: 5 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Touch a non-magical metal object to warm and soften it enough to bend or distort with bare hands. With GM agreement, make a relevant Average (+2 SL) Art or Trade Test for a more complex alteration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Transmutation of Chamon
textFields:
CN: 12 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Every target in the area suffers a Damage +WPB magic missile that ignores TB and AP, and +1 each of Blinded, Deafened and Stunned lasting for the duration. Affected targets also gain +1 AP and suffer Suffocation (page 169). A target dying during the Spell remains permanently encased in base metal.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Choking Shadows
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

The target gains 1 Fatigued Condition, cannot speak and suffers Suffocation (page 169).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Doppelganger
textFields:
CN: 10 Range: You Target: You Duration: Intelligence Bonus minutes

Assume the appearance of another humanoid you know, subject to GM judgment. Anyone without Second Sight is fooled by the appearance, though incorrect mannerisms may give you away. Second Sight users must beat your Casting Test with Opposed Difficult (-1 SL) Intuition to recognise the disguise.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Illusion
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Intelligence Bonus yards) Duration: Intelligence minutes

Fill the area with an illusory image of your choice. Anyone without Second Sight is automatically fooled. Second Sight users must beat your Casting Test with Opposed Difficult (-1 SL) Intuition to recognise the illusion; success neither ends it nor allows sight through it. The image is normally static. Spend an Action and pass Hard (-2 SL) Channelling (Ulgu) to animate it within its space for that Round.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Mindslip
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: 1 yard Target: 1 Duration: Intelligence minutes

Erase the target’s prior memories of you for the duration. When the Spell ends, you may require Opposed Average (+2 SL) Intelligence against your Casting Test; unless the target wins, the memory loss persists until dispelled.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Mystifying Miasma
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Everyone in the mist without Arcane Magic (Shadows) gains 1 each of Blinded, Deafened and Fatigued for the duration. When affected creatures try to use their Move, they must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Perception or fall Prone.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Shadowsteed
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Until the next dawn

Summon a riding horse (page 327). Outside sunlight it gains Dark Vision, Ethereal, Fear 1, Magical, Painless and Ward 9+ (page 356), and remains rideable while insubstantial. Riding it grants +2 SL to Ride Tests for riders with Arcane Magic (Shadow), or -2 SL without that Talent. It needs neither rest nor sustenance. At dawn’s first light it dissolves; if ridden when the Spell ends, its rider falls and takes falling damage (page 169).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Shadowstep
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: You Duration: Instant

Instantly relocate up to Willpower yards away. Enemies Engaging you at departure gain Surprised.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Shroud of Invisibility
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Make the target invisible and imperceptible to mundane senses, automatically fooling anyone without Second Sight. Second Sight users must beat the Casting Test with Opposed Perception to detect someone nearby, without learning an exact position. The target remains perceptible to other senses. The Spell ends when the target attracts attention by loud noise or an attack.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Goodwill
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus minutes

Grant +1 SL to every Fellowship Test in the area and suppress the effects of Animosity and Hatred.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Halétha’s Joy
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus hours

If biologically possible, the target conceives a child while the Spell lasts. The Spell ends once used.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Mirkride
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus minutes

Your spirit enters the Hedge with Ethereal (page 358), observing the material world invisibly and silently but unable to affect it. Your body stays immobile and insensate. Any Magical damage you take ends the Spell instead. You and spirits, other Ethereal beings and Daemons can see and interact with each other, including when invisible. When the Spell ends, your spirit returns to your body. If the body is killed while you are in the Hedge, your spirit wanders forever.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Nepenthe
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus hours

Create a silver liquid in a cup. Anyone drinking it within the duration may permanently erase all memory of one individual.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Nostrum
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Dexterity Bonus hours

Enchant a prepared draught. Drinking it while the Spell lasts immediately heals Dexterity Bonus Wounds and cures one disease chosen by the GM. Each +2 SL may cure an additional disease.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Part the Branches
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative minutes

See every invisible creature for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Protective Charm
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus days

Enchant a small piece of jewellery or pocket-sized trinket. Its bearer gains +2 SL to resist magical effects and Corruption.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Shepherd’s Eye
textFields:
CN: 0 Range: Special Target: Special Duration: Instant

Place organic material from one creature, such as wool, blood or droppings, in a bowl of water. Scry for 10 - IB minutes; the GM describes that creature’s location through symbols. If the location is familiar, you know where the creature is.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blight
textFields:
CN: 14 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: Special Duration: Instant

Blight a target, with these examples: all food and drink in a tavern spoil immediately; a well becomes brackish and stagnant; planted crops in a field rot overnight; or a domestic animal sickens, produces nothing useful, develops an unusable coat or hide, and dies in 10 - SL days.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Creeping Menace
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Each affected target is immediately Engaged by a swarm of your choice of Giant Rats, Giant Spiders or Snakes; use that creature’s standard profile with Swarm added. Spend an Action and pass Challenging (+0 SL) Charm Animal to send one or more swarms against another target. Remaining swarms disappear when the Spell ends.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Curse of Crippling Pain
textFields:
CN: 10 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Stab a doll or puppet representing the target and choose a Hit Location:
- Body: +1 Fatigued; pass Hard (-2 SL) Endurance or fall Prone.
- Head: 1 Stunned; pass Average (+2 SL) Endurance or gain -SL additional Stunned.
- Limb: rendered useless as though amputated (page 177).
Fatigued and Stunned persist for the duration. Spend an Action and pass Average (+2 SL) Channelling to stab another, previously unaffected Location.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Curse of Ill Fortune
textFields:
CN: 8 Target: 1 Range: Willpower yards or Willpower Bonus miles (with ingredient) Duration: Willpower Bonus minutes or days (with ingredient)

Cause minor inconveniences such as broken laces or chairs, impose -1 SL on every Test, and prevent the target spending Fortune. If they have no Fortune, they must reroll every Test roll of 01–05. Using something belonging to the target, such as a possession or hair, as the ingredient removes the line-of-sight requirement and enables the ingredient-based range and duration above.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Glamour
textFields:
CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 adult Duration: Willpower Bonus hours

Make an adult target appear any age within the normal adult range.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Haunting Horror
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Willpower days

Haunt one location, such as a house or clearing. Entrants other than witches and their familiars gain +1 Fatigued Condition. Then, unless Challenging (+0 SL) Psychology is passed, gain another Fatigued Condition and 1 Broken Condition; these latter two can only be removed by leaving the location.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Make Hale
textFields:
CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Heal the target WPB Wounds and remove 1 Fatigued and 1 Stunned. With +3 SL, you may use a Range of Willpower Bonus yards instead.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: The Evil Eye
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: 10 yards (maximum) Target: 1 (maximum) Duration: Instant

Make eye contact and resolve Opposed Intimidate/Cool, adding your Casting Test SL to your result. Winning gives the target Fear 1 of you and 1 Fatigued, plus another 1 Fatigued per +3 SL of victory. Winning by 6+ SL also gives 1 Broken.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Destroy Lesser Daemon
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Size (Average) or smaller Daemon Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

The Daemon opposes your Casting Test with Easy (+4 SL) Endurance. If you win, destroy it immediately and optionally increase one of your Characteristics by +10 for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Detect Daemon
textFields:
CN: 4 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant

Automatically detect whether a manifested Daemon is in range, including one summoned, bound into an artefact or possessing someone.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Manifest Lesser Daemon
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Manifest a Lesser Daemon, such as a Bloodletter or Daemonette (page 349), and resolve Opposed Channelling (Dhar)/Cool against it. On success it obeys one command literally, then vanishes if it completes the command before the duration ends. On failure it attacks immediately.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Octagram
textFields:
CN: 10 Range: Touch Target: AoE (Intelligence Bonus yards across, maximum) Duration: Willpower minutes

Draw an octagram on the floor with unholy symbols. Creatures with Daemonic cannot enter or leave it.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Raise Dead
textFields:
CN: 7 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Until sunrise

Raise 1 + SL Skeletons (page 339) from bare earth at the Round’s end, placing them as you wish within the area. Each starts Prone, is fully controlled by you and follows simple orders. Each +2 SL may add 1 Skeleton. Your death or becoming Unconscious ends the Spell and collapses them.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Reanimate
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Until sunrise

Reanimate WPB + SL corpses as Zombies (page 340), or skeletons as Skeletons (page 339), within range. They begin Prone, are fully controlled by you and obey simple orders. Each +2 SL may reanimate an additional WPB + SL Skeletons or Zombies. If you die or become Unconscious, the Spell ends and they fall dead again.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Screaming Skull
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant

Send a skull in a straight line for the full Spell range, following ground contours and passing through obstacles. It deals a Damage +WPB magic missile to targets without Undead. Anyone losing Wounds must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Psychology or gain 1 Broken Condition.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Vanhel’s Call
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant

Give Intelligence Bonus targets with Undead an immediate free Move or Action when cast; choose the same option for all. Each +2 SL may affect another Intelligence Bonus targets.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Festering Inflammation
textFields:
CN: 5 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Turn one of the target’s Wounds into a Festering Wound.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Miasma of Pestilence
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Living creatures in the area must pass Hard (-2 SL) Endurance or suffer Nausea (page 182). Nurgle’s devotees and skaven plague monks are exempt.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Stream of Corruption
textFields:
CN: 9 Range: Special Target: Special Duration: Instant

Immediately make an Unopposed Acid- and Poison-type Breath attack (page 357), treated as a magic missile with Damage equal to your Toughness Bonus that ignores Armour Points. A victim losing more Wounds than its own TB must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or contract Blood Rot (page 179).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Acquiescence
textFields:
CN: 5 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

At each Round’s start, the target must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or lose both its Move and Action.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: From Pain, Pleasure
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Give the target Painless (page 360) for the duration. Whenever it suffers a Critical Wound, it must pass Average (+2 SL) Endurance or drop its weapons and stand Helpless.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Phantasmagoria
textFields:
CN: 8 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Grant yourself and all allies in the area Distracting (page 358) for the duration. Affected targets do not distract each other.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Boon of Tzeentch
textFields:
CN: 9 Range: You Target: You Duration: Intelligence Bonus days

Choose one Spell from any Lore; cast it as memorised for the duration, but do not write it in a grimoire. To channel for it, use Channelling (Dhar) or its appropriate Channelling Skill if you possess that Skill. A Miscast while casting the borrowed Spell removes Boon of Tzeentch from your mind and also from your grimoire if recorded there.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Transformation of Tzeentch
textFields:
CN: 12 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

The target becomes Prone and Helpless for the duration. At each Round’s end it must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or gain 1 Corruption Point.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Treason of Tzeentch
textFields:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Initiative Bonus yards) Duration: Intelligence Bonus Rounds

Give targets Animosity (Allies). Unless immune to that Psychology, they cannot transfer Advantage to allies; if they score a Critical while attacking, they must pass Hard (-2 SL) Cool or target their nearest ally.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Dagger
textFields: Basic Very Short  SB+2        Melee weapons          16/– Common

rows.name: Knife
textFields: Basic Very Short  SB+1   Undamaging               8/– Common Melee weapons          8/– Common

rows.name: Hand Weapon
