rows.name: Ablaze
textFields: At Round end, take 1d10 Damage plus 1 per additional Ablaze, reduced by TB and the AP of the least protected location. Reaching 0 Wounds causes a Body Critical Wound. Normally affects flammable creatures, although some magical/divine effects bypass this restriction. A successful Athletics Test removes 1 Ablaze plus 1 per SL beyond the first; the GM sets Difficulty for the circumstances.

rows.name: Besmirched
textFields: While thoroughly fouled, suffer Disadvantage on every Fellowship Test until cleaned. This Condition does not stack.

rows.name: Bleeding
textFields: At Round end, lose 1 Wound per Bleeding, ignoring TB/AP. At 0 Wounds, replace this loss with a Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance Test each Round end; failure causes Unconscious. If Unconscious, Bleeding and at 0 Wounds, also roll 1d10 each Round end: a result no higher than your Bleeding count kills you; 10 removes 1 Bleeding. You cannot awaken while any remain. Each recovered Wound removes 1 Bleeding. Challenging (+0 SL) Heal removes Intelligence Bonus + SL Bleeding. A Bandage removes 1 without a Test, costing an Action or accompanying a Heal Test even if that Test fails.

rows.name: Blinded
textFields: Cannot perform tasks requiring sight, including reading and Ranged Attacks. Melee Attacks and other strongly sight-dependent Tests, such as Climb/Ride, have Disadvantage. Melee attackers gain Advantage unless also Blinded. Normally remove 1 Blinded at your Turn's end; poison/injury causes may last longer.

rows.name: Broken
textFields: Use Move and Action to Flee until hidden from all enemies, then your Action may improve concealment. Tests unrelated to running/hiding suffer −1 SL. While Engaged, cannot rally. Otherwise, a successful Cool Test at Round end removes 1 Broken plus 1 per SL beyond the first. Spending a full Round hidden from every enemy also removes 1 Broken.

rows.name: Deafened
textFields: Cannot hear or understand speech unless Lip Reading is usable. Every minute (6 Rounds), attempt Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance; success removes 1 Deafened plus 1 per SL beyond the first.

rows.name: Entangled
textFields:
Cannot Move; movement-related actions, including Grappling, suffer −1 SL. Spend an Action on Opposed Strength against the restraint: winning removes 1 Entangled plus 1 per SL beyond the first. For restraints without Strength, use the material value below.

| Material | Strength |
| --- | --- |
| Wool | 10 |
| Twine | 25 |
| Rope | 45 |
| Manacles | 65 |
| Heavy Iron Chain | 105 |

rows.name: Fatigued
textFields: All Tests suffer −1 SL. Rest, a Prayer or a Spell can remove Fatigued. Rest depends on the cause: hard labour, forced marches or poison normally require a night's sleep; strenuous fighting, Frenzy or Stunned may need only minutes. Fatigued from Overburdened, disease, exposure or another ongoing effect ends when its cause ends.

rows.name: Poisoned
textFields: Suffer −1 SL to all Tests and lose 1 Wound at Round end, ignoring TB/AP. At 0 Wounds, healing is impossible until all Poisoned are removed. If Unconscious, Test Endurance every TB Rounds or die. At each Round's end, successful Endurance removes 1 Poisoned plus 1 per SL beyond the first. Successful Heal by you or another removes the same amount. Endurance is normally Challenging (+0 SL), but the poison/venom sets the applicable Endurance/Heal Difficulty. Removing the last Poisoned gives 1 Fatigued.

rows.name: Prone
textFields: Your Move may only stand you up or crawl at half normal Walking pace in yards. Movement-related Tests have Disadvantage; melee attackers gain Advantage. Does not stack; standing removes Prone.

rows.name: Stunned
textFields: Movement is halved and all Tests suffer −1 SL. At Round end, successful Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance removes 1 Stunned plus 1 per SL beyond the first. Removing the last gives 1 Fatigued if none is already present. More Stunned than TB makes you Unconscious.

rows.name: Surprised
textFields: No Action or Move; cannot defend Opposed Tests. Melee attackers gain +2 SL. Does not stack. Ends at Round end or after the first attempt to attack you.

rows.name: Unconscious
textFields: You are Helpless, unaware and unable to act. Does not stack; becoming Unconscious removes all Stunned. Ordinary sleep usually ends after a few hours and may be interrupted. If another Condition/circumstance caused it, awaken when that cause ends. Spending Fortune to remove Unconscious without fixing its cause makes you Unconscious again at Round end.

rows.name: Durable
textFields: Withstand Damage equal to the Durable rating before suffering item-damage penalties. Against instant breakage, save on 1d10 of 9+; each further purchase improves the save by 1 (Durable 3 saves on 7+). Repeat purchases are allowed.

rows.name: Fine
textFields: An indicator of craftsmanship and social standing. Repeat purchases increase how impressive the item appears.

rows.name: Practical
textFields: A failed Test using the item gains +1 SL. On armour, reduce each wearing penalty by one level, such as −3 SL becoming −2 SL.

rows.name: Bulky
textFields: Add 1 Encumbrance. Bulky armour/clothing still has Enc 1 when worn. This Flaw normally cannot apply to small trinkets.

rows.name: Shoddy
textFields: Breaks on a failed Test using the item when the roll is a double. Shoddy armour breaks when a protected location sustains any Critical Hit.

rows.name: Ugly
textFields: Draws unfavourable attention; relevant Fellowship Tests may suffer −1 SL.

rows.name: Unreliable
textFields: A failed Test using the item suffers −1 SL. Double the wearing penalties of Unreliable armour.

rows.name: Blackpowder
textFields: Anyone targeted must pass the printed Average (+20) Psychology Test or gain 1 Broken, even when the shot misses.

rows.name: Blast (Rating)
textFields: Affects everyone in a Rating-yard diameter and normally cannot be Opposed. Inflicts Weapon Damage and its Conditions, without SL Damage. Damaging still permits Damage from the units die.

rows.name: Damaging
textFields: On a successful hit, use the higher of SL or the units die for the attack's Damage contribution. Undamaging overrides Damaging if both would apply.

rows.name: Defensive
textFields: Gain +1 SL to Melee Tests opposing incoming attacks. Benefit from only one Defensive Quality at a time. Unbalanced overrides Defensive.

rows.name: Fast
textFields: Add 20 to combat initiative only when attacking with this weapon. Using it for two-weapon fighting removes Fast.

rows.name: Hack
textFields: On a hit, damage a struck armour piece or shield by 1 before resolving Damage against the wearer.

rows.name: Impale
textFields: Successful combat attack rolls that are doubles or divisible by 10 cause a Critical Hit. A ranged Impale Critical leaves its ammunition embedded: arrows/bolts need successful Challenging (+0 SL) Heal to remove; bullets require a surgeon (Surgery Talent). Each unremoved arrow or bullet prevents recovery of 1 Wound.

rows.name: Inflict (Condition)
textFields: A hit applies the named Condition, using any listed Strength/Difficulty. While Entangling someone, the weapon cannot be used otherwise; you may release them whenever you choose.

rows.name: Magical
textFields: Can harm targets immune to non-magical attacks.

rows.name: Parry
textFields: Defending with this weapon ignores the usual −2 SL off-hand penalty. When dual wielding, if the first attack hits, a second attack made with the Parry weapon is Unopposed.

rows.name: Dangerous
textFields: A failed Test containing a 9 on either die causes a Fumble.

rows.name: Imprecise
textFields: Attacks with the weapon suffer −1 SL.

rows.name: Pistol
textFields: May attack in melee without range modifiers; the attack can be Opposed like a melee attack.

rows.name: Precise
textFields: Successful attacks gain +1 SL. Imprecise overrides Precise if both would apply.

rows.name: Pummel
textFields: A Head hit that deals Wounds equal to the target's TB gives it 1 Stunned.

rows.name: Reload (Rating)
textFields: After firing, spend Rating Actions reloading before firing again. A Repeater with shots remaining needs 1 fewer reload Action.

rows.name: Repeater (Rating)
textFields: Holds Rating shots and reloads automatically between shots. Once empty, complete the weapon's normal full reload.

rows.name: Trap Blade
textFields: When defending against a bladed weapon, a Critical may trap the blade instead of causing a Critical Hit; you must be at least the opponent's Size. The opponent drops the trapped blade. With Disarm, spend the printed Advantage to catch it in a free hand. Optionally Test Very Hard (−30) Strength, adding your Melee Test's SL: success breaks the blade unless Unbreakable.

rows.name: Unbalanced
textFields: Defending with this weapon suffers −1 SL.

rows.name: Unbreakable
textFields: Under nearly all circumstances, resists breaking, corrosion and loss of its edge.

rows.name: Undamaging
textFields: Double AP against the weapon. Successful combat hits have no automatic minimum 1 Wound. For any Critical Wound it causes, roll twice and use the lower result.

rows.name: Wrap
textFields: Melee Tests opposing its attacks suffer −1 SL.

rows.name: Flexible
textFields: May be layered under non-Flexible armour; both layers provide their benefits.

rows.name: Impenetrable
textFields: Disregard Critical Hits generated by an odd to-hit roll, such as 11 or 33.

rows.name: Partial
textFields: An even Hit Location roll bypasses this armour's AP.

rows.name: Shield
textFields: When opposing with Dodge or Melee, gain +1 SL (not cumulative with Defensive) and apply shield AP if hit. A shield with at least 2 AP permits Dodge against ranged attacks at any range. Only one shield provides benefits. A strapped/slung shield protects Head, Body and off Arm only, while allowing a two-handed polearm; a buckler allows an Enc 0 weapon in the off hand. Attacking with a shield uses Improvised Weapon rules, Personal Reach and Defensive; it then stops providing shield benefits until your next turn begins.

rows.name: Weakpoints
textFields: An Impale weapon's Critical Hit bypasses this armour's AP.

rows.name: Animosity (Target)
textFields: Fellowship-based Tests with the target group have Disadvantage. On meeting them, pass Psychology or insult, denigrate or attack; after doing so, you can temporarily tolerate their presence. Fear/Terror takes precedence: you need not confront a target you fear.

rows.name: Fear (Rating)
textFields: Against unfamiliar hostile Fear sources, make one Extended Psychology roll each Round, targeting accumulated SL equal to the highest Fear Rating present. Success overcomes every source of that Rating or lower. Known allies do not trigger the Test. While affected, gain no Momentum; the feared source's Melee Attacks against you have Advantage.

rows.name: Frenzy
textFields: On your Turn, a successful Willpower Test enters Frenzy. Gain immunity to other Psychology, one extra Melee Attack as a Free Action each Round, and +1 Damage to all Melee Attacks. Move/Action may only advance the goal of reaching and attacking the nearest foe. Frenzy ends when nearby foes are bested, or you become Stunned/Unconscious; immediately gain 1 Fatigued.

rows.name: Hatred (Target)
textFields: Social interaction with the target group is impossible. On meeting them, pass Psychology or attempt their destruction by the quickest, deadliest means. Slaying/driving them off restores control; otherwise, another Psychology Test may restrain you at each Round's end after the first. Whether controlled or not, gain +1 SL to Melee/Ranged against them and ignore their Intimidate/Fear, but not Terror.

rows.name: Terror (Rating)
textFields: First encountering a non-allied Terror source requires Psychology, using the highest Rating present. Success prevents further Terror effects that encounter. Failure gives Broken equal to Rating plus 1 per negative SL beyond the first. After resolving the Test, the source also causes Fear at the same Rating.

rows.name: Afraid
textFields: Make an Extended Psychology Test against the target’s Fear. Until accumulated SL equal or exceed its rating, gain no Momentum; its melee attacks against you have Advantage (p. 183).

rows.name: Amphibious
textFields: Has Swim; +1 SL to Swim Tests. Full Movement in water.

rows.name: Animosity
textFields: On encountering the listed target, make a Psychology Test. Failure: attack socially or physically as appropriate; +1 SL to Fellowship-based Tests to oppose or disparage them (p. 183).

rows.name: Belligerent
textFields: Immune to Fear while possessing Momentum.

rows.name: Bestial
textFields: No rational thought/language; defends only with Dodge. Shies from fire; fire Wounds inflict Broken. Flees after losing over half Wounds; enters Frenzy instead if cornered, protecting young or Territorial.

rows.name: Bite
textFields: Lose Momentum for a Free Attack at Rating Damage (SB already included); uses WS/BS without spending the turn’s Action.

rows.name: Blessed
textFields: Can enact the listed deity’s Blessings; Pray at Fellowship +10 (GM may increase).

rows.name: Bounce
textFields: When Charging, Leaping or Sprinting, double Movement and leap over intervening terrain and creatures.

rows.name: Breath
textFields: Magical ranged Free Attack: choose a visible creature within 20 + TB yards; it and every creature within SB yards of it oppose a single Ballistic Skill roll with their own Dodge Tests. Use BS 30 if the attacker has no BS. Losing targets suffer Rating Damage. Apply any listed Breath type: Acid — TB +4 Damage, and all weapons and armour carried by targets take 1 Damage. Cold — SB +2 Damage and a Fatigued Condition; affected weapons have Slow until that Condition ends. Electricity — SB +2 Damage, ignoring metal armour, and a Stunned Condition. Fire — SB +3 Damage and an Ablaze Condition. Poison — TB +2 Damage and a Poisoned Condition. Smoke — fills the area, blocks line of sight and causes Suffocation (p. 169) for TB Rounds. The attacker is immune to its own Breath.

rows.name: Champion
textFields: Winning an Opposed Test while defending in melee deals Damage as if attacking.

rows.name: Chill Grasp
textFields: Lose Momentum and use an Action: Opposed WS against Dodge or Melee. Win: target loses 1d10 + SL Wounds, ignoring TB and AP. Magical.

rows.name: Cold-blooded
textFields: Advantage on Cool Tests. Surprised is not removed the first time it normally would be.

rows.name: Constrictor
textFields: Every successful hit inflicts Entangled; may then initiate a Grapple (p. 167).

rows.name: Construct
textFields: No Int, WP or Fel; never Tests them, except use T for required WP Tests. Use SB instead of WPB for Wounds. All attacks Magical. Without a controlling spellcaster, or without Territorial, wanders mindlessly.

rows.name: Corrosive Blood
textFields: Whenever wounded, all Engaged targets take 1d10 Damage (one roll for all).

rows.name: Corruption
textFields: A Corrupting Influence of the listed strength (p. 187).

rows.name: Daemonic
textFields: No food, water or air; all attacks Magical. Non-Magical blow: 1d10, Rating+ ignores it and any Critical. Cannot ignore Magical blows this way. At 0 Wounds, returns to Chaos and leaves play.

rows.name: Dark Vision
textFields: Sees in darkness as in daylight.

rows.name: Disease
textFields: Carries the listed disease; others Test for Contraction as appropriate (p. 179). Whether the carrier suffers its effects is the GM’s choice.

rows.name: Distracting
textFields: Living targets within TB yards suffer −2 SL to all Tests. Does not stack with other Distracting creatures.

rows.name: Ethereal
textFields: Passes through solid objects. Only Magical attacks can harm it; all its attacks are Magical.

rows.name: Fear
textFields: Extended Psychology Test. Until accumulated SL exceed Rating (default 1): no Momentum; attackers gain Advantage in melee (p. 183).

rows.name: Fly
textFields: As its Move, fly up to Rating yards, ignoring intervening terrain, obstacles and creatures; may Charge. End landed or airborne; if starting a turn airborne, must Fly or fall (GM decides distance). Against it, measure horizontal range then increase one range step (Extreme becomes unreachable). While flying, −20 to its Ranged Attacks.

rows.name: Frenzy
textFields: WP Test to enter: Free Attack each Round, +1 Damage, immune to Psychology. Only attack or move to attack nearest visible enemy; no fleeing/retreat. Ends with no visible enemies or if Stunned or Unconscious; then Fatigued.

rows.name: Ghostly Howl
textFields: Once per turn, lose Momentum for a Magical Free Attack. Living hearers within Strength yards gain 3 Deafened and lose 1d10 Wounds ignoring TB/AP; Average (+2 SL) Cool or also Broken.

rows.name: Grim
textFields: At the end of its turn, gains Momentum if it has none.

rows.name: Hatred
textFields: On meeting target: Psychology Test; failure activates Hatred. Attack by fastest, deadliest means; +1 SL Melee/Ranged against them. Immune to their Intimidate/Fear, not Terror (p. 184).

rows.name: Horns
textFields: When Charging into combat, may make a Free Attack at SB +4 Damage.

rows.name: Hungry
textFields: After killing/incapacitating living prey or finding a fresh corpse: Average (+2 SL) Cool or feast; lose next Move and Action.

rows.name: Immunity
textFields: Ignores all harm of the listed type, including Critical Wounds.

rows.name: Infected
textFields: On causing a living opponent to lose Wounds: Easy (+4 SL) Endurance or contract a Festering Wound (p. 180).

rows.name: Infestation
textFields: Opponents suffer −1 SL to hit it in melee.

rows.name: Magic Resistance
textFields: Casting Tests for spells affecting it suffer −3 SL. Incompatible with Channelling or Arcane Magic, Bless, Chaos Magic, Invoke, Petty Magic and Witch! Talents (in either direction).

rows.name: Magical
textFields: All attacks are Magical and can harm creatures vulnerable only to Magical attacks.

rows.name: Many Heads
textFields: Head Criticals stun, kill or render unconscious only when all heads are disabled or similarly affected. With Bite, Horns or Tongue, make as many Free Attacks as healthy heads. With 2+ healthy heads, +2 SL to Perception.

rows.name: Mark of Chaos
textFields: Khorne: Frenzy; Etiquette (Followers of Khorne). Animosity towards overt Slaanesh followers (reciprocal while Mark visible). Language (Magick)/Channelling: dispelling only. Career Talents at normal XP: Berserk Charge, Combat Aware, Combat Reflexes, Furious Assault, Implacable, Magic Resistance, Resistance (Magic), Resolute, Strike Mighty Blow, Warrior Born. Nurgle: +10 Toughness; Etiquette (Followers of Nurgle). Animosity towards overt Tzeentch followers; they reciprocate while the Mark is visible. Career purchases at normal XP: Frightening, Hardy, Implacable, Iron Jaw, Menacing, Resistance (Poison), Resistance (Disease), Robust, Tenacious, Very Resilient. Slaanesh: Fearless (Everything); Etiquette (Followers of Slaanesh). Animosity towards overt Khorne followers; they reciprocate while the Mark is visible. Career purchases at normal XP: Attractive, Blather, Careful Strike, Combat Master, Gregarious, Inspiring, Lightning Reflexes, Nimblefingered, Resistant (Poison), Sharp. Tzeentch: Roll 1d10/3 Mutations, rounding up, alternating Mental and Physical. Etiquette (Followers of Tzeentch). Animosity towards overt Nurgle followers; they reciprocate while the Mark is visible. Career purchases at normal XP: Aethyric Attunement, Arcane Magic (Any), Chaos Magic (Tzeentch), Fast Hands, Instinctive Diction, Magical Sense, Petty Magic, Second Sight, War Wizard, Witch!.

rows.name: Mental Corruption
textFields: Roll on the Mental Corruption table (p. 189).

rows.name: Miracles
textFields: Can enact the listed deity’s Miracles; Pray at Fellowship +10 (GM may increase).

rows.name: Mutation
textFields: Roll on the Physical Corruption table (p. 189).

rows.name: Night Vision
textFields: See clearly in natural darkness for 20 yards; extend the illumination distance of light sources by 20 yards.

rows.name: Painless
textFields: Ignores non-amputation Critical Wound penalties; Conditions still apply.

rows.name: Petrifying Gaze
textFields: Lose Momentum and an Action against one visible living target: Opposed BS/Initiative (spellcasters may defend with Language (Magick)). Win: 1 Stunned, +1 per SL after the first. Win by 6+ SL: permanently turn target to stone.

rows.name: Regeneration
textFields: Round start: above 0 Wounds, heal 1d10; at 0, heal 1 on 1d10 of 8+. A roll of 10 fully heals one Critical and its penalties/Conditions. Cannot regenerate fire-caused Wounds/Criticals.

rows.name: Size
textFields: Size determines Wounds, primary melee Damage and combat interactions. Small: Wounds 2 × TB; no added Damage; counts as 1 when outnumbered. Average: Wounds SB + 2 × TB + WPB; no added Damage; counts as 1. Large: Wounds (SB + 2 × TB + WPB) ×2; add SB Damage; counts as 2. Enormous: Wounds (SB + 2 × TB + WPB) ×4; add SB Damage; counts as 3. Monstrous: Wounds (SB + 2 × TB + WPB) ×8; add 2 × SB Damage; counts as 4. These Damage bonuses are already included in NPC profiles and do not apply to ranged or extra attacks. Tiny has no supplied Wounds formula, Damage modifier or outnumbering count; retain its baseline or set Wounds manually. Melee defence against a larger creature suffers −2 SL. Aggressive creatures cause Fear in smaller creatures. Creatures may leave melee with smaller opponents without Disengaging. In Opposed Strength or similar Tests, a creature at least 2 Size steps larger wins automatically; with a 1-step difference, the smaller creature must roll a Critical to compare SL normally, otherwise it loses. The outnumbering counts above apply only when determining whether the larger creature is outnumbered; it counts as 1 for its own outnumbering bonus. Against a smaller opponent, lose Momentum for one Stomp as a Free Attack using Melee (Brawling), with SB Damage. Each upward Size adjustment gives +10 Strength, +10 Toughness and −5 Agility; reverse these changes when shrinking. Ignore Size rules while Swarm applies (p. 362).

rows.name: Skittish
textFields: Spectacular visible magic, thunderclaps or explosions inflict 3 Broken Conditions.

rows.name: Spellcaster
textFields: Casts the listed Lore(s). Add Spellcaster/Spellcaster Lord template, or grant Channelling (chosen Wind) at WP +10 and Language (Magick) at Int +10 as Basic Skills (GM may increase).

rows.name: Striding Gait
textFields: No movement penalties in the listed terrain; +1 SL to Athletics and Stealth there.

rows.name: Stupid
textFields: If no nearby ally lacks Stupid, make Easy (+4 SL) Intelligence at each Round’s start. Failure: lose that turn’s Move and Action. Nearby non-Stupid allies prevent this.

rows.name: Swarm
textFields: Acts as one creature; ignores Psychology, Engaged restrictions on moving and all Size rules. Each Engaged opponent loses 1 Wound at Round end. Has ×5 normal Wounds and +10 WS; shooting at it gains +40 to hit.

rows.name: Tail
textFields: Lose Momentum for a Free Attack at SB +2 Damage; smaller targets losing any Wounds also become Prone.

rows.name: Tentacles
textFields: One Free Attack per tentacle at SB +0 Damage. Causing Damage may inflict Entangled and initiate a Grapple with that tentacle. Resolve its Grapple with the tentacle’s Free Attack, not the creature’s Action (p. 167).

rows.name: Territorial
textFields: Fights to the death defending its area; normally does not pursue enemies beyond it.

rows.name: Terror
textFields: First encounter: Psychology Test; failure gives Broken equal to Rating +1 per negative SL. Causes Fear of same Rating regardless of result (p. 183).

rows.name: Tongue
textFields: Lose Momentum for a ranged Free Attack at SB +0 Damage. GM sets range (default 3 yards at Small–Large; 12 for larger). Hit: 1 Entangled; smaller targets dragged into melee. Then release, make a Weapon-Trait Free Attack, or keep wrapped and initiate a Grapple (p. 167).

rows.name: Trained
textFields: Animal Training teaches the options listed in parentheses; additional training options may be created. Broken: ignore Bestial and gain +2d10 Fellowship. Drive: pull carts, coaches, ploughs, buggies or similar loads. Entertain: +10 to appropriate Entertain, Perform or Play Tests. Fetch: retrieve objects, normally for dogs and similar animals. Guard: remain at or patrol a guarded place; gain Territorial. Home: return home when released or lost. Magic: ignore Skittish caused by magic, as required for most spellcasters’ mounts. Mount: accept a rider; belligerent animals may require a specific Ride specialisation, such as Ride (Griffon) for a griffon. War: +10 Weapon Skill and ignore Skittish caused by loud noises.

rows.name: Undead
textFields: Needs no air, food, water or other life necessities; counts as Undead for spells, Miracles and abilities.

rows.name: Unstable
textFields: Round end: Engaged opponent has Momentum and creature has none → driven back; lose 2 Wounds. Destroyed or banished at 0 Wounds.

rows.name: Vampiric
textFields: Successful Bite against suitable prey: heal Wounds equal to target’s loss. Blood-drinking is its only healing method.

rows.name: Venom
textFields: Causing Wounds inflicts Poisoned. The listed Difficulty applies to Tests to recover from Poisoned, not to avoid it (p. 186).

rows.name: Vomit
textFields: If starting the turn Engaged, spend Move and Action: one BS roll opposed by each target’s Dodge within 2 yards. Attacker Easy (+4 SL), defenders Challenging (+0 SL). Losing targets take TB +4 Damage and Stunned; all their carried weapons/armour take 1 Damage. Once per 12 hours.

rows.name: Wallcrawler
textFields: Full Movement on suitable vertical surfaces and ceilings; automatically passes Climb Tests.

rows.name: Ward
textFields: After any blow, roll 1d10: Rating+ ignores the blow, including Criticals.

rows.name: Web
textFields: Each successful hit inflicts 1 Entangled, with Strength equal to Rating (p. 186).

rows.name: Vice (Target)
textFields: Max: Willpower Bonus. Tests: Willpower to resist the chosen Vice. Each purchase gives a different Vice, such as Alcohol, Food, Narcotics or Pleasure. Encountering its target requires a Psychology Test (WFRP p. 190). Failure forces unhealthy indulgence instead of all other actions or duties, until insensible; gain one Fatigued Condition. At each later Round’s end, another Psychology Test can end this state. Fellowship Tests towards witnesses suffer −20. Each full day without indulgence adds a cumulative −20 to Psychology Tests until you indulge.

legacy.adaptation: Fourth Edition per-rank bonus on the listed Tests omitted; printed limit and effects retained under the approved Fifth Edition adaptation.

rows.name: Etiquette (Slims)
textFields: Choose a social group, such as Criminals, Cultists, Guilders, Nobles or Soldiers. Appropriate dress and behaviour let you blend in; the GM may warn you when your behaviour would breach that group’s customs.

rows.name: Craftsman (Butcher)
textFields: Choose a Trade specialisation. Gain Advantage on its Tests and may Advance it regardless of Career. Each further purchase selects a different Trade.

rows.name: Master Tradesman (Butcher)
textFields: Choose a Trade specialisation. On successful Tests with it, use either rolled SL or the units-die result as SL. Further purchases choose different Trades.

rows.name: Artistic (Butchery)
textFields: Choose an art form, such as painting or poetry. Gain Advantage on Art Tests in that medium and may always Advance Art regardless of Career. Each further purchase chooses a different form.

rows.name: Striding Gait (Mountains)
textFields: Choose terrain, such as Coastal, Desert, Rocky, Tundra, Wetland or Woodland. Ignore its movement penalties and gain +2 SL to all Pursuit-related Tests there. Further purchases select different terrain.

rows.name: Arcane Magic (The Great Maw)
textFields:
Choose a Colour Lore (Beasts, Death, Fire, Heavens, Life, Light, Metal or Shadows), Witch Lore such as Hedgecraft or Witchcraft, or Dark Lore such as Daemonology or Necromancy. Gain one chosen spell in that Lore and access to memorise more. Normally only one Arcane Lore is allowed; with GM permission and suitable study, one Dark Lore may be added to another Arcane Lore. Pay 100 XP to unlearn the Talent, immediately losing its spells.

rows.name: Bonecrusher
textFields: A Damage +4 magic missile ignores Armour Points but allows Toughness Bonus. If it causes a Critical Wound, add +20 to the severity roll on the relevant Critical Wound table. Casting requires chewing a mouthful of bones.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Bullgorger
textFields: Consume a mighty beast’s heart to grant the target +2 Strength Bonus for Damage and other appropriate feats of Strength for the duration. When it ends, the target must immediately eat a substantial meal or gain a Fatigued Condition. An unwilling target can reject the effect with a Difficult (−1 SL) Cool Test.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Braingobbler
textFields: After eating a whole head, including its brains, gain Fear 2 (WFRP p. 341). Anyone resisting this Fear who had a close relationship with the head’s former owner takes −20 on their Cool Tests.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Taste Death
textFields: Eating part of a corpse reveals approximately when and how it died, including the general weapon or cause, but no further detail or culprit. A death free of poison or disease is considered clean; custom then calls for consuming the remaining corpse.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Trollguts
textFields: Swallow a little Troll Bile or a similar substance to give the target Regeneration (WFRP p. 341). Ogres have no additional effect. Each non-Ogre who recovers Wounds this way must pass an Average (+2 SL) Endurance Test or develop mottled green or blue new flesh, especially on regrown limbs. This is not a mutation, though observers may mistake it for one.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: The Maw
textFields: Consume most of a large beast to open a bottomless, toothed pit. Everyone in the area immediately Tests Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge. Success avoids falling but causes a Damage +8 hit, reduced by 1 per SL on that Test. Failure causes a Damage +10 hit to a random location and 3 Entangled Conditions, opposed by Strength 60; all 3 must be removed to escape. Each creature inside takes another Damage +10 hit to a random location at the end of each of its turns. When the spell ends, the pit disappears; anyone still inside suffers a Critical Wound to a random hit location.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Feast of the Fallen
textFields: Bathe a blade in a freshly slain foe’s blood. Chosen creatures in the area gain Vampiric (WFRP p. 343) for the duration, activating it by wounding enemies in melee without needing to bite; other healing still works. An unwilling creature can resist with a Difficult (−1 SL) Endurance Test. When the spell ends, non-Ogres who wounded an enemy in melee must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool or gain a Stunned Condition. If they wounded a creature with Infected or Diseased, Tests against those Traits’ harmful effects take −30.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: A Deal’s a Deal

rows.name: Carry My Burdens
textFields: Once delivery of goods has been agreed, pass an Animal Training Test to make the target serve as your pack animal, regardless of its usual aggression or wildness. It carries whatever you require during the journey but neither attacks nor obeys other commands. It returns to its wild state on arrival. Only one creature can be affected at once.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Shake On It
textFields: Seal a deal with a handshake. The target cannot oppose its terms for at least Fellowship Bonus Rounds. To contest them, they must beat your SL on an Average (+2 SL) Cool Test; success permits refusing one required action, and each additional 2 SL permits one action against the deal. You sense any breach. Breaking it yourself while the Miracle lasts gives you +1 Sin point.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Supply and Demand
textFields: First locate a buyer or seller of particular goods with Difficult (−1 SL) Gossip. Then alter those goods’ Availability by one level to change their Bartering Ratio (WFRP p. 291). Their apparent supply increases or decreases; goods you possess are unaffected.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Trickle Down
textFields: Give a gold coin and promise future wealth while addressing people below your Status. A successful Charm Test gains +1 SL per SL on the Pray Test invoking the Miracle.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Twist of Fortune
textFields: You may spend 1 of the target’s Fortune points as your own. They can contest your SL with a Challenging (+0 SL) Fellowship Test: beating you preserves their point; beating you by +4 SL also lets them spend 1 of yours as their own. A transferred point must be spent before that session ends; it returns to its original owner at the next session’s start.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Absolute Purity
textFields: Within Fellowship Bonus yards, each creature with Undead, Daemon or Spellcaster, any Sin or Corruption points, or Arcane Magic, Chaos Magic or Petty Magic takes 1d10 Wounds ignoring Toughness and AP. Allies and bystanders are included.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Fist of Vengeance
textFields: The target takes 1d10 + Willpower Bonus Damage, ignoring AP.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Flaming Blade
textFields: If you wield a sword, it becomes Magical and gains +6 Damage. Each creature it strikes gains +1 Ablaze Condition.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Fury of the Righteous Sun
textFields: Everyone within Fellowship Bonus yards gains Blinded Conditions equal to your Fellowship Bonus and is hit by a Damage +2 magic missile.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Light of Stasis
textFields: All targets in the area enter stasis for the duration and cannot move or act. Time-dependent events, including falls, missiles, injuries and Conditions, pause until the Miracle ends.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Still the Winds
textFields: For the duration, all magic within Fellowship Bonus yards is dispelled, magic items lose their magical properties temporarily, and Channelling and Casting Tests automatically fail. Second Sight shows inert Winds in the area.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Dagger of the Art
textFields: Transform a stick no longer than eight inches into a dagger with the Magical Quality. Against creatures with Ethereal or Corruption, its Damage is SB + 8. After the duration expires, a Challenging (+0 SL) Channelling Test each round maintains it.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Fellstave
textFields: When learning this spell, choose Beastmen (including Minotaurs and Centigors, excluding Skaven), Daemons, Orcs and Goblins, Ogres, Fimir, Trolls, or Undead; the GM may allow other types. Each further purchase costs the normal new-spell XP and selects another type. Whittle a wooden post at least three feet long and four inches across, carve warding symbols, and drive it into the ground before casting. For one month, matching creatures within 100 yards must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool or gain a Broken Condition. After recovering, they Test Challenging (+0 SL) Intuition; success identifies the Fellstave as the source of their magical panic.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Invigorate
textFields: The target ignores all Fatigued Conditions for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Lovelock
textFields: Collect the honey produced during the incantation in a cup or other drinking vessel. Anyone drinking this philtre falls in love with the first person they find romantically appealing, if there is one.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Protection Pouch
textFields: Requires a small pouch made from a small animal’s body, such as a bat or shrew. The spell grows purple herbs to place inside it. Wearing the filled pouch around the neck gives +1 SL to Cool Tests resisting supernatural effects, including Fear or Terror from Undead or Daemons, and +10 to Endurance Tests against disease or Poisoned Conditions.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Sightstep
textFields: Magical Sense detects nothing unusual about you, and Stealth Tests to hide from Daemons, spirits and ethereal creatures gain +2 SL. While this concealment lasts, you cannot cast, dispel or channel.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Silvertide
textFields: Over the duration, you find a total of 2d10 pennies in overlooked places.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: The Ousting
textFields: One creature in range with Ethereal or Daemonic must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Willpower or lose Wounds equal to your Willpower Bonus. If reduced to 0 Wounds or fewer, it is banished from the physical world and cannot return for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Wyrd Ward
textFields: Touch the target, then win an Opposed Willpower Test. For the duration, their Language (Magick) and Channelling Tests to cast Witchcraft, Necromancy, Daemonology or any Chaos Lore spell take −2 SL.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Rhya’s Abundance
textFields: Touch up to one barrel, crate or basket of stored food or uncooked ingredients each round. Its contents double, become fresh, and lose mould, vermin, insects and other spoilage.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Rhya’s Demand
textFields: Humanoids within Fellowship Bonus yards who have not sacrificed since the last spring equinox to Rhya, or a nature deity or powerful nature spirit accepted by her cult, lose 1 Wound +1 per SL and gain a Fatigued Condition. Examples of accepted patrons include Isha and Taal. If at least five people are affected, the ground within Fellowship yards becomes infertile for d10 years.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Rhya’s Dominion
textFields: Focus on a natural feature that could house a spirit. On success, its spirit appears and performs one task for Rhya. It may interpret instructions literally, and cannot fulfil requests that breach Rhya’s strictures.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Rhya’s Flock
textFields: Control a flock, herd or pack of domesticated animals, sense their moods and share all their senses. You may calm or agitate them and direct actions within their natural behaviour, including sleeping, stampeding or attacking.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Rhya’s Taming
textFields: Pass Average (+2 SL) Charm Animal to tame an uncorrupted wild animal of Large Size or smaller. It becomes docile towards Humans, Elves honouring Isha and similar allies, growing more compliant per SL. It will not willingly leave its natural territory.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Rhya’s Rage
textFields: Only usable while defending children or an inhabited home or farmstead. Gain Immunity to Psychology, Painless, and +2 SL on Melee, Strength and Toughness Tests.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Face of the Wild
textFields: Spend 1 SL of gathered power to gain Fear (1) until your next turn.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Talons of Ghur
textFields: Until your next turn, spend gathered power to add +1 Damage per SL to an unarmed attack, up to Willpower Bonus SL. Choose after the Melee Test but before the GM announces its result.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Thick Hide
textFields: Spend 3 SL of gathered power: until your next turn, worn leather armour grants +1 AP at each location it covers.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Eyes of Death
textFields: Spend 1 SL of gathered power and choose a visible creature. The GM describes its remaining Wounds in relative terms.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Whispers of Doom
textFields: Spend 2 SL of gathered power to learn a creature’s Dooming if you dealt it at least 1 Wound within the last Willpower Bonus minutes.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Death’s Visage
textFields: Spend 3 SL of gathered power. For this round, you need no breath and ignore Fatigued, disease and Poisoned effects. Undead ignore you unless you directly attack them or they are intelligent enough to recognise the deception.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Brighten Blaze
textFields: Spend 1 SL of gathered power to intensify a visible non-magical fire within Willpower yards: a candle becomes torch-strength, a torch campfire-strength, and so on. Illumination increases; the GM may give nearby creatures one Ablaze Condition if the enlarged fire reaches them.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Set Alight
textFields: When a Melee attack hits, spend 2 SL of gathered power to give the opponent one Ablaze Condition.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Fervent Bellow
textFields: Shout encouragement and spend 3 SL of gathered power to remove one Broken Condition from one ally who hears you.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Visions of Trauma
textFields: Spend 1 SL of gathered power for +1 SL on a Dodge or Melee Test to evade or parry an attack.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Crackling Blade
textFields: Spend gathered power on a Melee attack with a metal weapon for +1 Damage per SL, up to Willpower Bonus SL. Choose after the Melee Test but before the GM announces its result.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Visions of Fortune
textFields: Spend 3 SL of gathered power and call advice to an ally who hears you. They gain +2 SL on one Test of their choice during their next turn. You cannot target yourself.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Reinforcement
textFields: Spend 1 SL of gathered power: worn metal armour grants +1 AP to each covered location until your next turn.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Heart of Iron
textFields: When you receive a Critical Wound, spend 2 SL of gathered power. The attacker rolls twice on the relevant Critical Wound chart and uses the less harmful result.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Quicksilver Blade
textFields: Spend 3 SL of gathered power on a metal weapon you hold. For this Round, its Melee attacks count as Chamon spells and gain the Fifth Edition core Lore of Metal effects: ignore metal armour AP and add Damage equal to the metal armour AP on the struck location.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Staunch
textFields: Spend 1 SL of gathered power to remove every Fatigued and Bleeding Condition you have.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Invigorate
textFields: As an Action, spend 2 SL of gathered power and touch a creature. Until your next turn, it gains +1 SL on Strength- or Toughness-based Tests and automatically passes Tests against disease or poison effects.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Regenerate
textFields: At your turn’s start, spend 3 SL of gathered power to gain the Fifth Edition core Regeneration Trait until the next Round starts.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Brighteyes
textFields: Spend 1 SL of gathered power to gain Dark Vision and immunity to Blinded until your next turn begins. Existing Blinded Conditions are suppressed, then resume when this ends.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Purging Light
textFields: Spend 2 SL of gathered power on a held melee weapon or one piece of ammunition. Until your next turn, a target it hits must pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance Test or gain one Blinded Condition. A Daemonic target also suffers +3 Damage.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Perfection of the Self
textFields: Spend 3 SL of gathered power to ignore your Diseases, Poisons, Critical Wounds and Mutations until your next turn. Hysh temporarily replaces missing limbs for this duration.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Ulgu’s Touch
textFields: Spend 1 SL of gathered power. On Stealth Tests this Round, add up to Willpower Bonus SL after rolling but before the GM announces the result.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Not Your Problem
textFields: Spend 2 SL of gathered power. A hostile enemy attacks another viable target on its next turn if at least one is available.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: A Passing Shadow
textFields: Spend 3 SL of gathered power to escape existing restraints. Attempts to grab, hold or otherwise stop your movement fail; difficult terrain does not hinder you, and you can pass barred windows and other narrow gaps.
rows.label: Cant

rows.name: Augury
textFields: Read omens to gain visions of the future. Learnable only by Humans/Elves and incompatible with Psychometry. Readings and conditional first-level Career access are detailed on pp. 44–46.

rows.name: Psychometry
textFields: An innate Human gift: perceive recent events or unspoken thoughts at a connected location or while touching an associated person/object. Each use requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or gives 1 Fatigued. Incompatible with Augury (p. 48).

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Craftsman (Alchemist)
textFields: Choose a Trade specialisation. Gain Advantage on its Tests and may Advance it regardless of Career. Each further purchase selects a different Trade.

rows.name: Craftsman (Blacksmith)
textFields: Choose a Trade specialisation. Gain Advantage on its Tests and may Advance it regardless of Career. Each further purchase selects a different Trade.

rows.name: Master Tradesman (Alchemist)
textFields: Choose a Trade specialisation. On successful Tests with it, use either rolled SL or the units-die result as SL. Further purchases choose different Trades.

textFields: Choose a Trade specialisation. On successful Tests with it, use either rolled SL or the units-die result as SL. Further purchases choose different Trades.
