rows.name: Belligerence of the Bloodmarsh
textFields: A Fenbeast gains Frenzy if it does not already have it (WFRP p. 190).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Collapse Construct
textFields: After casting, win an Opposed Willpower/Toughness Test against a construct to make it inert.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Decipher Curse
textFields: Identify whether an item is cursed and learn its benefits, drawbacks and trigger. If you decipher a curse, pass Challenging (+0 SL) Intelligence or suffer Moderate Exposure to Corruption from its secondary wards (WFRP p. 182). The curse remains active; removing it requires Remove Curse (p. 33).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Disrupt Magic
textFields: Cast before another caster finishes a channelled spell or ritual, then optionally make an Opposed Willpower Test against them. Winning makes their spell fail and gives them a Minor Miscast.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Lifebloom Silt
textFields: For the duration, a Fenbeast regenerates twice its usual Wounds.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Succour Magical Servant
textFields: Your Familiar or Construct immediately heals Toughness Bonus Wounds, doubled if Casting achieves at least +3 SL. Ritual magic requires large amounts of channelled power and may need particular surroundings, ingredients or personal sacrifices.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Abulla’s Snare
textFields: The target gains 2 Entangled at Strength equal to your Willpower and rises 2 yards. Next round it is pulled towards you, suspended about 5 yards above and 2 yards in front of your head, moving with you until expiry. Each +1 SL adds one Entangled or lifts it another 2 yards, maximum 10 yards. Release causes falling damage (WFRP p. 166).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Assault of Stone
textFields: Raise a permanent hill about 20 yards across and 5 yards high. Characters on the rising terrain take 20 Damage to a random location, reduced to 10 Damage by Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Crevasse
textFields: Open a crevasse 3 yards in each dimension. Each +2 SL adds 1 yard of length and depth, to a maximum depth of 10 yards. Targets on or beside it need Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge to avoid falling; Marginal Failure allows grabbing the edge. Horses and vehicles fall automatically, and structures may partly collapse. At expiry it closes, dealing 20 Damage to trapped victims and burying them alive with Suffocation (WFRP p. 181).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Dazzling Brightness
textFields: Everyone in the area gains 1 Blinded unless they have Arcane Magic (Light). Daemons gain 1 Stunned.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Driving Intent
textFields: The target gains +2 SL to resist Charm and Intimidation. On yourself, you may instead choose +2 SL to Charm while speaking only truth; the College of Light regards this use as glamour.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Erect the Edifice
textFields: Raise a wall from local earth and stone, 5 yards long, 1 yard high and 6 inches thick, providing Hard Cover (WFRP p. 161), or Earthwork under Up In Arms artillery rules. Each +2 SL allows an extra round adding 5 yards length or 1 yard height; each extra yard of height adds 6 inches thickness. Each 2-yard section may have one door/window opening. A bend or curve costs +2 SL. Repeated castings can make a building shell, but it collapses after Willpower Bonus + SL days unless you or an adviser present during casting have Lore (Engineering) or Trade (Stoneworker). The spell makes no basements, floors or roofs; finishing needs carpentry.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Eyes of Volans
textFields: Take −2 SL to sight-based Perception, except gain +20 when reading Winds with Second Sight. See corruption and recognise mutations in Humans and other civilised species, though clothing may conceal them; plants and animals are excluded. Looking at a target reveals its Corruption point total or Corrupted Trait.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Hands of Karkora
textFields: Targets in the area must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge or be Grappled (WFRP p. 163) by hands with Strength equal to your Willpower. If declared at casting, the hands may pull victims underground in later rounds instead of dealing Damage, causing Suffocation (p. 181).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Illuminate the Edifice
textFields: Fill every enclosed space in a house with daylight, including light escaping through cracks. +2 SL permits a tower or large manor; +4 SL a castle. Daemons and Undead need Challenging (+0 SL) Willpower to enter, then take Damage equal to Casting SL ignoring Toughness Bonus and AP.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Light of Purity
textFields: A light source grants Resistant (Disease) to everyone it illuminates. Wizards there add your Casting SL to attempts to dispel Dark and Chaos spells. The source sets Range and Duration (WFRP p. 309), capped at 1 mile and 1 day.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Meissner’s Instantaneous Librarian
textFields: Make a desired scroll, book or grimoire glow for Willpower Bonus + SL Rounds. Specify its title or a topic of at most 10 words; vague topics may identify several books. Immediately add 1 + SL towards an Extended Research Test. Further research normally needs reading, though complex research in a suitable library may count a second or third casting.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Orb of Hysh
textFields: Enclose one object of any size in solid light. Move, rotate or lift up to Willpower Bonus + SL Encumbrance at speed equal to Willpower Bonus. Malignant Influences inside are safely contained (WFRP p. 236), reducing exposure-based Corruption Tests by one level.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Perfect Comprehension
textFields: Understand spoken, written, coded, garbled or otherwise communicated language. This does not let you use languages you do not know. Dark Tongue is excluded; the GM may also exclude ancient obscure languages such as Slann or Old Ones speech.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Pierce the Veil
textFields: See through ordinary darkness, mist, smoke and fog as in daylight. An Opposed Willpower Test against the caster also lets you see through magical darkness, invisibility and illusions.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Shimmering Cloak
textFields: Melee and missile attacks lose their Damage rating and inflict only SL Wounds. Other non-magical Damage, including fire and falls, is negated. Magical attacks are unaffected. You cannot hide during the spell.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Time Amok
textFields: Every ally immediately receives one extra action without an extra move. Resolve these in Initiative order, skipping enemies and neutrals, then resume the usual order with the character after you.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Armour of Tin
textFields: Metal armour in the area loses 2 AP at every location.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Breach the Unknown
textFields: Learn an object’s physical properties as from a full day’s study, or a creature’s health and highest physical attribute. Each +2 SL reveals one further hidden detail, such as poison, medicinal properties or a Trait. Casting while touching a magical object temporarily grants Detect Artefact (WFRP p. 135).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Curse of Rust
textFields: Permanently rust one non-magical metal object into uselessness. At +4 SL you may also make a non-metal object brittle as glass for Willpower Bonus minutes. Mixed objects can have rusted metal and temporarily brittle non-metal parts; failed fasteners may break them apart. Maximum affected Encumbrance is 1, plus 1 per additional +2 SL.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Fault of Form
textFields: A partly metal weapon loses beneficial Qualities and gives −1 SL to hit. Dangerous Fumbles on 8, 9 or doubles; Reload doubles; Slow gives defenders +2 SL. Magical weapons resist alteration, but +4 SL temporarily suppresses their enchantments.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Gehenna’s Golden Globe
textFields: A golden sphere applies Golden Touch to targets in its area and moves using random vortex rules.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Gilded Cage
textFields: Golden bars enclose the area, bursting through obstructing walls or ceilings indoors. The half-inch bars can be bent with Hard (−2 SL) Strength or cut using suitable tools. Tiny or Little prisoners fit through 6-inch gaps. Outsiders cannot enter, but weapons and missiles pass between bars.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Golden Touch
textFields: The next living creature you touch must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Willpower or become a golden statue. The GM secretly rolls Duration. The statue has Toughness Bonus 10, retains normal Wounds, cannot see, hear or feel, and need not breathe. Any Wounds suffered immediately end the spell.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Goldsteel Shielding
textFields: Reinforce a non-living object, building or surface with +4 Armour and immunity to natural damage such as fire, earthquakes and hurricanes. Each exterior wall of a small two-storey house is roughly 4 × 4 yards; full coverage may need repeated casting. Taking cover behind it reduces Corruption exposure by two levels and gives +1 SL to Dispel spells targeting you. It can contain Malignant Influences such as Warpstone.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Inscription
textFields: Write or draw on metal by moving your hand over it, at twelve words per round. +2 SL permits invisible Secret Runes, revealed only by another Gold Wizard casting this spell on them. Alternatively, spray acid at a metal-armoured enemy as a Damage +2 magic missile; a hit destroys 1 AP at that location unless washed off within 10 rounds.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Knot Untied
textFields: For a puzzle, riddle, trap or mystery solvable by deduction, the GM must give one hint and may give another per +2 SL. Related Lore Tests gain +2 SL.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Metal Mended
textFields: Restore a damaged metal object of any size, replacing missing parts if at least three-quarters remain. Alternatively fuse two metal objects, assisting Trade (Smithing) or adding Unreliable and Bulky to enemy armour (WFRP p. 293). The GM decides other applications.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Meteoric Ironclad
textFields: Targets gain Ward (4) (WFRP p. 343) through weightless magical armour, compatible with ordinary armour.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Prismatic Refraction of Habermas
textFields: All Channelling and Casting in the area, including yours, take −1 SL. At expiry the collected Winds become harmless coloured light. Choose one Colour to become a handful of aethyric fluid instead, adding +1 SL to one Casting Test from its Lore. The fluid evaporates unused after two Rounds.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Puchta’s Silver Compass
textFields: A normal compass functions as a Compass of Meteoric Silver (p. 53) for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Replication of Levorg
textFields: Conjure a functional inanimate non-magical object of up to 4 Enc, plus 1 Enc per +2 SL. A skilled tradesperson can recognise the copy. It disappears when the spell ends.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Trial and Error
textFields: Choose one Skill at casting. You or an ally gain +2 SL on their next Test with it; achieving +2 SL also gives a single reroll for that Test.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Almanac
textFields: Spend one day attuning to an area, while free to move and cast other spells. Afterwards forecast major weather and seasonal events over the coming year. Dates are initially approximate; +2 SL narrows them to a week and +4 SL to a day.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Dwellers Below
textFields: Earth spirits seize targets in the area. Each must pass Strength, optionally using a mount’s Strength, or be pulled underground for 1d10 hours. The spirits neither deal Damage nor can be harmed. Returning targets must Test Moderate Exposure to Corruption (WFRP p. 182). The spirits depart underground at expiry.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Flesh of Stone
textFields: Turn a target to living stone, resisted if unwilling by Opposed Willpower. It can move and fight but cannot speak, has half Movement, +30 Strength and Toughness, and +4 AP everywhere, and needs no air.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Gardener’s Warcry
textFields: Target earth to create a lasting Blood Forest. Everyone initially in the area takes 10 Damage, reduced by Toughness Bonus and Armour, and gains Bleeding. Later crossing above half Movement requires Challenging (+0 SL) Agility to avoid Bleeding. The forest persists until cut or burned.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Geyser
textFields: Targets in the area take a Damage +4 magic missile, are pushed Willpower Bonus yards in your chosen direction, and gain Prone. Each additional +2 SL may give any one affected target Stunned. A pool of fresh springwater remains afterwards.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Invigorating Chant
textFields: Awaken dormant plant creatures in the area, such as Dryads, Tree Kin, Fenbeasts or carnivorous plants; they spend one round stirring before acting. Targets immediately heal SL Wounds and gain SL on all Tests for the duration. You do not control them. They may resent waking out of season but are unlikely to attack you during the spell. The GM sets their forms and abilities, with Constructs (p. 30) as guidance.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Jade Casket
textFields: Animate a creature dead within the past hour at maximum Wounds. It obeys simple commands or otherwise instinctively protects you. It retains non-magical Skills, Traits and Talents but cannot speak or remember its former life. It is neither truly alive nor Undead.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Leaf Fall
textFields: Missile attacks against you take −2 SL. Gain Contortionist (WFRP p. 135) and reduce Damage from falling, crushing, clubs, hammers and other blunt weapons by 3.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Leyfinding
textFields: Gain a detailed mental map of leylines and stone circles in range, adding +2 SL to Navigation to locate planned or natural leylines. Sense each line’s minor/major strength and each circle’s waystone count, but not specific Wind Colours at distance (Chapter 14).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Nature’s Whisper
textFields: Touch a river or tree to speak telepathically with its minor spirit. Rivers generally know events within 1 mile upstream/downstream from the last 24 hours; forest trees have similar reach and years of memory, but take at least 5 minutes per answer. Complex questions may receive vague answers. Spirits may demand help, need not like you, and this grants no advantage communicating with animated spirits such as Naiads or Dryads.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Paranoth’s Pathway
textFields: Everyone in the area gains Striding Gait (Woodlands) (WFRP p. 145). Existing holders may gain one temporary level plus another per +2 SL. At +4 SL the party leaves no trackable traces. Crossing another path or harming a living tree ends the spell.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Spiral Stair
textFields: Rise on a staircase to Willpower yards high, plus Willpower yards per +2 SL, maximum 200 yards. While on it, gain 3 AP everywhere and add its height to incoming missiles’ travel distance. Other Jade Wizards knowing this spell may climb with Challenging (+0 SL) Lore (Magic); it is insubstantial to everyone else.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Vaunted Transmogrification of Colchis
textFields: All initially affected characters and surfaces become non-flammable and immune to fire Damage. Extinguish fires and remove Ablaze in the area. Portable fires can enter, but cannot harm protected targets. A character leaving the area loses immunity.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Verdant Apotheosis
textFields: Revive targets slain within the last minute. Each must Test Moderate Exposure to Corruption (WFRP p. 182). Critical Wounds and lost limbs are not healed; decapitation prevents revival.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Vital Growth
textFields: Grow one plant or tree to its natural maximum height. Doubling it requires +2 SL and one additional round concentrating on casting; tripling requires +4 SL and two rounds; quadrupling requires +6 SL and three rounds.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Wood Shape
textFields: Turn yourself or another target into an oak. Unwilling targets resist with Average (+2 SL) Willpower. The tree retains sight and hearing and can be harmed by axes, fire and other tree-damaging attacks.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Azure Blades
textFields: On each melee opponent’s turn each round, they suffer three unavoidable 8 Damage hits to random locations. Very Long or Massive weapons reach past the blades; Long weapons attack simultaneously; shorter weapons attack only after the wielder takes these hits.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Curse of Fate
textFields: With line of sight, give a target −10 on all Tests for the duration, with only one such curse per target. At +6 SL use Fate of Doom instead: Range becomes 1 mile and the target permanently loses 1 Fate point. If it has none, its next Critical Hit received during the duration uses 00 on the appropriate table.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Divination
textFields: Choose one effect: learn an auspicious time for a future action, with accuracy set by the GM’s secret Challenging (+0 SL) Intelligence Test for you; locate a previously seen lost or stolen object by direction but not distance; or modify one specifically defined future die roll by +10 or −10. Only one effect of the last kind can affect you at once.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Enemy Foreseen
textFields: You cannot be Surprised. The GM must warn you of an ambush or comparable danger Initiative Bonus rounds before it occurs, giving time to prepare or escape.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Fantastic Foresight
textFields: Allied wizards in the area, excluding you, may reroll their first failure on every Channelling, Casting and Dispel Test. Alternatively cast Solmann’s Discombobulation: enemy wizards roll each such Test twice and take the worse result.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Fate Illuminated
textFields: Ask the GM one yes/no question about the target’s intentions within the next hour, plus another per +2 Casting SL. Questions must concern intent. Alternatively, touching the target reveals its Dooming (WFRP p. 136), curses and portents, including active and reversed symbols (p. 45).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Lens on the Sky
textFields: A floating crystal lens follows you, clearly showing creatures and objects up to 3 miles away. Gain +2 SL to long-distance Perception and ignore fog/cloud penalties, but not darkness. Using it to observe stars gives +2 SL on your next Navigation Test.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Let the Four Winds Blow!
textFields: Choose four random vortex spells (p. 20) or enemy groups in range. Push each directly away by Willpower Bonus yards, plus that distance per +2 Casting SL. An enemy hitting a solid obstacle or character stops and takes 7 Damage, reduced by Toughness Bonus and AP. Every target gains Prone when it stops.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Mistral From the Stratosphere
textFields: Choose a direction; targets in range that way take 12 Damage ignoring AP but allowing Toughness Bonus, and must pass Hard (−2 SL) Endurance or suffer first-stage Cold Exposure (WFRP p. 181). Water freezes 1 inch thick per round. In later rounds you may redirect the blast or keep freezing those targets. Damage occurs only in the first round, but Cold Exposure Tests repeat each round. Lost Characteristics recover 10 points per hour. You may move while casting.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Mystic Mirror
textFields: Communicate both ways through mirrors or reflective surfaces with someone you have met or whose name you know. Your image and voice appear in their surface, and theirs in yours. Casting fails without a reflective surface in their line of sight.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Polish and Glean
textFields: Clean glass perfectly. At +2 SL a lens or window may grant +20 Lore (Astronomy); at +4 SL it may grant +20 visual Perception using Second Sight.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Project Spirit
textFields: Your body sleeps while your invisible spirit moves normally, sees, hears and passes solid barriers. It cannot speak, cast or manipulate physical objects. If it has not returned before expiry, you wake suddenly and Test Moderate Exposure to Corruption (WFRP p. 182).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Sapphire Arch
textFields: Create an arch 4 yards wide and 3 yards high. Anything passing through enters limbo. The arch vanishes at the end of your next round. Your next casting releases the previous occupants without them experiencing elapsed time. If you die first, they return at their original entry point with Stunned and Prone.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Starshine
textFields: A moving area of starlight around you dispels ordinary and magical darkness and reveals invisible or concealed creatures and hidden doors.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Storm of Shemtek
textFields: Fire 2 × Initiative Bonus Damage +6 magic missiles at separate targets in front of you and immediately gain Stunned. Observers without Arcane Magic (Heavens) must Test Fear (1) (WFRP p. 190). No open sky is needed. Alternatively summon only Initiative Bonus bolts into an area 2 × Willpower Bonus yards across, without Stunned or Fear.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: T’Essla’s Arc
textFields: A Damage +10 magic missile causes 1 Blinded Condition.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Thorsen’s Thunderstorm
textFields: A tornado deals a Damage +8 magic missile to targets in its area, then pushes them randomly using Let the Four Winds Blow! (p. 100). It moves with random vortex rules (p. 20).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Bewilder
textFields: A target failing Challenging (+0 SL) Willpower rolls 1d10 for behaviour throughout the duration: 1–2 needs Challenging (+0 SL) Willpower to act; 3–4 acts normally but moves randomly; 5–6 charges and attacks the nearest target; 7–8 can only stand still and Dodge; 9–10 gains Prone and becomes Helpless (WFRP p. 162).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Black Horrors
textFields: Haunt a shadow with a non-attacking shade causing Fear (1), increased by 1 per +2 Casting SL to a maximum of Fear (4). The shadow becomes magical and persists even under illumination.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Bridge of Shadows
textFields: Carry willing targets through the air to a chosen visible destination within Willpower yards of their starting point. You may travel with them if in the area. Solid objects block passage, but obstacles up to Willpower yards high can be crossed. Arrival occurs when the spell ends.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Dance of Despair
textFields: Enemies failing Willpower must dance. Moving or acting then requires Hard (−2 SL) Athletics or Challenging Perform (Dance). They gain Fatigued when the spell ends. Allies and neutral characters are unaffected.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Deep Pockets
textFields: Store one object in a weightless, invisible pocket dimension. A filled container counts as one object. Its permitted Encumbrance is 1 +1 per +2 Casting SL. Perception cannot locate it; an Action retrieves it. If not retrieved before expiry, it is lost.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Grand Illusion
textFields: Use Illusion’s rules, but include sight, sound, smell, taste and touch, with movement allowed. Describe the illusion fully at casting. For believers it functions physically, allowing passage over an illusory bridge, for example. Recognising the illusion removes that reality for the observer immediately.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Grey Wings
textFields: Teleport yourself or one other target up to 100 yards from its starting position.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Horn of Andar
textFields: Allies in range gain +2 SL Cool and Leadership; enemies take −2 SL on those Tests and must immediately Test Fear (1). Neutral targets are unaffected.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Hush
textFields: A sound-dampening area follows a willing target; an enchanted object may be picked up after casting. Choose one: prevent sound leaving while allowing sound in; prevent sound entering while treating internal sounds normally; or prevent sound being produced inside.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Mutable Visage
textFields: An unwilling target resists with Opposed Willpower. Choose one appearance change: adjust attractiveness and Fellowship by +10 or −10; appear dead even under close inspection, retaining senses but unable to move or speak; or become unrecognisable to acquaintances. Willpower Tests can restore recognition for people the target wishes to reconnect with.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Pit of Tarnus
textFields: Open a pit whose diameter and depth equal the area. Those on or beside it must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge to avoid falling; Marginal Failure permits grabbing the edge. At expiry it closes, dealing 20 Damage and burying trapped victims alive with Suffocation (WFRP p. 181).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Ribauld’s Retroactive Illusion
textFields: Teleport a terrain feature up to Willpower yards, including its occupants. It must be house-sized or smaller, separate from the ground, and not a famous landmark. Buildings, trees, boulders, streams and pools qualify; hills do not. The destination must make sense for the feature. The GM decides fame and suitability.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Shadow Grove
textFields: Reveal shadows cast by invisible creatures and aethyric manifestations. Invisible targets can be spotted normally but attacks against them take −10. Possessed creatures cast one shadow for themselves and one per possessing spirit or Daemon. Natural or artificial light is required; total darkness prevents the spell working.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Substance of Shadow
textFields: An object or creature entirely inside a shadow cast by an object blocking visible light becomes invisible and partly insubstantial; total darkness does not qualify. Physical attacks, pushing and touch cannot affect it, but magic works normally. It may affect physical things without penalties. Any part leaving the shadow ends the spell.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Traitor of Tarn
textFields: An enemy losing Opposed Willpower sees you as an ally and former allies as enemies. It cannot be ordered into obvious suicide. Each order to attack a former ally permits Challenging (+0 SL) Cool to break the effect. On neutral targets, instead gain +2 SL on Fellowship-based Tests involving them. Friendly targets are unaffected.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Wandering Shadow
textFields: Detach your shadow and use Actions to direct it at your Movement rate; without direction it stays still. See, hear and smell from its location, but cannot cast through it. It causes Fear (1) and cannot attack. Direct sunlight or distance beyond 48 yards from a light source destroys it.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Acceptance of Fate
textFields: Allies ignore Fear, treat Terror as Fear for the duration, and permanently lose grief-based Psychology. Alternatively, nearby enemies failing Challenging (+0 SL) Cool cannot flee combat for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Amaranth
textFields: Reduce Critical Hit table rolls against you by 10 and gain Resistant (Poison, Disease, and Chaos). Existing relevant Talents gain +1 level per +2 SL.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Animus Imprisoned
textFields: Trap a soul in a bottle, vial or pouch, leaving its body comatose until an Amethyst wizard or Morr priest opens the vessel beside it. The body needs food and water; awakening requires Moderate Source of Corruption exposure (WFRP p. 182). You may speak telepathically with the soul. Incorrect opening or opening far from the body kills it and creates a Ghost (p. 331). As a Telepathy ingredient (p. 125), the soul enables unlimited-range contact with an Amethyst wizard it previously met. A Miscast breaks the vessel and releases the soul under those same rules.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Ashes and Dust
textFields: A cloud deals 8 Damage ignoring Armour and causes Suffocation until targets leave (WFRP p. 181), moving under random vortex rules (p. 20). At +4 SL you may also create a Purple Sun of Xereus at its centre: a 1-yard globe causing Fear (2). A creature touched must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool or die; walls, doors and other obstacles disintegrate automatically.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Compel Spirits
textFields: For creatures with both Undead and Ethereal, choose: command all targets losing Opposed Willpower, including orders to fight or flee, though only Death’s Release can lay them to rest; or summon Ghosts equal to SL (WFRP p. 331), uncontrolled unless you cast again. The Amethyst College forbids summoning.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Crystal Maze
textFields: Targets vanish into the maze and cannot be harmed or affected. At the end of each subsequent round roll 1d10: 1–3 returns them to their departure point; 4–6 requires another roll next round; 7–9 loses them for 1d10 hours, then requires Moderate Exposure to Corruption on return (WFRP p. 182); 10 loses them forever in Tzeentch’s Realm.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Death’s Release
textFields: Each round, targets with both Undead and Ethereal must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool or gain Stunned. Accumulating 3 Stunned releases a spirit from the mortal world.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Fate of Bjuna
textFields: Each round, targets failing Challenging (+0 SL) Cool gain Stunned and take their own Strength Bonus + 6 Damage ignoring Armour, with 50% chance each of head or body. Each +2 SL may additionally surround one target with energy: failure on Challenging (+0 SL) Willpower causes immediate Suffocation damage and continued Suffocation for the duration (WFRP p. 181).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Iyrtu’s Embrace
textFields: Gain +10 Strength per +1 SL. Grapple attacks automatically succeed; a rolled miss becomes +0 SL.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Limbwither
textFields: Choose a limb to render useless for Willpower Bonus minutes, treating it as amputated (WFRP p. 180). Alternatively ward a grave: the first person to desecrate it within one year suffers a randomly chosen deadened limb for Willpower Bonus days.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Shyish Uncovered
textFields: Learn the number, species and time of deaths in the area during the past month, plus another month per +1 SL. Names and causes are not revealed. For a deceased person whose name you know, each additional +2 SL permits one question answerable through knocks, including yes/no or numbers.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Speed of Lykos
textFields: You or another target may move 100 yards next round and still act, with normal terrain and obstacles applying. A target killed during the spell may perform one immediate action before dying.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Taste of Death
textFields: The primary living enemy Tests Minor Exposure to Corruption (WFRP p. 182), then Challenging (+0 SL) Cool to avoid Unconscious. Other enemies within Initiative Bonus yards of it must pass Average (+2 SL) Cool or gain Stunned. Each Cool failure also requires Easy (+4 SL) Cool to avoid Fatigued and Psychology (Despair). Despair victims gain Fatigued on waking every morning for the next week.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Telepathy
textFields: Send a telepathic message to another Amethyst wizard; Animus Imprisoned removes Range limits. Other recipients need Challenging (+0 SL) Intuition to understand. Alternatively read another Amethyst wizard’s surface thoughts. They may detect this with Challenging (+0 SL) Intelligence, then block it by winning Opposed Willpower.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Tide of Years
textFields: Destroy a non-magical object by aging it to dust, up to 2 Enc plus 1 per +2 Casting SL. Durable items instead lose all Qualities. At 4 or more SL you may target a living creature: failing Average (+2 SL) Cool permanently reduces Strength and Toughness by 1d10 each through aging. Daemons, Undead and plant creatures are immune.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Wild Kin of Zandox
textFields: Summon two hounds visible only fleetingly with Hard (−2 SL) Perception. On your turn they may attack enemies within 4 yards, each with WS 50 and Weapon (Bite) +8. They cannot be attacked and gain no Momentum.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I). Fourth Edition Advantage references converted to Momentum (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Body of Fire
textFields: Anyone grabbing or Grappling you takes 8 + SL Damage and must pass Hard (−2 SL) Cool every round to maintain the hold. Each round you Grapple someone, they take an additional 8 + SL Damage and 1 Ablaze. An attacker wounding you in melee must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge or take a Damage +3 magic missile ignoring Armour. Your clothing and belongings are fireproof; you remain vulnerable to fire.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Boiling Blood
textFields: A target failing Difficult (−1 SL) Endurance immediately gains 2 Blinded and takes 10 + SL Damage at each of its rounds’ starts, ignoring Armour but allowing Toughness Bonus. A slain target explodes, dealing a Damage +1 magic missile to everyone within 2 yards.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Burning Head
textFields: A flaming head about two feet across travels straight to maximum Range, striking everything in its path with a Damage +4 magic missile, reduced to +0 by Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge. Every struck target gains 1 Ablaze. Those losing at least 1 Wound treat you as causing Fear (1).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Captivating Flame
textFields: Enchant a fire no larger than a torch. One random observer looking towards it must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool or gain 3 Stunned, ignoring everything else until those Conditions are removed. Attacking an affected target immediately removes all spell-caused Stunned. At +2 Casting SL, a brazier/campfire-sized fire affects two random observers; +4 SL permits a pyre/building-sized fire affecting every observer.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Choleric
textFields: Name or point out a person to become the target’s Prejudice for Willpower Bonus hours (WFRP p. 190). Friendship with that person permits Average (+2 SL) Cool to resist. At +4 Casting SL, you may instead impose Animosity for Willpower Bonus days; at +8 SL, Hatred for Willpower Bonus weeks. Normal resistance to the chosen Psychology still applies until expiry or dispelling.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Flamestorm
textFields: Create a fire pillar 2 yards across and 2 yards high. Each +2 Casting SL adds 1 yard diameter and 2 yards height. Those initially inside take a Damage +8 magic missile and 3 Ablaze, are thrown clear and gain Prone. Only creatures immune to magical fire can enter. It lasts until dispelled or next sunrise.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Forge of Tarnus
textFields: Touch unlit forge coals to ignite them. Trade (Smith) Tests during the spell gain +1 SL, including magical item crafting (Archives II).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Ignite
textFields: Give an object or person 2 Ablaze. If already Ablaze, you may instead distribute 3 new Ablaze Conditions among others within 2 yards.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Inextinguishable Flame
textFields: Make an ordinary fire up to campfire size impossible to extinguish for Willpower Bonus hours. +2 Casting SL extends the unit to days, +4 SL to weeks, or +6 SL to months.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Kindleflame
textFields: Normally non-flammable things in the area, including water and stone, can burn. Already flammable targets take additional fire Damage equal to SL and gain one extra Ablaze whenever they receive that Condition.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Kindred of the Hearth
textFields: Put your hands into a bonfire, taking 6 Damage minus Toughness Bonus, to summon an elemental with Movement 3, WS equal to your Willpower, Damage +6 and Fear (1). It must stay within 12 yards of the fire and follows spoken instructions. Casting another spell or speaking to anyone else makes it stop. It can only move or attack, gains no Momentum, and gives 1 Ablaze whenever it deals Damage. Only dousing it with at least a pint of water can harm it, destroying it.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Fourth Edition Advantage references converted to Momentum (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Magma Storm
textFields: Targets in the molten-rock vortex gain 2 Ablaze and take a Damage +12 magic missile.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Sanguine Swords
textFields: Summon one sword plus another per additional +2 Casting SL, maximum six. In subsequent rounds, spend your Action directing them at visible targets in range, with at most one sword attacking each target at once. Each has Fly (20), WS 60 and 8 Damage, returning to you afterwards. Normal defence applies. They gain no Momentum and cannot be destroyed except by dispelling.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Fourth Edition Advantage references converted to Momentum (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Taste of Fire
textFields: Choose one: make a pot of food very spicy, requiring Easy (+4 SL) Endurance when eaten to avoid digestive trouble; turn a quart-jug of any liquid into strong spirits retaining some original flavour; or turn a pint-flask of liquid into flammable lantern oil.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Withering Heat
textFields: Enemies in the area gain Fatigued each round they run, charge or flee. Removing armour and clothing removes one Fatigued gained this way. Contact with any fire automatically gives them Ablaze, and every fire source deals extra Damage equal to Casting SL.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Ygethmor’s Flaming Blizzard
textFields: Each Round, targets in the area take 8 + SL Damage and must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Athletics or gain Prone. Each flammable object or terrain feature has a 25% ignition chance per round. Only hard cover shelters against these effects.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Amber Trance
textFields: A target failing Hard (−2 SL) Cool becomes an immovable, indestructible amber statue, unaffected even by poison and disease but able to heal naturally or magically. Attacking ends the spell, with the first blow harmless. The target remembers nothing from the trance. A willing target can hibernate for a full 3-month season until equinox or solstice. If self-cast, it cannot end early except through an attack or dispelling.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Awakening of the Wood
textFields: Forest targets take a Damage +4 magic missile. Failing Average (+2 SL) Dodge also causes one Bleeding and one Entangled at Strength 30.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Beast Unbroken
textFields: A domestic animal becomes wild until dispelled, fleeing or turning on its former owner as the GM decides. Charm Animal can deter attacks but cannot tame it. Riders need Hard (−2 SL) Ride to avoid being thrown. At +4 Casting SL, you may instead transform a Human who fails Difficult (−1 SL) Willpower: it grows thick hair, cannot speak, and rolls 1d10 each round. 1–3: scratches, defecates or picks its nose; 4–6: moves randomly, colliding with obstacles or attacking creatures in its path; 7–9: laughs and crawls or dances towards the nearest character; 10: screams, causing Fear (1) to listeners without Arcane Magic (Beasts). Both versions last until dispelled.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Curse of Anraheir
textFields: Invulnerable spirits visible only to the targets impose −2 Movement and −20 WS, BS and Agility on enemies in the area, without Damage. They follow departing targets with reduced penalties of −1 Movement and −10 to those Characteristics. Mounts must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool or flee until calmed with Challenging (+0 SL) Ride.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Eyes of the Pack
textFields: The target may switch between its own sight and yours at will, at any distance. Your view may satisfy line of sight for some spells, including teleportation, but it cannot cast through your body.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Follow Scent
textFields: Gain +20 on smell-based Track and Perception, including Second Sight to smell magic. Detect Corruption and mutation by scent in plants, animals and animal dung.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Hunter’s Moons
textFields: Allies in the area gain +1 Movement, +10 Strength and +10 Toughness.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Merciw’s Monstrous Regiment
textFields: Allies in the area, excluding you, gain +30 Strength and Toughness, each capped at 100.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Musk Spray
textFields: Mark a creature or object with a distinctive smell, giving +2 SL on Tests to locate it.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Quick Passage
textFields: Gain +1 Movement, Scale Sheer Surface and Striding Gait (Any 1) (WFRP pp. 144–145). Existing Talents may gain one temporary level plus another per +2 Casting SL. Tests to avoid Entangled gain +10.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Summon Mount
textFields: The GM chooses an ordinary, non-monstrous animal native to the terrain, such as a stag, boar or bear, to serve as your mount. Gain its Ride Skill at your Language (Magick) value temporarily. It fights for you but retains self-preservation.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: The Ox Stands
textFields: Immediately remove SL + 1 Broken Conditions from allies in the area. They need no further Fear or Terror Tests for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Transformation of Kadon
textFields: Become a Large or Enormous monster chosen by the GM. Amber/Elven examples: Demigryph, Dragon, Hippogryph, Great Eagle, Griffon; Beastman Shaman/Witch/Chaos Sorcerer examples: Manticore, Hydra, Jabberslythe, Wyvern. Retain Intelligence and Willpower; replace all other Characteristics with its profile and all Skills/Talents with its Skills/Creature Traits. You cannot cast. Each +4 Casting SL permits one Optional Trait or casting on someone else by Touch instead; unwilling targets resist with Opposed Willpower.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Vengeful Hood
textFields: Against a non-magical attack that would hit, pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool to reduce Damage by Willpower Bonus + SL. Reducing it to 0 instead deflects it: a ranged attack strikes a random target within 2 yards as its original target; a melee attack hits its attacker, who cannot Oppose it.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Winter Coat
textFields: Ignore Cold Exposure and reduce Critical Hit table rolls against you by 10. Take −10 Agility and Fellowship.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Writhing Worm
textFields: The target is automatically Grappled and gains Entangled (WFRP p. 163). The invulnerable worm uses Strength 50. Each won Opposed Strength Test either adds another Entangled or dissolves 1 AP of leather/similar armour at every location, also destroying leather belongings such as bags. It cannot deal Grapple Damage. Escape ends the spell.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Bind Monstrous Beast
textFields: CN: Beast’s Wounds Type: Lore of Beasts Learning XP: 400. Requires a skull or hide of the beast’s species and its occupied lair within Willpower yards. Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or Fatigued. Consequences: the beast senses the attempted enslavement and considers it a threat. Win Opposed Willpower to control it for Willpower Bonus days, during which it follows clear orders. Failure almost always provokes an attack. At expiry it regains its will and may resent its treatment.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Bind Spirit Within Power Stone
textFields: CN: 32 Type: Any Lore of the Eight Winds Learning XP: 600. Requires a Power Stone and Minor Elemental or similar spirit, with no ingredients, sacrifice or failure consequences. A Leyline Junction (p. 197) or Arcane Fulcrum (p. 198) halves CN. Bind the minor spirit into the stone for the benefits on p. 167. The GM may define variants for other spirits, such as Spites, Ghosts, Spectres, Daemons or Incarnate Elementals, considering their greater will and resentment.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Carve Ogham Stone
textFields: CN: 50 Type: Any Learning XP: 450. Requires quartz-veined granite at least about six feet high and one foot wide, but no ingredients. Before casting, inscribe appropriate attracting or warding symbols; Read/Write, Difficult (−1 SL) Language Magick and Average (+2 SL) Art (Engraving) are required, both Tests successful. Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or Fatigued. Consequences: failure. Create an Ogham stone with Attraction, Containment or Dampening; stones can form a druidic circle (p. 195), though not fully replace Elven or Dwarf waystones.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Create Power Stone
textFields: CN: 64 Type: Any Lore of the Eight Winds Learning XP: 400. No ingredients. At least two apprentices must assist in triangulating the Wind. A Leyline Junction (p. 197) or Arcane Fulcrum (p. 198) halves CN. You and the apprentices spend d10 hours preparing. No failure consequences. Create one Power Stone matching your Lore; this ritual is taught only to selected master wizards and wizard lords.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Conjuration of the Bloody Hidesman
textFields: CN: 85 Type: Lore of Beasts Learning XP: 500. Requires a totem of bones and freshly flensed pelts from eight or more large animals, and Extreme Saturation, an Arcane Fulcrum or a Storm of Magic (Chapter 14). Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or Fatigued. Consequences: everyone within Willpower Bonus yards, including you, takes a Damage +12 freezing Ghur attack ignoring leather and fur armour. The totem becomes an Incarnate Elemental of Beasts (p. 176).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.key: magic:winds-of-magic:ritual:conjuration-of-the-incarnate-elemental-of-death:Conjuration of the Incarnate Elemental of Death
rows.name: Conjuration of the Incarnate Elemental of Death
textFields: CN: 90 Type: Lore of Death Learning XP: 500. Requires an hourglass of powdered monarch’s bones; it becomes part of the Elemental rather than being consumed. Conditions: Extreme Saturation, an Arcane Fulcrum or a Storm of Magic (Chapter 14). Each Channelling Round requires Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or Fatigued. Consequences: everyone within Willpower Bonus yards, including you, takes magical Damage equal to your Willpower Bonus ignoring Toughness Bonus and AP, and gains Prone. An Incarnate Elemental of Death emerges from the hourglass (p. 175).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Conjuration of Jack o’ Cinders
textFields: CN: 85 Type: Lore of Fire Learning XP: 500. Build a huge pyre and keep it burning throughout the ritual. Conditions: Extreme Saturation, an Arcane Fulcrum or a Storm of Magic (Chapter 14). Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or Fatigued. Consequences: everyone within Willpower Bonus yards, including you, gains 4 Ablaze. Summon an Incarnate Elemental of Fire from the pyre (p. 174).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Corrupt Waystone
textFields: CN: 60 Type: Any Dark Lore Learning XP: 450. Access to a waystone is required, with no ingredients or other conditions. Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or Fatigued. Consequences: failure. Corrupt the waystone (p. 194). In a planned leyline, this stops the flow; magic stagnates at the nearest uncorrupted upstream stone, and the next stone becomes the new gathering stone from which flow resumes. Saphery’s High Elf Mages notice quickly and prioritise investigating and hunting those responsible.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Create Construct
textFields: CN: 60 Type: Any Lore Learning XP: 400. Requires a suitable body, with no other conditions. Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or permanent loss of 1 Strength or Toughness. Consequences: failure. Animate the body as a magical Construct using p. 30’s default profile and optional Traits.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Create Familiar
textFields: CN: 45 Type: Any Lore Learning XP: 250. Prepare a vessel (examples and details on p. 180); an idea or concept doubles CN. No conditions apply. Permanently sacrifice one Wound, Fate point or point of maximum Fortune. Failure destroys the vessel. Create a Power Familiar assisting magic, a Spell Familiar with its own wizardry, or a Combat Familiar guarding you. It is an independent Character bound to obey and protect you regardless of affection, can improve, and may be played by another Player (p. 184). A second familiar requires CN 80 and two Wounds, Fate Points or points of maximum Fortune. Humanoid form is assumed; the GM assigns abilities, drawbacks and CN adjustments for different or more complex forms using the printed familiar table.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Permanent Resilience expenditure converted to maximum Fortune (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Create Waystone Property
textFields: CN: 40 Type: Any Learning XP: 300. Requires a waystone active in a planned leyline (p. 193), with no ingredients. Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or Fatigued. Consequences: failure. Give it Amplification, Containment, Dampening or Refraction (p. 194 onwards). Disrupting the flow to the Great Vortex may eventually bring investigation and punishment from Saphery’s High Elf Mages.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Cursecraft
textFields: CN: 50 (25) Type: Any Lore Learning XP: 200 (100). Parenthesised costs apply to Witchcraft, Daemonology, Necromancy and all Chaos Lores. Requires access to the item, but no ingredients or other conditions. Permanently sacrifice 1 Wound that never heals and undergo Moderate Exposure to Corruption (WFRP p. 182). Failure destroys the ingredients. Give the item a boon with a deliberate ironic or dangerous bane, agreed by player and GM; examples are on p. 170.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Imbue Staff
textFields:
CN: 35 Type: Any Lore of the Eight Winds Learning XP: 100. Requires a quarterstaff or similar-length metal rod and Lore-appropriate decorations, but no ingredients or other conditions. Spend 1 Fortune, recoverable normally. Failure destroys the ingredients. The result is an Enchanted Staff (p. 152).

The printed Resolve sacrifice is converted to Fortune by Appendix I.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Resolve expenditure converted to Fortune (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Invocate Daemon
textFields: CN: Daemon’s Willpower Type: Lore of Daemonology Learning XP: 400. Know at least one name the Daemon uses and cause significant mayhem, suffering or death during the ritual. Cast Octagram first (WFRP p. 256). Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or permanent loss of 1 randomly chosen Strength or Toughness. Consequences: the Daemon notices your attempt, usually taking offence. It manifests in the Octagram for Intelligence Bonus days, then returns to Chaos. You can communicate, but it need not answer or obey. The player and GM decide further bargains, sacrifices and services.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Materialise the Living Swamp
textFields: CN: 40 Type: Lore of Death, Life, Shadows, Hedgecraft or Witchcraft Learning XP: 400. Requires a heartstone (p. 179) and organic matter, but no ingredients. Conditions: Heavy, Extreme or Corrupted Saturation, an Arcane Fulcrum or a Storm of Magic. Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or permanent loss of 1 randomly chosen Strength or Toughness. Consequences: failure. Form an obedient Fenbeast (p. 179) lasting Willpower Bonus days; Extreme Saturation extends its lifespan while it remains there. Dismiss it at will into sludge.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Remove Curse
textFields: CN: 40 Type: Any Lore Learning XP: 200. Requires the cursed item, confirmed by successful Decipher Curse (p. 26), but no ingredients. Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Cool or Moderate Exposure to Corruption (WFRP p. 182). Consequences: failure. You may remove all the item’s boons and banes; a weapon retains Magical.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: The Crossed Scythes
textFields: CN: Entity’s Willpower Type: Lore of Death Learning XP: 400. Requires engraving tools, but no ingredients. Before casting, carve crossed downward-pointing scythes above an entrance with an Extended Challenging (+0 SL) Art (Engraving) Test totalling 20 SL; an Undead creature to suppress must be beyond it. Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Cool or 1 Damage ignoring Toughness Bonus and AP. Failure alerts the entity. After completion, non-Construct Undead crossing must pass Very Difficult (−30) Cool or be blocked and gain one Fatigued per −SL, even if normally immune. They may retry next turn, accumulating Fatigued until successful; only a full night’s rest removes these Conditions. Construct Undead instead Test Very Difficult (−30) Endurance; failure blocks passage and causes 1 Wound per −SL.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Secret Signs (Brotherhood of Grimnir)
textFields: Read and leave concealed group-specific messages or warnings. Listed specialisations: Grey Order, Guild (Any One), Ranger, Scout, Thief and Vagabond.
Grey Order Guilder Hedgefolk Knightly Order Miner Ranger Scout Smuggler Thief Vagabond

rows.name: Trade (Mason)
textFields: Practise a craft/service and understand its associated knowledge. Listed specialisations: Apothecary, Calligrapher, Chandler, Carpenter, Cook, Embalmer, Engineer, Herbalist, Shipwright, Smith and Tanner.

Apothecary Art Supplies Barber Boatbuilder Brewer Calligrapher Carpenter Cartographer Chandler Cook Embalmer Engineer Engraver Explosives Farrier Gunsmith Herbalist Poisoner Printing Shipwright Smith Tanner Tinker

rows.name: Runesmithing
textFields: Forge, reactivate or deactivate magical runes. Merely learning a rune grants no item; rune crafting remains outside character creation.

rows.name: Sail (Skycraft)
textFields: Operate flying machines using this Advanced Skill. Take-off/landing require Average (+2 SL) Tests. Skycraft and ordinary Sail do not unlock one another; situational operations are not automated.

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Lore (Anatomy)
textFields: Recall knowledge in a studied or experienced subject. Routine facts need no Test; unusual/obscure information does. Listed specialisations: Engineering, Geology, Heraldry, History, Law, Local*, Magic, Metallurgy, Science and Theology.

Art Astrology Beasts Chaos Chemistry Daemons Dragons Dwarfs Engineering Folklore Genealogy Geography Geology Giants Heraldry Herbs History Law Local Magic Medicine Metallurgy Oceans Politics Prophecy Rats Reikland Riverways Routes Science Sigmar Spirits Taxes The Empire Theology Trolls Warfare Witches Wrecks

rows.name: Ancestral Grudge
textFields: Choose a culture or faction, such as Orcs, Goblins, Skaven, Trolls or Khorne Daemons, and enter an unfulfillable Blood Grudge against it in your Book of Grudges (p. 33). Each significant victory, including destruction, recovery of stolen property or many kills, grants 50 XP. Each purchase targets a different faction. The GM may increase rewards for narrower targets: for example, 75 XP for a particular Goblin tribe or 100 XP for a particular Human family.

rows.name: Bludgeoner
textFields: Winning an Opposed Test to activate Pummel causes one extra Stunned Condition per Bludgeoner level.

legacy.adaptation: Fourth Edition per-rank bonus on the listed Tests omitted; printed purchase limit and effects retained, by user-approved adaptation.

rows.name: Crew Commander
textFields: As an Action, pass a Challenging (0 SL) Leadership Test to aid a crew within earshot using a Crewed weapon. For its next attack with that weapon, crew members may use your Ranged Skill.

legacy.adaptation: User-approved Fourth Edition adaptation: printed Initiative Bonus purchase limit and explicit Leadership/crew effect retained. No old default per-rank Talent Test bonus; situational crew effects are reference-only.

rows.name: Demolisher
textFields: Activating Hack adds +1 Damage per Demolisher level against the struck armour or shield. Against enemies in cover with a Hack weapon, treat hard cover as medium, medium as soft and soft as no cover.

legacy.adaptation: Fourth Edition per-rank bonus on the listed Tests omitted; printed purchase limit and effects retained, by user-approved adaptation.

rows.name: Dragon Belcher
textFields: When you fire a Blackpowder weapon, each targeted enemy failing its Cool Test gains one additional Broken Condition per Dragon Belcher level.

rows.name: Entrenchment
textFields: While you occupy soft cover, attacks against you are Hard (−2 SL) rather than Difficult (−1 SL). In medium cover, they are Very Hard (−3 SL) rather than Hard (−2 SL).

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I). Fourth Edition per-rank bonus on the listed Tests omitted; printed purchase limit and effects retained, by user-approved adaptation.

rows.name: Forgefire
textFields: While you are Engaged, melee weapons held by you or allies within Willpower Bonus yards gain Penetrating. An already Penetrating weapon instead ignores one more point of non-metal armour.

rows.name: Glorious Demise
textFields: Gaining Unconscious lets you interrupt turn order for an immediate Melee attack as a Free Action before becoming incapacitated. Gaining Stunned lets you spend one Fortune point for an immediate Free Action Melee attack. Your next Turn proceeds normally; if still Stunned, you cannot take an Action.

rows.name: Harpooner
textFields: On a Crossbow Critical Hit, you may add +10 per Harpooner level to the Critical Hit table roll, maximum 00. Each Crossbow bolt lodged by Impale also reduces the target’s Movement by 1, minimum 1.

rows.name: Kingsguard
textFields: Enemy attacks against allies within 2 yards suffer −10 per Kingsguard level. This never protects you and does not apply while you have any Condition.

rows.name: Liquid Fortification
textFields: After an alcoholic drink, gain +10 Strength and Toughness, including immediately for that drink’s Consume Alcohol Test regardless of its result. The bonus lasts one hour after your last drink. Further drinks extend it without increasing either bonus above +10.

legacy.adaptation: Fourth Edition per-rank bonus on the listed Tests omitted; printed purchase limit and effects retained, by user-approved adaptation.

rows.name: Long Memory
textFields: Perfectly recall the time, date, place, visible faces and exact spoken commitments at significant events you participated in during the campaign. Events before the campaign may require an Intelligence Test based on elapsed time, from Easy (+4 SL) for months to Hard (−2 SL) for a century.

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I). Fourth Edition per-rank bonus on the listed Tests omitted; printed purchase limit and effects retained, by user-approved adaptation.

rows.name: Magic Defiance
textFields: You may Reverse Tests required by a spell’s effects and Magic Resistance Tests to dispel magic.

legacy.adaptation: Fourth Edition per-rank bonus on the listed Tests omitted; printed purchase limit and effects retained, by user-approved adaptation.

rows.name: Master Rune Magic
textFields: Each purchase teaches one master rune from pp. 127–131, restricted to any runic forms named by this Talent. Forge it through the Forge Rune Endeavour (full rules p. 121). The first purchase also teaches all three Doom Runes (p. 132).

legacy.adaptation: Fourth Edition per-rank bonus on the listed Tests omitted; printed purchase limit and effects retained, by user-approved adaptation.

rows.name: Maverick
textFields: Ignore the −20 penalty to Ranged attacks while using the Flight Trait.

legacy.adaptation: Fourth Edition per-rank bonus on the listed Tests omitted; printed purchase limit and effects retained, by user-approved adaptation.

rows.name: Rune Magic
textFields: Each purchase teaches one non-master rune from pp. 127–131. Obey any specified runic form or exact rune restriction. Inscribe it through the Forge Rune Endeavour.

legacy.adaptation: Fourth Edition per-rank bonus on the listed Tests omitted; printed purchase limit and effects retained, by user-approved adaptation.

rows.name: Short Fuse
textFields: Explosive weapons you use gain +1 Blast Rating per Short Fuse level.

rows.name: Tireless
textFields: When applying Fatigued penalties, ignore one Fatigued Condition plus one per Tireless level. For example, four Conditions with two levels leave one effective Condition and a −10 penalty to all Tests.

rows.name: Underminer
textFields: Attacking while Prone or otherwise beneath your target carries no penalty, and enemies receive no attack bonus against you for being Prone. Gain an extra +20 to hit a Surprised enemy when emerging from a tunnel, pit or other concealed position below it.

legacy.adaptation: Fourth Edition per-rank bonus on the listed Tests omitted; printed purchase limit and effects retained, by user-approved adaptation.

rows.name: Whirlwind of Death
textFields: As an Action, spend one Fortune to make a Melee attack against every creature Engaged with you. The GM selects one enemy to Oppose. On success, apply the same normally calculated Damage to the same Hit Location on all Engaged creatures. No Criticals apply, but enemies reduced to 0 Wounds suffer Critical Wounds normally. You cannot combine other special attack options. Dual Wielder permits Reversing this Melee Test when wielding two weapons.

rows.name: Craftsman (Mason)
textFields: Choose a Trade specialisation. Gain Advantage on its Tests and may Advance it regardless of Career. Each further purchase selects a different Trade.

rows.name: Master Tradesman (Mason)
textFields: Choose a Trade specialisation. On successful Tests with it, use either rolled SL or the units-die result as SL. Further purchases choose different Trades.

rows.name: Artistic (Tattoo)
textFields: Choose an art form, such as painting or poetry. Gain Advantage on Art Tests in that medium and may always Advance Art regardless of Career. Each further purchase chooses a different form.

rows.name: Savant (Runes)
textFields: Choose a Lore specialisation you possess and gain Advantage on its Tests. Each further purchase selects a different Lore.
