rows.name: Rune of Cleaving
textFields: Each Rune of Cleaving adds +1 Damage to this weapon.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Retribution
textFields: For Critical Wounds this weapon causes, you may add +20 per Rune of Retribution to the Critical Wound table roll.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Cutting
textFields: Successful hits with this weapon may ignore 2 armour AP per Rune of Cutting.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Daunting
textFields: Drawing this weapon grants Fear with a Rating equal to its Runes of Daunting. If you already have Fear, add +1 to its Rating per rune.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Fire
textFields: Drawing the weapon lights its blade, illuminating 20 yards. Enemies it damages gain one Ablaze Condition. With two or three Runes of Fire, it can also make Ballistic Skill ranged attacks at Willpower Bonus Range with Blast 4: these cause no Damage but give one Ablaze Condition per rune.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Fury
textFields: While wielding this weapon, gain one Dual Wielder level per Rune of Fury, even beyond the Talent’s normal maximum.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Grudge Rune
textFields: Choose an enemy against whom you hold a Blood Grudge (p. 84). Each Grudge Rune gives this weapon +10 to hit and +1 Damage against that enemy. If the target dies, choose a new Blood Grudge enemy at the adventure’s end.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Might
textFields: Against a target larger than you, each Rune of Might adds +3 Damage to this weapon.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Speed
textFields: Carrying this weapon in combat grants +10 Initiative per Rune of Speed.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Striking
textFields: Attacks with this weapon gain +10 to its matching Melee specialisation per Rune of Striking. The bonus does not apply to another weapon, including a similar weapon held in your other hand.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Alaric the Mad
textFields: This weapon’s attacks ignore the target’s armour AP, Qualities and every other benefit of that armour.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Breaking
textFields: Destroy an opponent’s magic weapon used in a Melee Test when this weapon successfully attacks against their Melee opposition, or successfully Opposes their attack with Melee.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Flight
textFields: Use this as a Thrown ranged weapon with Range SB×3 and Accurate. After dealing Damage, it returns to your hand.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Skalf Blackhammer
textFields: Every successful attack with this weapon scores a Critical.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of the Slayer
textFields: Choose an enemy type, such as Daemons, Undead, Dragons, Goblins or Elves. When this weapon attacks that type, you may Reverse the attack Test and its Critical Wound table rolls.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Snorri Spangelhelm
textFields: A failed Melee Test with this weapon becomes a success at 0 SL. An opponent can still defeat the attack by scoring more SL on the Opposed Test.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Haste
textFields: Grants Fast, with a −30 penalty to Melee defence Tests against this weapon instead of −10.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Force
textFields: While wearing the armour, a successful charging Melee attack adds Damage equal to your highest location AP for each Rune of Impact.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Fortitude
textFields: Wearing the armour grants +10 Toughness per Rune of Fortitude.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Iron
textFields: Wearing the armour grants +2 Wounds per Rune of Iron. Remove these Wounds when taking it off; this may cause a Critical Wound if you are badly injured.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Resistance
textFields: While wearing the armour, gain +10 per Rune of Resistance on Tests to Oppose incoming Melee attacks.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Shielding
textFields: While wearing the armour, reduce Damage from incoming ranged attacks and spells by 2 per Rune of Shielding. Damage reduced to 0 or less causes no Wound loss.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Stone
textFields: Each Rune of Stone adds +1 armour AP. Armour bearing only Runes of Stone is exempt from the Rule of Pride and works even within 100 yards of an identical suit.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Adamant
textFields: While wearing the armour, you may Reverse a Critical Wound table roll made when you suffer a Critical Wound.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Gromril
textFields: Removes Weakpoints. Only a Runic Flaw (p. 126) can Damage this armour; Talents and effects such as Penetrating cannot reduce its AP. Effects that bypass armour and directly cause Wounds still work.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Steel
textFields: While wearing the armour, lose at most 10 Wounds from each instance of Damage.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Clear Sight
textFields: Hold the talisman to your eye to ignore penalties from non-magical fog, mist, smoke or similar vapours. Two Runes of Clear Seeing also pierce magical vapours and permit clear sight in complete darkness.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Truth
textFields: Touch the talisman to a fake, forgery, counterfeit or deliberately devalued item and it shines. Two Runes of Disclosure also expose magical illusions or copies; three show the bearer exactly how the deception was made.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Far Sight
textFields: Hold the talisman to your eye to see clearly up to one mile away. Two Runes of Farseeing extend this to two miles; three extend it to four.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of the Furnace
textFields: While worn, prevents Ablaze and heat exposure, and reduces incoming fire or flaming-attack Damage by 4 per Rune of the Furnace.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Luck
textFields: While worn, grants one Fortune point per Rune of Luck, even above normal maximum Fortune. Remove those points when taking it off, minimum 0 Fortune. They cannot return until the next session.
rows.label: Rune

legacy.adaptation: Permanent Resilience expenditure converted to maximum Fortune (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Rune of Restoration
textFields: After a good night’s sleep wearing it, recover Toughness Bonus Wounds per Rune of Restoration.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Spellbreaking
textFields: While wearing it, activate a Rune of Spellbreaking before a Magic Resistance Willpower Test to count as rolling 01. Each rune can activate once per adventure.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Spelleating
textFields: After you dispel a spell with Magic Resistance while wearing it, its caster cannot attempt that spell for your Willpower Bonus in Rounds. Two Runes of Spelleating change this to hours; three change it to weeks.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Warding
textFields: While worn, lets you impose −10 per Rune of Warding on attacks or spellcasting Tests targeting you.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Balance
textFields: While worn, when an enemy you can see casts a spell, you may Reverse their Spellcasting Test, or your Opposed Willpower Test if within Magic Resistance range.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Industry
textFields: While worn, allows one extra Endeavour between adventures.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Kingship
textFields: While worn, allows you to Reverse Charm, Intimidate or Leadership Tests targeting a Dwarf or a group mostly made up of Dwarfs.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Passage
textFields: While worn and moving at walking pace or slower, lets you pass through fixed solid objects, including trees, stone and metal cages. You cannot pass through animals or Undead, or finish a Move inside a solid object.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Spite
textFields: When a Melee attack damages you, its attacker immediately takes 2d10 Damage to a random location, reduced normally by Toughness Bonus and AP.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Alarm
textFields: A Small or larger creature entering range triggers a loud alarm. Two Runes of Alarm can instead play a recorded sentence; three can instead send a recorded telepathic message any distance to the crafter or their nearest living descendant.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Battle
textFields: Affected allies start combat with one Momentum per Rune of Battle.
rows.label: Rune

legacy.adaptation: Fourth Edition Advantage references converted to Momentum (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Rune of Courage
textFields: Affected allies gain +10 to Psychology Tests per Rune of Courage.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Discovery
textFields: The crafter selects one metal or gem per Rune of Discovery, such as gold, diamond, gromril, iron ore, obsinite, ithilmar or brightstone. The item shines when a selected material is within range.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Enemy Detection
textFields: Define a creature category or description per rune, from Skaven or obvious Chaos worshippers to one-eyed red-haired women. The rune glows crimson when a clear match enters range.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Locking
textFields: Locks in range cannot be picked or forced except by magic or their key. Two Runes of Locking also block magic. Three block the key too, allowing only the crafter or nearest living descendant to open them at will. Breaking the protected chest or door still bypasses the lock.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Purification
textFields: Affected allies gain +20 per Rune of Purification on Tests against toxins in air or water.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Retribution
textFields: Desecrating a body in range, including theft from the dead or necromantic casting, immediately gives the offender one Ablaze Condition per Rune of Retribution.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Sanctuary
textFields: Affected allies gain +10 per Rune of Sanctuary to Magic Resistance Willpower Tests to dispel.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Slowness
textFields: An enemy Running to Engage an affected ally loses 4 yards of Run distance per Rune of Slowness, to a minimum of its Walk distance.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Verminkill
textFields: Rodents, Skaven and rat-based creatures such as Rat Ogres lose 2 Wounds per Rune of Verminkill upon entering range or starting a Turn there. Ignore Toughness Bonus and AP.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Expel Chaos
textFields: Affected allies may Reverse Tests against corruption, Tests to avoid mutations from Corruption, and rolls on Physical or Mental Corruption Tables. When engaged with a Daemonic enemy with Unstable, count the ally as having +2 Momentum when calculating Unstable Wound loss.
rows.label: Rune

legacy.adaptation: Fourth Edition Advantage references converted to Momentum (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Master Rune of Grimnir
textFields: You may Reverse enemy Ranged attack Tests targeting affected allies.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Grungni
textFields: You may Reverse enemy spellcasting Tests targeting affected allies.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Stromni Redbeard
textFields: Affected allies start combat with one Momentum. This rune’s range doubles to 12 yards, or 24 yards on a battle standard.
rows.label: Rune

legacy.adaptation: Fourth Edition Advantage references converted to Momentum (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Master Rune of Valaya
textFields: Affected allies may Reverse Magic Resistance Willpower Tests to Oppose casting. Magic Resistance has no range limit for them: they may Oppose spells against any visible target and dispel persistent spells as well as incoming spells.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Accuracy
textFields: This weapon gains +10 to hit per Rune of Accuracy.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Burning
textFields: A hit from this weapon gives one Ablaze Condition per Rune of Burning.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Forging
textFields: The crew may activate a Rune of Forging to cancel a Fumble, Misfire or both when using this weapon. Each rune works once per adventure.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Penetrating
textFields: Each Rune of Penetrating adds +2 Damage to this weapon.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Reloading
textFields: Reduce this weapon’s Reload Rating by 2 per Rune of Reloading. At 0 or below, remove Reload. A Salvo weapon retains a minimum Reload Rating of 1.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Seeking
textFields: Against flying enemies, this weapon gains +20 to hit per Rune of Seeking.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of the Stalwart
textFields: Dwarfs crewing this weapon start combat with one Momentum per Rune of the Stalwart. Leaving the crew or becoming Engaged removes this extra Momentum.
rows.label: Rune

legacy.adaptation: Fourth Edition Advantage references converted to Momentum (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Rune of the Valiant
textFields: Dwarfs crewing this weapon gain +10 Willpower per Rune of the Valiant.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Defence
textFields: The crew always has hard cover: Ranged attacks against them suffer −30.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Disguise
textFields: Enemies cannot see this weapon until it fires, after which it stays visible for the combat. Its crew remains visible and moving it still makes noise.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Immolation
textFields: Any Dwarf in the crew may activate this as a Free Action, destroying the weapon. Every creature within 6 yards suffers Damage 15 to a random location, reduced by Toughness Bonus and AP. Survivors gain Ablaze.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Master Rune of Skewering
textFields: Once per adventure, activate before a Ranged attack roll with this weapon to count as rolling 01. A successful attack also scores a Critical and can strike any chosen location.
rows.label: Rune

rows.name: Rune of Hearth and Home
textFields: Requires an Anvil of Doom and a Hard (−2 SL) Runesmithing Action (p. 132). Until the next Round ends, Dwarfs within 25 yards may count as rolling 01 on Cool Tests.
rows.label: Rune

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Rune of Oath and Steel
textFields: Requires an Anvil of Doom and a Hard (−2 SL) Runesmithing Action (p. 132). Dwarfs within 25 yards gain +2 AP to worn armour until the next Round ends.
rows.label: Rune

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Rune of Wrath and Ruin
textFields: Requires an Anvil of Doom and a Hard (−2 SL) Runesmithing Action (p. 132). Each enemy within 25 yards takes Damage 12 to a random location, reduced by Toughness Bonus and AP.
rows.label: Rune

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Martial Arts
textFields: Remove Undamaging from your unarmed attacks. Each later rank unlocks one Quality: Damaging, Defensive, Distract, Fast, Penetrating, Precise or Pummel. At combat’s start or your turn’s start, select one unlocked Quality to last until your next turn.

rows.name: Sword-dancing
textFields: Gain Ritual of Cleansing free. Further techniques each cost 100 XP per technique already known. Performing them requires a Greatsword of Hoeth except in the book’s older traditions. Performance and Yenlui effects remain references.

rows.name: Blessed by Isha
textFields: Elf only. Obtain the everqueen’s blessing in Ulthuan or Ariel’s in Athel Loren to unlock High Magic. See pp. 79–80 for all training requirements.

rows.name: High Magic
textFields: Requires Blessed by Isha and one Channelling (Qhaysh) Advance. High Magic spells cost 200 XP per Intelligence Bonus band already known: 200, 400, 600, etc. No free spell is specified. The printed Talent adds rank to High Magic Overcasting SL and removes individual Wind-access restrictions for Colour casting.

legacy.adaptation: User-approved one-purchase limit; the printed rank-based Talent gives no maximum.

rows.name: Lileath’s Blessing
textFields: Printed maximum: Initiative Bonus. Each rank adds +1 SL to Channelling (Qhaysh) Tests and allows one more simultaneous Ward-granting aura spell. Situational effects remain descriptive.

rows.name: Uncouth Uranai
textFields: Reduce Standing by one when dealing with High Elves of Caledor, Ellyrion, Avelorn or Saphery. This does not apply in Eataine or the Outer Kingdoms. A cultural starting Talent; it does not permanently reduce general Status.

rows.name: Blood of Aenarion
textFields: Optional High Elf ancestry: gain one starting Fate and choose Magical Prodigy or Martial Prodigy. A rolled mental-corruption result is a Psychology, not a Mutation. Make a weekly Average (+2 SL) Cool Test or enter Yenlui (Dark). Permanent effects and XP reductions apply in the creator; play effects remain references.

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Craftsman (Jeweller)
textFields: Choose a Trade specialisation. Gain Advantage on its Tests and may Advance it regardless of Career. Each further purchase selects a different Trade.

rows.name: Master Tradesman (Jeweller)
textFields: Choose a Trade specialisation. On successful Tests with it, use either rolled SL or the units-die result as SL. Further purchases choose different Trades.

rows.name: Artistic (Poetry)
textFields: Choose an art form, such as painting or poetry. Gain Advantage on Art Tests in that medium and may always Advance Art regardless of Career. Each further purchase chooses a different form.

rows.name: Hatred (Dark Elves)
textFields: Choose a group to Hate, such as beastmen, goblins, orcs, monsters, outlaws, Sigmarites, undead or witches. On encountering it, pass a Psychology Test or immediately seek its destruction by the fastest, deadliest means. Against it, gain +1 SL on Melee and Ranged Tests and immunity to its Intimidate and Fear, but not Terror. Full Hatred rules: p. 184.

rows.name: Fearless (Dark Elves)
textFields: Choose an enemy group, such as Giants, Skeletons or Trolls, and become immune to fear it causes. Each further purchase chooses another group.

rows.name: Fearless (Sea Monsters)
textFields: Choose an enemy group, such as Giants, Skeletons or Trolls, and become immune to fear it causes. Each further purchase chooses another group.

rows.name: Bless Arrow
textFields: Make one non-magical arrow magical and add +1 Damage.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Calm
textFields: Touch the target and pass Challenging (+0 SL) Fellowship to remove their Prejudice, Animosity, Fear and Frenzy effects.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Greenfinger
textFields: Touched living plants grow at their natural rates to full size and productivity even in poor conditions. Touched dead plants return within one day to their former living state.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Identify Disease
textFields: Learn the names and effects of all diseases affecting a person, animal or plant.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Remove Dirt
textFields: Touch an object, person or animal to remove its dirt completely. On a surface, clean a circle Willpower Bonus yards across.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Reveal Magic
textFields: Magical objects and creatures in range glow visibly, even when hidden. Wizards count only if affected by a spell. Elven Arcane spells require every relevant Arcane Magic (Lore) Talent and the ability to channel every listed Wind before purchase. Channel them using your least proficient Channelling Skill, applying the least favourable abundance or scarcity modifier among their Winds.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Enchant Plant
textFields: Winds: Ghyran, Chamon. Give a non-magical plant one permanent, dispellable enchantment: Hardy resists poor light, dry soil and adverse temperatures; Nourishing halves the Encumbrance of edible produce needed for food; Vessel allows binding a Lesser Daemon, Minor Elemental or soul as into a Power Stone. A plant can carry only one enchantment.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Assigned to the latest acquired Colour Lore for Fifth Edition prices and training counts.

rows.name: Lesser Banishment
textFields: Winds: Hysh, Shyish. Win an Opposed Willpower/Cool Test to banish a Ghost, Spectre, Lesser Daemon or Daemonic Beast to its original spirit realm or Realm of Chaos. Wraiths, Greater Daemons and other powerful entities are unaffected. Banishment causes no Damage or destruction, and the target can be summoned again.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Assigned to the latest acquired Colour Lore for Fifth Edition prices and training counts.

rows.name: Magic Alarm
textFields: Winds: Azyr, Ulgu. Monitor a chosen area. Any creature or spirit of Tiny Size or larger entering it alerts you at any distance, waking you immediately if asleep. Learn their exact number but not their types.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Assigned to the latest acquired Colour Lore for Fifth Edition prices and training counts.

rows.name: Masking the Mind
textFields: Winds: Shyish, Ulgu. Intuition Tests against you and Casting Tests targeting you with mind-reading or scrying are Very Hard (−3 SL). You can be forced to speak, but not to speak truthfully.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I). Assigned to the latest acquired Colour Lore for Fifth Edition prices and training counts.

rows.name: Purify Body
textFields: Winds: Ghyran, Hysh. Pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance to remove one disease or poison from another creature. A Fumble gives you that disease or poison.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I). Assigned to the latest acquired Colour Lore for Fifth Edition prices and training counts.

rows.name: Speak with Animal
textFields: Winds: Azyr, Ghur. Speak with an animal in a language others cannot understand. Anyone knowing Anoqeyån may understand with Average (+2 SL) Language (Magick). The animal is not charmed; you may use Charm rather than Charm Animal when speaking to it. Its Intelligence limits the conversation’s complexity.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I). Assigned to the latest acquired Colour Lore for Fifth Edition prices and training counts.

rows.name: Voice of Iron
textFields: Winds: Aqshy, Chamon. Normal speech and shouting carry three times their usual distance, unaffected by barriers or competing noise. Gain +10 on Intimidation and Leadership Tests. Hostile listeners may negate that bonus by noticing the unnatural voice with Difficult (−1 SL) Perception. Whispers gain no effect.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I). Assigned to the latest acquired Colour Lore for Fifth Edition prices and training counts.

rows.name: Zone of Comfort
textFields: Winds: Aqshy, Ghur. Creatures with both Swarm and Size (Tiny or Little) cannot attack you. Ignore Cold and Heat Exposure (WFRP p. 181), and reduce Damage from cold or heat attacks by 1.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Assigned to the latest acquired Colour Lore for Fifth Edition prices and training counts.

rows.name: Apotheosis
textFields: The target heals Willpower Bonus Wounds and gains Fear 1 temporarily. Overcasting: each +3 SL adds Willpower Bonus Wounds healed; +6 SL also heals a Critical Wound on Challenging (+0 SL) Fellowship; +10 SL resurrects the target at full Wounds with its normal appearance and abilities and a magical halo. It dies after Willpower Bonus minutes or if Apotheosis is Dispelled, and cannot be revived again. Gain Yenlui (Dark).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Arcane Unforging
textFields: Deal 1 Damage to the body per 2 AP worn across all Hit Locations, allowing Toughness Bonus but ignoring AP. On Challenging (+0 SL) Channelling, also destroy one random carried magic item. Overcasting: each +1 SL destroys 1 random worn AP after Damage; +3 SL and Average (+2 SL) Dexterity reveal all carried magic items and let you choose which to destroy; +8 SL increases Damage to 1 per AP.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Coruscation of Finreir
textFields: Gain Flight (Agility) (WFRP p. 339) and 5 AP everywhere, using the higher of these AP or worn armour at each location. Overcasting can create an Arcane Fulcrum (Winds of Magic p. 198) granting casters within Willpower Bonus yards +1–5 SL (1d10 /2) to Casting, rerolled each Round. +5 SL creates a Warp Rift within Willpower Bonus yards in terrain or mid-air; it is a Malignant Influence (WFRP p. 236), and you lose −3 Yenlui. +8 SL creates a Magic Portal in solid terrain within that range; it is more stable and augments only one chosen Colour Lore and High Magic.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Curse of Arrow Attraction
textFields: Shooters may reroll missed missile attacks against affected targets, including magical ammunition and war machines but excluding magic missiles. Overcasting: +4 SL removes shield AP and Defensive when Opposing missiles, though shields can still block them; +6 SL and Challenging (+0 SL) Ballistic Skill let you choose missile Hit Locations against cursed targets.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Deadlock
textFields: Temporarily suppress one persistent spell or magic item; weapons and armour retain their ordinary function. Alternatively, prevent a caster using one spell you know from seeing them cast it or reading their grimoire. Overcasting: +6 SL suppresses a Waystone, Ogham Circle, Herdstone or Leyline Junction’s Channelling/Casting bonus (Winds of Magic pp. 194–197), but not an Arcane Fulcrum; gain Yenlui (Light). +9 SL suppresses an Arcane Fulcrum’s Magical Flux control (Winds of Magic p. 192); gain Yenlui (Light).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Drain Magic
textFields: Immediately Dispel persistent spells in the area without Extended Tests and remove accumulated channelled magic. Magic items and Ward are unaffected. Overcasting: +5 SL expands the area to Willpower yards and Difficult (−1 SL) Intelligence lets you exempt allies and yourself; +7 SL also Dispels persistent Blessings and Miracles and grants Yenlui (Light); +10 SL also suppresses magic items and Ward, and requires casters to pass Challenging (+0 SL) Channelling or lose spellcasting for 24 hours.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Fiery Convocation
textFields: Each creature initially in the area takes a Damage +5 magic missile and 1 Ablaze Condition, repeated each subsequent Round even after leaving the area. Full immersion in water or sand removes the effect. Overcasting: +5 SL raises Damage to +6 in Round 2 and another +1 each following Round; gain Yenlui (Dark). +8 SL and Challenging (+0 SL) Weapon Skill let you exempt allies.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Fortune is Fickle
textFields: The target Miscasts on every double on Channelling or Casting, regardless of Talents, ingredients or other protections. Their Casting cannot Critical, and Dispelling fails on doubles. Second Sight sees the distracting spirits as malign Qhaysh elementals. Overcasting: +4 SL makes doubles automatically fail non-spellcasting actions too; +6 SL makes Channelling/Casting doubles Major Miscasts and grants Yenlui (Dark).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Glamour of Teclis
textFields: Each Round, targets failing Very Hard (−3 SL) Navigation can only wander in a random direction at walking speed. Others see no maze, only dazed targets. After a target fails 3 Tests, Average (+2 SL) Leadership lets you choose its direction for the remainder; Test again for every change. Overcasting: +3 SL makes the effect last Intelligence Bonus hours for targets failing three Navigation Tests and grants Yenlui (Dark); +6 SL and Challenging (+0 SL) Agility let you exempt allies.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Greater Banishment
textFields: Each Round, Daemonic and Undead creatures in the area take a Damage +8 magic missile, or +15 at Large Size or above; Unstable doubles this Damage. Destroyed Daemons cannot be summoned for 1,001 days; destroyed Undead can never be summoned again. Make a free Dispelling attempt against each Witchcraft, Daemonology, Necromancy, Dark Magic or Chaos spell in the area. Overcasting: each +1 SL adds +10 to Dispelling Tests; +4 SL and Average (+2 SL) Fellowship suppress evil or Chaotic magic items for the duration; +7 SL increases Damage to +15, or +30 at Large Size or above, and grants Yenlui (Light).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Hand of Glory
textFields: Allies gain 3d10 to one chosen Characteristic: Weapon Skill, Ballistic Skill, Strength, Toughness, Initiative or Agility. Roll once for every target. Alternatively increase Movement by 2. Increased Toughness does not change Wounds. Overcasting: +3 SL removes all Broken Conditions from allies within Fellowship Bonus yards; +6 SL replaces the usual benefit with +3d10 to “all four Characteristics” (one roll shared across them) and +2 Movement; +8 SL removes all Broken and Fatigued Conditions from allies within Fellowship Bonus yards, heals them 1d10 Wounds, grants Immunity to Psychology (WFRP p. 340) for the duration, and gives Yenlui (Light).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Invisible Eye
textFields: Create a controllable invisible eye with Perception equal to your Language (Magick), Acute Sense (Sight) and Flight 120. Use its senses while your body is in a trance. It cannot pass solid objects and is destroyed by 3 Damage if detected. If someone interacts with your body, you may refocus on it, destroying the eye and gaining Surprised. Overcasting: +4 SL grants the eye Magical Sense, Second Sight and Dark Vision; +8 SL increases Range to Intelligence miles.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Shield of Saphery
textFields: Allies in the area gain Ward 9+. Each further High Magic spell you cast improves that Ward by 1. Overcasting: each +3 SL improves Ward by 1; +4 SL changes Range to half Willpower yards.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Soul Quench
textFields: A Damage +6 magic missile. Slain targets cannot become Ghosts or have their souls bound into leylines, Power Stones, Tree Kin or similar vessels. Overcasting: +3 SL turns slain bodies to dust; +7 SL doubles Range and Target, raises Damage to +11, and grants Yenlui (Dark).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Tempest
textFields: The tempest follows random vortex movement (Winds of Magic p. 21), skipping steps 1–2 and moving 2d10 yards at step 3. Each Round, creatures in the area take a Damage +4 magic missile and must pass Average (+2 SL) Athletics or lose 20 WS and BS for the tempest’s duration. Flying targets instead take Damage +5 and −1 SL on Athletics. Overcasting: +4 SL also requires Challenging (+0 SL) Cool to move; flying failures fall 50 yards per Round, and all BS Tests take −30. +5 SL also inflicts a Damage +15 magic missile each Round on buildings and war machines in the area. +8 SL and Challenging (+0 SL) Initiative let you exempt allies.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Walk between Worlds
textFields: Allies gain Ethereal and double Movement. Overcasting: +5 SL and Hard (−2 SL) Willpower extend Duration to Intelligence Bonus minutes; +8 SL lets targets at a suitable geomantic nexus use the Paths of the Old Ones to reach any other nexus you choose, regardless of distance.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Artist’s Touch
textFields:
Give a non-magical item you are crafting Fine. Other Qualities and Flaws are determined normally.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Patience of Vaul
textFields:
For a non-magical item you are crafting, reduce each required Extended Test’s SL total to one quarter without reducing the finished quality.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Vaul’s Grace
textFields:
Give a non-magical weapon or armour piece you are crafting Lightweight. When crafting a magical item, still Test Trade (Smith) to determine its other Qualities or Flaws.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Vaul’s Rage
textFields:
Your forge explodes. Others within Willpower Bonus yards take a Damage +6 magic missile to a random location ignoring Armour, gain 2 Ablaze, and must pass Dodge or gain Prone and Stunned. Everyone within 2 × Willpower Bonus yards takes a Damage +3 hit to a random location and 1 Ablaze. Flammable terrain ignites. You and your tools are unaffected.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Divination of Flames
textFields:
Sacrifice: 1 item. Detect and remotely see every creature within Intelligence yards of the targeted forge or campfire, including hidden creatures, regardless of line of sight or your distance. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +2 SL detects invisible creatures; +3 SL lets you target detected creatures with spells without line of sight, provided they are in range.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Divination of Stones
textFields:
Sacrifice: 1 item. Detect rare minerals useful for magic items and where to dig for buried deposits. The GM decides presence and quantity; mountainous regions have a suggested 50% chance, usually yielding enough for 1d10 Encumbrance of magic items. These minerals improve the crafting Lore (Magic) Test from Very Hard (−3 SL) to Difficult (−1 SL) (Archives II p. 54). Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +3 SL also detects ithilmar, found only at Vaul’s Anvil in Caledor.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Fires of Perfection
textFields:
Sacrifice: Blindness. Ignore any Flaws, Quirks or Curses rolled while crafting the targeted magical item (Archives II p. 54). Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +5 SL allows another crafting spell of Vaul on that item despite its normal non-magical-item restriction.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Wisdom of the Skysteel
textFields:
Sacrifice: Blindness. With the required ithilmar ore and rare minerals, use a Crafting Endeavour to forge a non-magical ithilmar item, reducing its Encumbrance by 2 (minimum 0). Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +4 SL instantly makes an ithilmar item as brittle as dry wood and shifts you towards Yenlui (Dark). +6 SL permits crafting a magical ithilmar item (Archives II p. 54), without another enhancing spell of Vaul; choose this option only at the start, but make progress only while this spell remains active.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Fortress of Hotek
textFields:
Sacrifice: Blindness. Give your forge’s chamber or building one defence: Flame Barrier surrounds it with Firewall (WFRP p. 248); Magical Armour protects you inside with Glittering Robe (p. 250); Metal Ward applies Crucible of Chamon (p. 249) to metal touching its walls, with exemptions chosen at casting; Strengthened Doors makes ordinary doors TB 5/W 15 and reinforced doors gates at TB 10/W 30, harmed only by siege weapons. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: each +2 SL adds one further listed defence.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Fishbonding
textFields:
Befriend a non-magical, non-predatory fish of any Size; a fish that would not normally attack an Elf qualifies. Hostile fish become neutral towards you but may attack allies; neutral fish become friendly and defend you if able; friendly fish can be ridden with the appropriate Ride Skill. This does not enable communication.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Stormsense
textFields:
Learn nearby storms’ direction, movement speed, intensity, duration, whether they are strengthening or subsiding, and whether they are magical.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Ocean’s Fury
textFields:
Create a non-magical, undispellable storm: Near Gale for Willpower Bonus minutes, Strong Gale for the next Willpower Bonus minutes, then Violent Storm for the remaining duration (Sea of Claws p. 107).

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Spirits of the Waves
textFields:
Summon a wind elemental from ocean currents. While concentrating you move it 2d10 yards per Round; otherwise it follows random vortex movement (Winds of Magic p. 21). A struck ship suffers a Critical Hit to rigging (Sea of Claws p. 118). Within 50 yards, Visibility improves one level and Wind intensity drops one level (p. 106). Each +3 SL summons another elemental.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Armour of Mathlann
textFields:
Sacrifice: +2 Fatigued Conditions. A single-masted ship’s hull gains Armour 2 with no weight penalty (Sea of Claws p. 97); rigging and crew are excluded. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: each +2 SL permits a ship one mast larger; +4 SL grants Armour 3 instead; +6 SL also protects rigging and crew against missiles.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Call of the Seas
textFields:
Sacrifices: +2 Fatigued Conditions and −2 Wounds. Summon a Merwyrm (Sea of Claws p. 145), emerging after one full Round that does not count towards Duration. You cannot communicate with or control it. For Fishbonding it counts as neutral and non-predatory during the spell. It returns to the sea when the spell ends. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +5 SL makes it friendly for Fishbonding; +8 SL prevents its departure at expiry and shifts you towards Yenlui (Dark).

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Cloak of Mathlann
textFields:
Sacrifices: +2 Fatigued Conditions and −1 Wound. Fog conceals a single-masted ship and crew, imposing −3 SL on perception and ranged attacks against it. Challenging (+0 SL) Perception can notice its wake or fog eddies. Black arks and sea monsters are excluded. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: each +2 SL permits one additional mast; +8 SL permits black arks and sea monsters and shifts you towards Yenlui (Dark).

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Mistress of the Deep
textFields:
Sacrifices: +1 Fatigued Condition and −1 Wound. Summon a stationary, non-attacking Oceanid. Each Round, characters within 20 yards must pass Difficult (−1 SL) Cool or become Helpless (WFRP p. 162), able only to approach it. Use Syreen (Sea of Claws p. 145), Naiad (Death on the Reik Companion p. 88, recommended) or Siren (Imperial Zoo p. 86). It swims away when the spell ends. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +5 SL exempts you from its song; +3 SL lets you direct its movement at Movement 6, but not attacks.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Waterlungs
textFields:
Sacrifice: +1 Fatigued Condition. The target breathes underwater as easily as air. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +4 SL also makes sight, hearing and smell work underwater as in air; a separate +4 SL option makes air cause Drowning and Suffocation (WFRP p. 181), draws the target towards water and permits breathing from a bucketful, shifting you towards Yenlui (Dark).

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Writhing Mists
textFields:
Sacrifice: +1 Fatigued Condition. Allies in the mist gain +20 Stealth, and ranged attacks against them take −20 to hit. Leaving the area removes protection. The mist is stationary and ends if you stop concentrating. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +3 SL lets you move it up to Willpower Bonus yards each Round; a separate +3 SL option gives allies inside Fear 1.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Divine Stylus
textFields:
Write luminous characters with your fingertip on solid surfaces or in mid-air, using any language you know. They shed candlelight and last Willpower Bonus hours. You cannot draw pictures.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Enlightenment
textFields:
An animal gains +20 Intelligence and Willpower and loses Bestial and Skittish. It can understand and express more complex ideas, but may forget information when the spell ends.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Arcane Insight
textFields:
Learn an item or artefact’s magical abilities, curses and bound beings. Challenging (+0 SL) Intelligence reveals how it was made; extra SL provide information about its creator. Understanding a powerful artefact well enough to duplicate or repair it may require an Extended Intelligence Test across repeated castings.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Greater Spirit Bond
textFields:
For an Animal Familiar you already possess, extend Animal Telepathy and Companion’s normal 4-yard range to Willpower miles (Archives III pp. 81–82). The distant bond cannot help spellcasting, but can work with Messenger and Sensory Sharing.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Crucible of Light
textFields:
Sacrifice: Extended Difficult (−1 SL) Research, 10 SL total. Make a sword magical with Fast. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +3 SL adds Defensive or Precise; +5 SL gives it a mind and gives its wielder one level each of Combat Aware, Reaction Strike and Riposte; +7 SL makes bestowed Qualities permanent if cast during forging, with only one attempt per sword.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Mnemonic Control
textFields:
Sacrifice: Extended Difficult (−1 SL) Research, 10 SL total. The target’s next Lore or non-magical Language Test automatically succeeds with SL equal to your Casting SL. There must be a plausible reason they encountered that knowledge before. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +2 SL permits the automatic success on their next Casting Test instead; +3 SL permits erasing one specific memory, excluding Skills and spells.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Psychic Sending
textFields:
Sacrifice: Extended Difficult (−1 SL) Research, 10 SL total. Send a mental spoken message lasting up to one minute, in your own voice, to someone you previously met or corresponded with. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +3 SL includes a mental image; +4 SL permits a stranger whose full name you know.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Sacred Wards
textFields:
Sacrifice: Extended Difficult (−1 SL) Research, 20 SL total. Ward an area with one effect, optionally exempting those with a password: Forgetfulness erases the last 24 hours’ memories on entry; Purity deals Mutations × 6 Damage ignoring Toughness Bonus/AP and bars Daemons; Surveillance lets you view the area by concentrating for a Round; Truthfulness prevents lies inside. Cast only once per area, but renew before expiry with CN 0, keeping the original area, duration and effects. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +6 SL extends Duration to Intelligence Bonus weeks.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Soulcraft
textFields:
Bind a Ghost into a waystone or leyline, with both in range. A mortal dead no more than one hour can have its ghost bound before departing for the spirit realm. An unwilling Ghost Opposes your Casting with Cool, increasing the effective CN by 1 per SL it scores.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: The Primary Words
textFields:
Sacrifice: Extended Hard (−2 SL) Research, 20 SL total. Communicate basic ideas with any mortal creature or animal. Advanced ideas may require Intelligence Tests by either or both parties. Others hear gibberish; those knowing Anoqeyån can grasp the exchange with Average (+2 SL) Language (Magick). Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +2 SL enables advanced communication with species predating the Old Ones, including Dragons, Great Eagles, Fimir and most animals; +4 SL enables basic communication with spirits, elementals and Daemons.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99).
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Ritual of Cleansing
textFields: Perform thirty precise forms over several minutes to enter meditation. At sunrise, you may shift Yenlui towards Light; at sunset, towards Dark.
rows.label: Technique

rows.name: Flight of the Phoenix
textFields: While not Engaged, throw your sword SB + WPB yards for its normal Damage with Penetrating. Each +1 SL adds 1 yard of Range and +1 Damage.
rows.label: Technique

rows.name: Path of the Sun
textFields: Gain one War Leader Talent level (WFRP p. 147) for Willpower Bonus Rounds. Each +1 SL grants another level or extends the effect by one Round.
rows.label: Technique

rows.name: Path of Frost
textFields: For Weapon Skill Bonus Rounds, successful strikes ignore 1 AP. During that period, add +10 to Critical Wound table rolls per +1 SL on the Sword-dancing Test.
rows.label: Technique

rows.name: Path of the Storm
textFields: For Initiative Bonus Rounds, Oppose any missile attack with Melee (Two-handed); each +1 SL on the Sword-dancing Test adds one Round. This can break arrows and split gunpowder shot.
rows.label: Technique

rows.name: Path of the Rain
textFields: For Agility Bonus Rounds, gain +1 SL to Dodge Tests. Each +1 SL on the Sword-dancing Test adds another +1 SL to Dodge and one Round.
rows.label: Technique

rows.name: Shadows of Loec
textFields: Move up to SL × Movement yards, minimum 5 yards; terrain and obstacles apply normally. Enemies previously Engaged with you must pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Initiative Test or gain Surprised.
rows.label: Technique

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Path of the Hawk
textFields: Choose a target within Willpower Bonus yards. On a failed Difficult (−1 SL) Endurance Test, it suffers 10 + Sword-dancing SL Damage, ignoring armour but applying TB, and two Deafened Conditions. Each +1 SL on the Sword-dancing Test can add 1 yard to range and one target.
rows.label: Technique

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Path of Falling Water
textFields: Make one attack against every enemy Engaged with you and within weapon reach. Against an enemy with Swarm, you may make three attacks instead.
rows.label: Technique

rows.name: Final Stroke of the Master
textFields: The opponent must pass a Very Hard (−3 SL) Dodge Test or take the blow at +4 Damage, plus +1 Damage for each +1 SL on your Sword-dancing Test.
rows.label: Technique

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Badwill
textFields:
Fellowship Tests in the area take −10, and Prejudice becomes Hatred. You may exempt yourself. The effect may attract malicious spirits.

Blood and Bramble p. 6: Hedgecraft spells require ingredients. A successful Lore (Herbalism) foraging roll provides 1 + SL ingredients; the printed purchase price is 5 brass pennies.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Bonesetter
textFields:
Hold the broken limb while the patient bites prepared bark and leather. Within one week of a Broken Bone injury (Fourth Edition core p. 179), reduce its healing time by 1d10 days plus another 1d10 per SL on the Casting Test, to a minimum of one day. Each broken bone can benefit only once.

Blood and Bramble p. 6: Hedgecraft spells require ingredients. A successful Lore (Herbalism) foraging roll provides 1 + SL ingredients; the printed purchase price is 5 brass pennies.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Cleanslate
textFields:
Immerse the target in running water or douse them with clean spring water. Resolve a Dispel attempt (Fourth Edition core p. 237) as though all required SL were achieved in one round. This removes most harmful magic, but excludes effects from worn or carried items, the items themselves, and non-magical consequences of magic such as Ablaze. Powerful curses may need further ingredients or trials; casting reveals these requirements.

Blood and Bramble p. 6: Hedgecraft spells require ingredients. A successful Lore (Herbalism) foraging roll provides 1 + SL ingredients; the printed purchase price is 5 brass pennies.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Fertilise
textFields:
Invoke the earth’s spirits and relieve yourself at the field’s four corners. Next season’s harvest will be at least average for that field despite weather, pests, poor soil or similar problems. The customary fee is one twentieth of its yield.

Blood and Bramble p. 6: Hedgecraft spells require ingredients. A successful Lore (Herbalism) foraging roll provides 1 + SL ingredients; the printed purchase price is 5 brass pennies.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Fetterfetch
textFields:
Enchant a dowsing instrument for a spirit you can name. Anyone can use it to find that spirit’s fetter: a nature spirit’s home, or a ghost’s remains, valued object or connected person. Following it requires an Extended Difficult (−1 SL) Navigate Test, one Test per hour, needing 5–15 SL according to distance, concealment and deliberate obstruction. Destroying a fetter usually banishes a spirit or releases a ghost, but killing a loved one may transfer the ghost’s bond to the killer. Resolving unfinished business or communicating for it may instead release it; an unwilling or hostile ghost can resist such efforts. The GM should give a ghost Regenerate while it defends its fetter.

Blood and Bramble p. 6: Hedgecraft spells require ingredients. A successful Lore (Herbalism) foraging roll provides 1 + SL ingredients; the printed purchase price is 5 brass pennies.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Geistbane
textFields:
Enchant a prepared oil-and-herb mixture. Applied to house entrances, it requires spirits to pass Hard (−2 SL) Willpower to enter. Applied to a weapon, it counts as magical against spirits, ghosts and Undead requiring magical attacks. Against Undead vulnerable to normal weapons, or on an already magical weapon, it instead grants Damaging against those creatures. Harming a living creature with the weapon ends the enchantment.

Blood and Bramble p. 6: Hedgecraft spells require ingredients. A successful Lore (Herbalism) foraging roll provides 1 + SL ingredients; the printed purchase price is 5 brass pennies.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Kindle
textFields:
Light gathered kindling. While fuel remains and the spell lasts, ordinary means cannot extinguish the fire. Endurance Tests against cold gain +20. Food cooked on it cannot burn, and rancid or poisoned ingredients become safe to eat.

Blood and Bramble p. 6: Hedgecraft spells require ingredients. A successful Lore (Herbalism) foraging roll provides 1 + SL ingredients; the printed purchase price is 5 brass pennies.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Onerion
textFields:
Prepare a powder of herbs and sleepless owl droppings for one drink, plus one additional drink per SL. Each must be consumed before the duration ends. The drinker’s next sleep contains one dream of your chosen kind, with details you specify or supplied by their subconscious. You can include a message, interpreted by the dreamer. Effects are psychological; a nightmare may cause a Fatigued Condition the following day.

Blood and Bramble p. 6: Hedgecraft spells require ingredients. A successful Lore (Herbalism) foraging roll provides 1 + SL ingredients; the printed purchase price is 5 brass pennies.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Stout Spirit
textFields:
Enchant up to 10 swigs of strong alcohol in a container. Each drinker automatically passes their first Fear Test during the duration. After this benefit, their effect ends and cannot benefit them again before the next dawn.

Blood and Bramble p. 6: Hedgecraft spells require ingredients. A successful Lore (Herbalism) foraging roll provides 1 + SL ingredients; the printed purchase price is 5 brass pennies.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Trankraft
textFields:
Enchant a bowl of hot broth for one person, who must immediately drink it all; some Hedgewise traditions also call for an appreciative burp. For the duration, the drinker ignores Fatigued Conditions from exertion or exposure, but not magic. Those Conditions return when the spell ends and remain until proper rest.

Blood and Bramble p. 6: Hedgecraft spells require ingredients. A successful Lore (Herbalism) foraging roll provides 1 + SL ingredients; the printed purchase price is 5 brass pennies.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Woecharm
textFields:
Infuse jewellery with ill will. Once willingly worn, it causes minor daily misfortunes and gives −10 to Gamble Tests, −10 to Tests resisting harmful magic, and +20 to Critical Wound severity rolls. Second Sight detects the curse only while an effect is occurring; Detect Artefact can identify it.

Blood and Bramble p. 6: Hedgecraft spells require ingredients. A successful Lore (Herbalism) foraging roll provides 1 + SL ingredients; the printed purchase price is 5 brass pennies.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Godspakt
textFields:
Choose a spirit and a task, then cast at a place resonant with that spirit. Success summons it to perform your request. Most demand payment, increasing with the task; the GM chooses the demand, which can involve material or unusual sacrifices.

Blood and Bramble p. 6: Hedgecraft spells require ingredients. A successful Lore (Herbalism) foraging roll provides 1 + SL ingredients; the printed purchase price is 5 brass pennies.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Banishment of Böl
textFields: Target a creature with Daemonic or Undead. If its Willpower is lower than yours, it turns its attention from you to whatever it would otherwise attack. Otherwise win an Opposed Cool Test for this effect. Its attention returns to you when the new target dies; you may cast again. Presenting a personal memento lets you direct it towards a particular suitable person instead.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Bonesnapper
textFields: Mark a stone from a ruined building or monument with your own blood. Throw it as a Rock or use it as an Improvised Weapon (Fourth Edition core p. 295). If it inflicts at least 1 Wound, the victim must pass Difficult (−1 SL) Endurance or suffer Broken Bone (Minor) at that location (Fourth Edition core p. 179), without a Critical Wound. The effect ends after causing one Broken Bone or when the duration expires.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Congeal
textFields: The target loses 1 + SL Bleeding Conditions. For each removed, you may give them one Fatigued Condition. If you impose any Fatigued Conditions, they must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or gain Unconscious. This spell cannot inflict Bleeding through the Lore of Witchcraft effect.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Curse of the Treacherous Tongue
textFields: Crush a dried deer or other ungulate tongue. Unless the target passes Hard (−2 SL) Cool, you choose the next sentence they speak. It uses their normal voice and delivery; you cannot force them to start speaking. After that sentence they regain control, know what they said without knowing why, and may contradict it. Listeners are not compelled to believe it.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Fatethief
textFields: The target Tests Hard (−2 SL) Endurance and loses 1 Fortune point either way. Failure also prevents gaining Fortune points for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Lodestone
textFields: Dip a lodestone or other magnetic material into the target’s blood, which must be no more than a day old. For the duration it points towards the blood’s owner while they live, without indicating distance. The spell targets the stone, so the owner’s Resistance (Magic) and similar protections do not apply.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Mirrored Abyss
textFields: Touch a reflective surface no larger than your Willpower Bonus in yards to make a portal into a dark, silent realm. Anyone entering is trapped and must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance each day or disappear forever. Living prisoners may pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool to appear in nearby reflective surfaces. A second casting can free them; other solutions may exist. Dispelling only closes an open portal and does not release prisoners.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Outcast’s Curse
textFields: Unless the target passes Challenging (+0 SL) Willpower, everyone meeting them feels suspicious and uneasy, and their Fellowship-based interaction Tests take −20 for the duration. Acquaintances can ignore the unease if they choose and have reason to suspect witchcraft. Second Sight and similar senses detect Dhar indistinguishable from a witch’s own residue.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Pactbind
textFields: Cut your hand with a ritually prepared Dhar-infused blade and state an agreement. Another living creature must willingly cut their hand with it and clasp yours, accepting the exact terms without amendment. Any commitments you state also bind you. Each subject must fulfil the literal agreement to the best of their ability; the GM interprets it. A subject receives one warning before a breach. Breaking it causes frailty until they make amends with the caster, or the other subject if the caster breached it: every Wound loss adds a Bleeding Condition, each Fatigued Condition becomes two, and Critical Wound severity rolls gain +40. Ordinary Dispel (Fourth Edition core p. 237) cannot remove it; effects specifically removing curses can. The caster immediately senses its removal.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Painjar
textFields: Use a dying creature’s preserved pain, such as its bottled last breath. A target failing Hard (−2 SL) Cool rolls a random hit location and Critical Wound. It suffers the result’s other penalties for the duration, including apparent lost limbs, Stunned or Prone, but no extra Wounds or Bleeding Conditions. The injury appears real only to the victim. All these effects end with the spell; the GM may impose a further Stunned Condition for trauma.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

rows.name: Wayward Path
textFields: Walk the entire chosen path while chewing herbs and offal. For the duration, anyone following that route becomes lost and returns to their starting point, whether following you or travelling independently. In settlements, only those taking your exact route are affected; crossing it does nothing. Those sensing the Winds recognise magic but remain lost until it is dispelled.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Nameless Summons
textFields:
Prepare a circle up to Willpower Bonus yards across and invite an entity without controlling its identity or conduct. After casting, Test Challenging (+0 SL) Cool and add its SL to 1d10 on the Nameless Summons table. The GM decides the entity, requests, demands and actions; it may demand payment or attack. It remains indefinitely while inside the circle. On leaving, it returns after up to its Willpower Bonus Rounds (minimum 1).

Nameless Summons table (p. 17), printed results: −5 or worse: a greater daemon’s forelimb drags you into its realm; Hostile; gift: your flesh, blood and soul. −4 to −0: a Lesser Daemon or powerful spirit (Cairn Wraith or Tomb Banshee); Hostile; immediate sacrifice of 1d10 living, sentient creatures. +0 to +4: a Lesser Daemon or powerful spirit; Neutral; sacrifice of one living, sentient creature. +5 to +9: a Lesser Daemon or powerful spirit; Favourable; promise of a future sacrifice or great service. +10 or better: a Greater Daemon interested in speaking rather than killing outright; Neutral if demands are met, Hostile otherwise; future great service and your essence at death.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Craftsman (Artist)
textFields: Choose a Trade specialisation. Gain Advantage on its Tests and may Advance it regardless of Career. Each further purchase selects a different Trade.

rows.name: Master Tradesman (Artist)
textFields: Choose a Trade specialisation. On successful Tests with it, use either rolled SL or the units-die result as SL. Further purchases choose different Trades.

rows.name: Savant (Ranald)
textFields: Choose a Lore specialisation you possess and gain Advantage on its Tests. Each further purchase selects a different Lore.

rows.name: Distant Sounds
textFields: Listen clearly to a specific known target or noise anywhere in range, including behind walls or in sealed rooms. You must know the target’s location. You may also whisper to them.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Long Reach
textFields: Extend your reach by the Range with invisible arms. You can grasp or manipulate objects, hold a ladder or ledge, lift up to 2 Enc, and make Sleight of Hand Tests.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Lose the Loot
textFields: Touch illicitly acquired goods to sense who and where will buy them at a decent price. In a large town or city, this points to the nearest Fence. The GM decides their attitude, but with no Sin Points they should at least trade with you.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Silence Reigns
textFields: Everyone in the area hears only ordinary background noise; footsteps, barking and other sudden sounds are concealed.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Poor Man’s Face
textFields: Valuables carried on you are hidden with Ranald for the duration; searches find worthless substitutes. Each hour an object remains hidden gives a 1% chance that Ranald keeps a valuable permanently.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Talk Your Way Out
textFields: Gain a single +8 SL bonus to a Charm Test made to talk your way out of being caught red-handed.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: The Heat Is Off
textFields: After a crime, people and authorities overlook you for the next few hours and struggle to recall your presence. Subtract 3 when calculating watch presence using the patrol rules (p. 92). Fellowship-based Tests against Fel take −3 SL because others cannot concentrate on you. Attempting another crime ends the Miracle.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Bountiful Fortune
textFields: Each chosen companion may reverse the percentile dice on their next Test. The benefit expires if unused within Fellowship Bonus Rounds.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Crisis of Confidence
textFields: Choose someone in range about to attempt a voluntary Fellowship-based Test. They abandon the attempt. If they must make the Test regardless of choice, it instead takes −20.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Force the Hand of Chance
textFields: Gain +1 SL on a specified Test. You may repeatedly roll 1d10, adding another +1 SL for each result of 6 or less and stopping whenever you choose. Any result of 7 or more removes every bonus gained and gives −1 SL on the original Test instead.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Perfect Empathy
textFields: While speaking with someone, understand their meaning, intentions and current thoughts perfectly, regardless of language.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: The Gamemaster
textFields: On observing a game, sport or similar pastime, learn its rules and best strategies. If it depends on mental skill rather than chance or physical prowess, competing Tests gain +4 SL. When the Miracle ends, you retain only the rules.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Up the Stakes
textFields: Make a Test normally. Success becomes an Astounding Success; failure becomes an Impressive Failure.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: A Suitable Sucker
textFields: For the duration, you may reroll results on the Contents of a Purse (p. 28) and Victim Quirk (p. 29) tables. A chosen reroll must be accepted.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Bamboozle
textFields: A Human-sized creature failing Hard (−2 SL) Cool follows your directions for its next round. You cannot order direct self-harm, though indirect harm is possible. Undead and Daemonic creatures are immune.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Named Fourth Edition Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364). Ordinary printed numerical bonuses remain unchanged.

rows.name: One Almighty Lie
textFields: Tell and roleplay an outrageous lie, then invoke the Miracle. If the Pray Test succeeds, add its SL to d10 and apply that total as bonus SL on your Charm Test. The GM may award further SL for an entertaining, implausible lie.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Ranald’s Mischief
textFields: For an Opposed Test against one adversary, temporarily match two of your Characteristics to theirs. Roll twice on this d10 table, rerolling duplicates: 1–2 Weapon Skill; 3–4 Intelligence; 5–6 Fellowship; 7–8 Initiative; 9–0 any Characteristic of your choice.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Unremembered Face
textFields: Each creature you meet must pass Hard (−2 SL) Cool to recall more than two facts about your appearance. You choose those two facts.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Named Fourth Edition Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364). Ordinary printed numerical bonuses remain unchanged.

rows.name: Back At You
textFields: Choose a combat in range in which you are not participating. Compare its participants’ S, T and WS; the one higher in at least two is stronger. While the Miracle lasts, Wounds that participant inflicts in one attack may be added to the next Damage the weaker participant inflicts on them.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Class War
textFields: A Gold Tier target suffers Curse of Ill-Fortune (Fourth Edition core p. 255) for one day per level of Gold Standing, plus one day per Pray SL. Habitual adherence to Ranald’s strictures prevents the curse.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Free Your Mind
textFields: You or a chosen target automatically resist Charm and Leadership Tests made by someone of higher Status than that target.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Moment of Clarity
textFields: Gain Immunity to Psychology for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Rally Round
textFields: Allies in the area gain +2 SL to Endurance and Cool Tests, plus another +1 SL per 10 people in the crowd. Silver and Gold Status characters receive no benefit.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Under my Protection
textFields: Choose an authority figure who has threatened or persecuted a particular victim. From their next sleep, the target has nightmares and must Test Challenging (+0 SL) Cool each morning or gain a Fatigued Condition. Treating their victims kindly or otherwise making amends ends the dreams.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Named Fourth Edition Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364). Ordinary printed numerical bonuses remain unchanged.

rows.name: Auroch’s Heart
textFields: The target adds your Fellowship Bonus as SL to all Toughness Tests for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Earthshudder
textFields: Within Fellowship Bonus yards of a chosen point, targets must pass Difficult (−1 SL) Athletics or gain Prone. Constructed structures in the area take d10 + SL damage.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Named Fourth Edition Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364). Ordinary printed numerical bonuses remain unchanged.

rows.name: Nature’s Repast
textFields: Touch up to six individual meals made from wild foraged or hunted food. Each eater can go four days before needing an Endurance Test against starvation. The quantity of food and number of people it feeds do not increase.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Pax of Taal
textFields: Natural animals with Intelligence 25 or less in the area become peaceful and attack nothing, including prey and each other. Bipedal and Chaos-twisted creatures are excluded. Attacking affected animals ends the effect on them.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Rending Paw
textFields: You or one ally gain +20 Strength for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: River’s Blessing
textFields: For the duration, gain +4 SL on Swim Tests and move through water at your full Movement rate rather than half. This has no effect in salt water.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Wild Wind
textFields: You are unaffected. Other targets in the area take −2 SL on WS and Agi Tests and must pass Difficult (−1 SL) Toughness each round or gain Prone. Ranged attacks cannot be made within the area; only gunpowder and artillery weapons may attack into it.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Named Fourth Edition Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364). Ordinary printed numerical bonuses remain unchanged.

rows.name: Wilderness Way
textFields: Invoke before a journey period using Chapter 7, Pathfinding (p. 112). Record Pray SL as rerolls available for Planning, Travel or Camp Endeavour results during that journey period. An encounter removes unused rerolls. You may invoke again before the next journey stage.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Bilebrew
textFields: Drink a mixture of spleen and gall. You and friendly Ogres in the area gain Hatred of a target or group you choose.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Bloodgruel
textFields: Suck blood and marrow from a severed limb, then Test Easy (+4 SL) Endurance. Success heals 1 Wound plus 1 per SL; failure gives you Bloody Flux.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty converted to Fifth Edition SL (core Appendix I p. 364).

rows.name: Get Some Guts
textFields: Consume a male Mournfang’s large intestine. Targets ignore Broken Conditions for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Toothcracker
textFields: Chew earth-encrusted bedrock from a mountain peak, then Test Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance; failure costs one tooth per −1 SL. Successful casting gives you and friendly Ogres in the area +20 to Endurance and Cool Tests and +1 AP at every location for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Behave!
textFields: An affected Squig, Giant Wolf, Spider of any Size, or Snotling obeys the Shaman like a trained dog.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Cunnin’ Words
textFields: The Shaman speaks a language understood by the listener.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Curse of Da Bad Moon
textFields: Enemies in the area gain +1 Fatigued Condition and cannot spend Fortune Points for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Gift of the Spider-God
textFields: Affected allies gain Venom at Challenging (+0 SL) potency. Existing Venom becomes Difficult (−1 SL) potency instead.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty converted to Fifth Edition SL (core Appendix I p. 364). Use current core Venom: Wounds inflict Poisoned; Challenging or Difficult specifies recovery Difficulty.

rows.name: Gork’ll Fix It
textFields: The target suffers one Fatigued Condition for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: The Great Green Spite
textFields: During the spell, every successful Goblin melee or ranged strike against an enemy in the area counts as a Critical Hit. A Hobgoblin caster grants this effect to Hobgoblins instead.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Itchy Nuisance
textFields: The target takes −1 SL to every Test for the duration, increased to −2 SL while wearing metal armour.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Mork Wants Ya!
textFields: The target must win an Opposed Strength Test against Strength 80 to escape a giant hand. Failure causes a 10 Damage body hit, then a fall from 2d10 yards.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Night Shroud
textFields: Throw a black-capped nightshade mushroom to create a cloud. Everyone inside gains Blinded and must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Perception when trying to move or gain Prone. Night Vision or Dark Vision makes a character immune to both effects.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Nikkit!
textFields: Attempt to pick a pocket in range using Sleight of Hand 55. After a successful theft, the victim may pass Challenging (+0 SL) Perception to see the conjured hands returning the loot to the Shaman.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Sneaky Stabbin’
textFields: Affected targets’ blows gain Impale and Penetrating.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Vindictive Glare
textFields: A Damage +4 magic missile strikes everyone in the area. Targets taking Damage must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool or gain Stunned.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: ‘Ard as Nails
textFields: The target gains Hatred of all enemies, ignores harmful effects of Conditions and Diseases, and adds +2 SL to Toughness-based Tests.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Bash ‘Em Lads!
textFields: Allocate one Momentum per Casting SL among allied Orcs, Goblins and Hobgoblins in range. Multiple points may go to one target.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed individual Advantage uses Momentum; the Fourth Edition Group Advantage alternative is omitted.

rows.name: Brainbursta
textFields: The target immediately gains Prone and Stunned, plus one additional Stunned per Casting SL. If its Stunned Conditions exceed Toughness Bonus, it must immediately pass Average (+2 SL) Cool or take a Critical Hit to the head.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty converted to Fifth Edition SL (core Appendix I p. 364).

rows.name: ‘Eadbutt
textFields: A Damage +1 magic missile always hits the head. Damage becomes +6 against a target with Aethyric Attunement or Second Sight.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Legacy: user-approved Target 1 resolves printed Target You conflicting with the magic-missile effect.

rows.name: ‘Ere We Go!
textFields: Targets in the area gain +2 Momentum for Melee Tests. For a Hobgoblin caster, the spell targets Hobgoblins instead of Orcs.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed individual Advantage uses Momentum; the Fourth Edition Group Advantage alternative is omitted.

rows.name: The Evil Sun
textFields: Each Round, targets in the area suffer 8 + SL Damage and must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or gain an Ablaze Condition.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Fists of Gork
textFields: Drop everything held and attack only with fists for the duration, using Melee (Brawling) 55 and Weapon (Fists) +9.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Foot of Gork
textFields: All targets in the area gain Prone and take an 8 Damage hit to a random location, ignoring AP. Passing Difficult (−1 SL) Dodge reduces Damage to 4.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty converted to Fifth Edition SL (core Appendix I p. 364).

rows.name: Gaze of Mork
textFields: A Damage +4 magic missile hits every living creature on a straight line along the blast. Structures of Toughness 65 or less also take Damage.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: The Hand of Gork
textFields: Move 1d10 targets to a place in range. They must begin within Willpower Bonus yards of each other. On landing, targets immediately entering Melee gain +1 Momentum in combat.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed individual Advantage uses Momentum; the Fourth Edition Group Advantage alternative is omitted.

rows.name: Mork Save Us!
textFields: For each Casting SL, give one allied Orc, Goblin or Hobgoblin in range Ward 10. An existing Ward improves by 1 instead, but cannot reach 7+ or better this way.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: WAAAGH!
textFields: Orcs, Hobgoblins and Goblins in the area gain 1 Momentum usable for Melee and Ranged Tests, remove all Broken Conditions, and gain +2 SL to Cool and Endurance for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed individual Advantage uses Momentum; the Fourth Edition Group Advantage alternative is omitted.
