rows.name: Die Hard
textFields: Any Critical Wound can heal. For TB Rounds after death, attempt Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance at each Round's start; success restores life at 1 Wound.

legacy.adaptation: User-supplied older-edition definition retained; no direct Fifth Edition equivalent.

rows.name: Corrupting Vomit
textFields: Being hit by Chaos Troll vomit exposes the target to Moderate Corruption.

rows.name: Rotten Regeneration
textFields: Follow core Regeneration, replacing restored Wounds with half of 1d10, rounded down (p. 88).

rows.name: Bileful Vomit
textFields: Use Stream of Corruption (CN 9; special Range/Target; Instant). Immediately make an Unopposed Acid- and Poison-type Breath attack. It is a magic missile dealing TB Damage that ignores AP. Targets losing more than their TB in Wounds must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or contract Blood Rot.

rows.name: That’s No Mound
textFields: Stealthy applies only until the Troll moves or takes an Action.

rows.name: Sated
textFields: Eating an Average-or-larger creature undisturbed removes the Hungry Troll template.

rows.name: Starving
textFields: After 24 hours without food, the Hungry Troll begins suffering Starvation.

rows.name: Water Wise
textFields: The River Troll Hag ignores Stupid while in a body of water; elsewhere it still applies.

rows.name: Purple Skullback Bite
textFields: Being wounded and Poisoned by the bite requires Average (+2 SL) Cool; failure gives 1 Corruption. Forest Goblin Shamans still suffer damage/poison, but gain the printed +2d10 to Channelling and Language (Magick) for 2d10 hours and may reroll Waaagh! Miscasts. These bonuses are temporary.

legacy.adaptation: Printed Average (+20) uses core Average (+2 SL); current Venom inflicts Poisoned on Wounds without an avoidance Test.

rows.name: Chanty (Any)
textFields: Each purchase teaches a different p. 67 chanty. Perform an Entertain (Singing) Test where the crew can hear you. Establishing it takes 30 seconds; its effect then lasts three minutes plus SL minutes and affects the crew. Dodge is your only combat action while singing; the GM may permit other actions such as Perception or Cool Tests. Damage or any failed Opposed Test ends it. Sing one chanty each watch.

legacy.adaptation: User-approved printed Intelligence Bonus limit and effects; old default per-rank Test bonuses omitted. Songs use their printed effects as references only.

rows.name: Master and Commander
textFields: Appropriate Leadership Tests aboard your ship or involving your crew gain +1 SL per Master and Commander level. Applies to individual Leadership and Crew Tests.

legacy.adaptation: User-approved printed Fellowship Bonus limit and explicit per-rank Leadership effect retained. No additional old default Test bonus; situational effect is not automated.

rows.name: Etiquette (Crew)
textFields: Choose a social group, such as Criminals, Cultists, Guilders, Nobles or Soldiers. Appropriate dress and behaviour let you blend in; the GM may warn you when your behaviour would breach that group’s customs.

rows.name: Hatred (Followers of Stromfels)
textFields: Choose a group to Hate, such as beastmen, goblins, orcs, monsters, outlaws, Sigmarites, undead or witches. On encountering it, pass a Psychology Test or immediately seek its destruction by the fastest, deadliest means. Against it, gain +1 SL on Melee and Ranged Tests and immunity to its Intimidate and Fear, but not Terror. Full Hatred rules: p. 184.

rows.name: Bless (Stromfels)
textFields: Gain all Blessings of your deity. Normally only one Bless (Deity) Talent is allowed. Bless is incompatible, in either direction, with Channelling, Arcane Magic, Chaos Magic, Magic Resistance, Petty Magic and Witch! Unlearning costs 100 XP, removes all its Blessings and may incur divine displeasure determined by the GM.

rows.name: Invoke (Stromfels)
textFields: Gain one chosen Miracle of your deity and access to memorise further available Miracles at their listed XP costs. Normally only one Invoke (Deity) is allowed. Invoke is incompatible, in either direction, with Channelling, Arcane Magic, Chaos Magic, Magic Resistance, Petty Magic and Witch! Unlearning costs 100 XP, removes all its Miracles and incurs extreme divine displeasure determined by the GM.

rows.name: Blessings of Bel Shanaar
textFields: Cast while travelling towards a fixed destination whose location you know. For the duration, your Navigation Tests, including Crew Tests involving you, gain +2 SL.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Niezlib’s Optimal Firing Solution
textFields: Cannon-firing Tests gain +1 SL for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Sea of Glass
textFields: Ask everyone aboard to be silent, then close your eyes. Apply Doldrums from the Wind Effect Table (p. 107) for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Living Mire
textFields: Ensnare a ship at sea in seaweed, giving −2 Movement and −3 SL Manoeuvre. Its crew can cut it free with an Extended Challenging (+0 SL) Boat Handling Test requiring your Willpower Bonus + casting SL.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Water Water Everywhere
textFields: Purify seawater and direct it into the ship’s stores to refill empty water barrels.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Whirlpool
textFields: Create Gentle Rotation in the target area (whirlpools, p. 114). Normal Overcasting can enlarge it. Strength options: 5 SL — Whirlpool; 8 SL — Powerful Vortex; 13 SL — A Maelstrom; 21+ SL — The Maelstrom.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Breathe Water
textFields: The target breathes water and ignores Suffocation from drowning in water (WFRP p. 181) for the duration. You cannot invoke this while your own mouth is underwater.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Quell Waters
textFields: Reduce a strait or whirlpool’s M rating to 0 for the duration.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Sea Curse
textFields: Target a ship crewed by those unworthy of Manann’s respect, including Chaos followers, Stromfels worshippers, Orcs and Goblins, Skaven or a crew with negative Manann’s Mood. For the duration, every hit received by that crew gains +2 Damage.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Repel Sea Beast
textFields: A sea creature takes no hostile actions for the duration, unless it suffers Damage or harmful Conditions.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Rip Tides
textFields: A visible ship takes −1 M and −1 SL Man.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessed Voyage
textFields: Invoke when calculating Manann’s Mood. Improve it by 2d10 minus your current Sin Points.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of the Albatross
textFields: An albatross arrives and waits up to 1 hour for sailing, then follows the ship for the duration. While it remains, the ship cannot sink regardless of Damage. Killing it gives the ship −d10 Morale and −2d10 Manann’s Mood. If needed, use the pigeon profile (WFRP p. 316), changed to Small Size and 3 Wounds.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blessing of the Mariner
textFields: The target gains +1 SL on Row, Sail and Swim Tests.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Raging Seas
textFields: Strike a specific target in the sea or on shore with a wave of CR 15.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Send ‘em to Stromfels
textFields: Double the target ship’s Holed Rating (p. 117).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Storm Winds
textFields: Increase wind intensity for one ship by one step for the duration (p. 107), without changing direction.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Blood Trail
textFields: Track an injured person over land or water with Easy (+4 SL) Track, smelling even tiny or partially removed blood traces.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364).

rows.name: Curse of the Harsh Mistress
textFields: The target suffers nightmares. Whenever resting to remove Fatigued Conditions, they must pass Difficult (−1 SL) Cool or retain the Fatigued Condition.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364).

rows.name: Manann’s Mood Made Meaningless
textFields: For your current ship, roll on the Manann’s Mood table below, adding 1 per Sin Point. 1 to 4: Stromfels Triumphant! Treat Mood as 0 for the duration. 5 to 8: Stromfels Ascends! Roll 5d10, adding it to negative Mood or subtracting it from positive Mood. 9: No effect; calculate Mood normally. 10 or more: Manann Provoked! Subtract 5d10 from Mood (p. 130).
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Seasickness
textFields: Give the target Seasickness for the duration, using Sea of Claws p. 125.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Lure of the Lurkerfish
textFields: Hard (−2 SL) Lore (Riverways) identifies the light as a Lurkerfish lure. Failure requires Easy (+4 SL) Cool; fail again and become effectively Unconscious, able only to move towards the light.

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers.

rows.name: Slimy
textFields: When Grappled, a successful Toughness Test gives the Latch-eel +4 SL on later escape Tests. The opponent must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Athletics or either release it or begin Suffocating.

rows.name: Love the Light
textFields: Light/fire attracts Daggerfish rather than deterring them. Despite Bestial, they neither shy from fire nor gain Broken from flaming attacks.

rows.name: Immersion
textFields: Inflicting Entangled through a Grapple pulls the victim inside the Sea Elemental, causing Suffocation. Escape by removing Entangled through Opposed Strength against its Strength 59. The Elemental need not maintain the Grapple, remains free to act and is not Engaged by that victim.

rows.name: Mindless Spellcaster
textFields: Use Strength when Casting or Channelling.

rows.name: Boat Crusher
textFields: Can constrict vessels of Size Large or less. First spend 1 turn wrapping per 10 vessel Size, then Extended Opposed Strength against the vessel's Toughness; SL reaching its Wounds destroys it. Crew may attack or lever it off. A hit inflicting over 7 Wounds forces Average (+2 SL) Cool; failure releases the vessel. Levering uses Opposed Strength: 0–4 SL prevents squeezing that turn; 5+ forces release.

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers.

rows.name: Electrical Discharge
textFields: At the start of a turn after Grappling, spend 1 Momentum to shock the victim: 10 Damage, ignoring non-magical metal armour. If Wounds are lost, Difficult (−1 SL) Endurance or 1 Stunned. Each discharge also requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance from the Gargantuan; failure gives 1 Fatigued. While Fatigued, its shock deals 6 Damage. Shocking a Grappled boat harms no hull, but every crew member takes 6 Damage, or 3 while the Gargantuan is Fatigued.

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers. Printed Advantage uses Momentum.

rows.name: Whale Bane
textFields: Fanged Maw attacks use Venom with Difficult (−1 SL) recovery. Causing Wounds applies Poisoned; the Test Difficulty governs recovery rather than avoiding the poison.

legacy.adaptation: Uses full Fifth Edition Venom rather than the older on-hit interpretation.

rows.name: Syreen’s Call
textFields: Spend an Action singing. Anyone within the Syreen's Initiative in yards must pass Difficult (−1 SL) Cool or become effectively Unconscious and able only to move towards it.

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers.

rows.name: Resistant to Cold
textFields: An Endurance Test may negate the ill effects of cold/ice weapons, spells or other sources.

rows.name: Lure of the Leviathan
textFields: Hard (−2 SL) Lore (Oceans) recognises the underwater light as a lure and allows looking away. Failure requires Easy (+4 SL) Cool or 1 Stunned.

legacy.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers.

rows.name: Devastating Assault
textFields: Charging a ship causes a collision at CR 50.

rows.name: On a Different Scale
textFields: Although Bestial, the Black Leviathan fears only flames at least as large/intense as a large bonfire. The GM similarly judges Fear/Terror by whether the source's size warrants its respect; insignificant threats do not concern it.

rows.name: Marine Creature
textFields: The printed profile assumes water, where full Movement applies. On land, Movement becomes 1 and all Tests suffer −2 SL. Without regular dousing, it begins Suffocating.

rows.name: Arnzipal’s Black Horror
textFields: Everyone in the area must pass Difficult (−1 SL) Strength or suffer 3 Wounds. A Fumble requires spending a Fate Point to avoid being dragged into the Aethyr and killed. Each Turn, the vortex moves 1d10 + 5 yards randomly; use Winds of Magic pp. 20–21 if available, or another random direction method.

rows.name: Invoke (Mathlann)
textFields: Gain one chosen Miracle of your deity and access to memorise further available Miracles at their listed XP costs. Normally only one Invoke (Deity) is allowed. Invoke is incompatible, in either direction, with Channelling, Arcane Magic, Chaos Magic, Magic Resistance, Petty Magic and Witch! Unlearning costs 100 XP, removes all its Miracles and incurs extreme divine displeasure determined by the GM.

rows.name: Shroud of Fog
textFields: Create non-magical fog that limits visibility to 10 yards and cannot be Dispelled.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Uproot the Mountains
textFields: Shake a hill or mountain. At the start of each target’s Round, Very Hard (−3 SL) Athletics is required to avoid Prone and losing all actions and movement. Overcasting: each extra Round of Duration lets you move the terrain Willpower Bonus yards; anyone in its path must pass Average (+2 SL) Athletics or take 10 Damage to a random location. +5 SL can trigger an avalanche, requiring Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge from anyone in its path to avoid 15 Damage to a random location.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed named Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers; existing High Magic definitions and learning rules are preserved.

rows.name: Earth Line
textFields: Slann only; requires a geomantic nexus or leyline within Willpower Bonus miles. Send energy along a leyline in your chosen direction to the next nexus. Anyone on it must pass Hard (−2 SL) Endurance or take 15 body Damage, reduced by Toughness Bonus but ignoring Armour. Overcasting: +4 SL creates an undispellable bridge 8 yards wide along the leyline, of any length across water of any depth, lasting Willpower Bonus hours; +6 SL clears an 8-yard-wide path through forest or jungle along the line.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed named Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers; existing High Magic definitions and learning rules are preserved.

rows.name: Ruination of Cities
textFields: Slann only; requires a geomantic nexus or leyline within Willpower Bonus miles. Collapse an unfortified building, wall or bridge into Difficult terrain. Occupants must pass Hard (−2 SL) Dodge or take 20 body Damage and become buried, suffering Suffocation (WFRP p. 181). Overcasting extra targets must select those nearest the first. Ground between them opens into a crevasse 2 yards wide and 4 yards deep; Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge avoids falling, while a Marginal Failure permits grabbing the edge. +6 SL permits fortified targets such as castle walls or towers.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed named Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers; existing High Magic definitions and learning rules are preserved.

rows.name: Mental Blast
textFields: Slann only; requires a geomantic nexus or leyline within Willpower Bonus miles. Enemies take Intelligence Bonus + 6 Damage, plus 6 if Daemonic or Undead, allowing Toughness Bonus but ignoring Armour. Average (+2 SL) Intelligence is also required to avoid Stunned. Overcasting: +6 SL, The Deliverance of Itza, changes Target diameter to AoE (Half Willpower yards), centred on the caster and expandable normally. +9 SL, The Great Leveller, sacrifices the Slann to kill enough outnumbering enemies in line of sight to equal the Slann’s allies in number, taking lowest Intelligence first. Only spending a Fate Point prevents a Character’s resulting instant death.
rows.label: Magic

legacy.adaptation: Printed named Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers; existing High Magic definitions and learning rules are preserved.

rows.name: Waterlungs (Mathlann)
textFields: Only Elven Priests of Mathlann may use this Miracle. Targets breathe underwater but suffer Suffocation and Drowning in air (WFRP p. 181), feel drawn to water, and need only a bucketful to breathe. Each +2 SL adds one target.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Cloak of Mathlann (Mathlann)
textFields: Only Elven Priests of Mathlann may use this Miracle. A ship and crew become invisible, though those aboard still see its interior. Crew leaving become visible. Challenging (+0) Perception can notice the wake or fog eddies. Beyond one mast, each extra mast requires +2 SL. Black Arks and sea monsters are excluded.
rows.label: Magic

rows.name: Dramatic Injury
textFields: Wounds: 0. Gain 1 Bleeding. After healing, the cheek scar grants +1 SL to suitable social Tests; gain this benefit only once.

rows.name: Struck Forehead
textFields: Wounds: 2. Gain 2 Bleeding and 1 Blinded; Blinded persists until all Bleeding ends.

rows.name: Fractured Jaw
textFields: Wounds: 2. Gain 1 Stunned and Broken Bone (Minor).

rows.name: Broken Nose
textFields: Wounds: 3. Gain 1 Bleeding; fail Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance and also gain Stunned.

rows.name: Major Eye Wound
textFields: Wounds: 3. Gain 1 Bleeding and 1 Blinded; Blinded requires Medical Attention (page 172).

rows.name: Broken Jaw
textFields: Wounds: 3. Gain 2 Stunned and Broken Bone (Major).

rows.name: Major Ear Wound
textFields: Wounds: 3. Gain 4 Deafened and permanently lose hearing in one ear. A repeat permanently removes all hearing.

rows.name: Concussive Blow
textFields: Wounds: 4. Gain 1 Deafened, 1d10 Stunned and Fatigued lasting 1d10 days.

rows.name: Smashed Teeth
textFields: Wounds: 4. Gain 2 Bleeding; lose 1d10 teeth, Amputation (Easy +4 SL).

rows.name: Mangled Ear
textFields: Wounds: 4. Gain 2 Bleeding and 3 Deafened; lose the ear, Amputation (Average +2 SL).

rows.name: Devastated Eye
textFields: Wounds: 5. Gain 2 Bleeding and 1 Stunned; lose the eye, Amputation (Difficult -1 SL).

rows.name: Disfiguring Blow
textFields: Wounds: 5. Gain 3 Bleeding and 2 Stunned; lose eye and nose, Amputation (Hard -2 SL).

rows.name: Mangled Jaw
textFields: Wounds: 5. Gain 4 Bleeding, 3 Stunned and Broken Bone (Major); lose tongue and 1d10 teeth, Amputation (Hard -2 SL).

rows.name: Shattered Skull
textFields: Wounds: Death. Instant death from skull destruction. A suitable blade may instead sever the head, throwing it 1d10 yards in a random direction.

rows.name: Jolted Wrist
textFields: Wounds: 0. Drop anything in that hand.

rows.name: Jarred Arm
textFields: Wounds: 0. Drop held items; the hand counts as lost for 1d10 – TB Rounds, minimum 1 (Amputated Parts, page 177).

rows.name: Bleeding Hand
textFields: Wounds: 1. Gain 1 Bleeding. While it lasts, pass Average (+2 SL) Dexterity before Actions using items in that hand or drop the item.

rows.name: Torn Muscles
textFields: Wounds: 1. Gain 1 Bleeding and Torn Muscle (Minor).

rows.name: Wrenched Arm
textFields: Wounds: 2. Drop held items; the arm is unusable for 1d10 Rounds (Amputated Parts, page 177).

rows.name: Gaping Wound
textFields: Wounds: 2. Gain 2 Bleeding. Until Surgery closes the wound, further arm Wounds add one Bleeding.

rows.name: Ruptured Ligament
textFields: Wounds: 2. Drop held items; Torn Muscle (Major).

rows.name: Clean Break
textFields: Wounds: 2. Drop held items; Broken Bone (Minor). Fail Difficult (-1 SL) Endurance and also gain Stunned.

rows.name: Deep Cut
textFields: Wounds: 3. Gain 2 Bleeding, 1 Stunned and Torn Muscle (Minor).

rows.name: Crushed Elbow
textFields: Wounds: 3. Drop held items; Broken Bone (Major).

rows.name: Dislocated Shoulder
textFields: Wounds: 4. Arm unusable until reset (Amputated Parts, page 177). Extended Average (+2 SL) Heal, 6 SL, resets it; Tests using it then suffer -1 SL for 1d10 days.

rows.name: Severed Finger
textFields: Wounds: 4. Lose a finger, Amputation (Average +2 SL); gain 1 Bleeding.

rows.name: Cleft Hand
textFields: Wounds: 4. Lose 1 finger, Amputation (Difficult -1 SL); gain 2 Bleeding and 1 Stunned. Each subsequent Round without Medical Attention loses another finger. Losing them all removes the hand, Amputation (Difficult -1 SL).

rows.name: Mauled Bicep
textFields: Wounds: 5. Drop held items; gain 2 Bleeding, 1 Stunned and Torn Muscle (Major).

rows.name: Mangled Hand
textFields: Wounds: 5. Lose the hand, Amputation (Hard -2 SL); gain 2 Bleeding.

rows.name: Sliced Tendons
textFields: Wounds: 5. Arm permanently unusable, Amputation (Very Hard -3 SL); gain 3 Bleeding and 1 Stunned.

rows.name: Brutal Dismemberment
textFields: Wounds: Death. The arm is severed or torn off; shock and blood loss cause almost immediate death.

rows.name: Gut Blow
textFields: Wounds: 1. Fail Average (+2 SL) Endurance and vomit: Stunned for 1 Round, plus Besmirched.

rows.name: Bruised Ribs
textFields: Wounds: 2. Agility Tests suffer -1 SL for 1d10 days.

rows.name: Wrenched Collar Bone
textFields: Wounds: 2. Randomly choose an arm; drop its held items. It is unusable for 1d10 Rounds (Amputated Parts, page 177).

rows.name: Cracked Ribs
textFields: Wounds: 2. Gain 1 Stunned and Broken Bone (Minor).

rows.name: Gaping Wound
textFields: Wounds: 3. Gain 3 Bleeding. Until Surgery, further Body Wounds each add one Bleeding.

rows.name: Painful Cut
textFields: Wounds: 3. Gain 2 Bleeding and 1 Stunned. Fail Hard (-2 SL) Endurance and scream; Astounding Failure (-6 SL) also causes Unconscious.

rows.name: Pulled Back
textFields: Wounds: 3. Gain 1 Stunned and Torn Muscle (Major).

rows.name: Arterial Damage
textFields: Wounds: 3. Gain 4 Bleeding; until Surgery, each further Body Damage causes 2 Bleeding.

rows.name: Gut Wound
textFields: Wounds: 4. Gain 2 Bleeding and Festering Wound (Disease and Infection, page 179).

rows.name: Fractured Hip
textFields: Wounds: 4. Gain 1 Stunned and Broken Bone (Minor); fail Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance and also gain Prone.

rows.name: Major Chest Wound
textFields: Wounds: 4. Gain 4 Bleeding. Until Surgery, further Body Wounds each cause 2 Bleeding.

rows.name: Smashed Rib Cage
textFields: Wounds: 5. Gain 1 Stunned removable only by Medical Attention, 1 Bleeding and Broken Bone (Major).

rows.name: Spinal Cord Damage
textFields: Wounds: 5. Gain 3 Stunned and Broken Bone (Major). Legs are permanently unusable, Amputation (Very Hard -3 SL).

rows.name: Internal Bleeding
textFields: Wounds: 5. Gain 1 Bleeding removable only by Surgery; contract Blood Rot (Disease and Infection, page 179).

rows.name: Torn Apart
textFields: Wounds: Death. Death by bisection; the upper half falls in a random direction and showers everyone within 2 yards in blood.

rows.name: Jabbed Toe
textFields: Wounds: 0. Fail Average (+2 SL) Endurance and suffer Disadvantage on Agility-based Tests until your Turn ends.

rows.name: Lost Footing
textFields: Wounds: 0. Fail Challenging (+0 SL) Athletics and gain Prone.

rows.name: Twisted Ankle
textFields: Wounds: 1. Tests relying on that leg, including running, Climb and Dodge, have Disadvantage for 1d10 - Toughness Bonus Rounds, minimum 1.

rows.name: Thigh Strike
textFields: Wounds: 1. Gain 1 Bleeding; fail Average (+2 SL) Endurance and also gain Prone.

rows.name: Twisted Knee
textFields: Wounds: 2. Tests using the leg have Disadvantage for 1d10 Rounds.

rows.name: Bad Cut
textFields: Wounds: 2. Gain 2 Bleeding; fail Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance and also gain Prone.

rows.name: Badly Cut Toe
textFields: Wounds: 2. Gain 1 Bleeding. After the encounter, fail Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance and lose 1 toe, Amputation (Average +2 SL).

rows.name: Ruptured Tendon
textFields: Wounds: 3. Gain 1 Stunned, Prone and Torn Muscle (Major); fail Hard (-2 SL) Endurance and also gain Unconscious.

rows.name: Torn Thigh
textFields: Wounds: 3. Gain 3 Bleeding. Until Surgery, further Wounds to that leg add one Bleeding.

rows.name: Hacked Leg
textFields: Wounds: 3. Gain 2 Bleeding, 1 Stunned, Prone and Broken Bone (Minor).

rows.name: Dislocated Knee
textFields: Wounds: 4. Gain Prone; leg unusable until reset (Amputated Parts, page 177). Extended Average (+2 SL) Heal, 6 SL, one Test per Round, resets it. Then halve Movement for 1d10 days.

rows.name: Cracked Shin
textFields: Wounds: 4. Gain 1 Stunned, Prone, Broken Bone (Minor) and Torn Muscle (Major).

rows.name: Broken Knee
textFields: Wounds: 4. Gain 1 Bleeding, 1 Stunned, Prone and Broken Bone (Major).

rows.name: Crushed Foot
textFields: Wounds: 4. Gain 2 Bleeding. Fail Average (+2 SL) Endurance and also gain Prone, losing 1 toe plus 1 per SL below 0, Amputation (Average +2 SL). Without Surgery within Toughness Bonus days, lose the foot.

rows.name: Severed Foot
textFields: Wounds: 5. Lose the foot, Amputation (Hard -2 SL); gain 3 Bleeding, 2 Stunned and Prone.

rows.name: Cut Tendon
textFields: Wounds: 5. Gain 2 Bleeding, 2 Stunned and Prone; leg permanently unusable, Amputation (Very Hard -3 SL).

rows.name: Shattered Pelvis
textFields: Wounds: Death. Instant death from traumatic shock after pelvic destruction and loss of a leg.

rows.name: Extra Mouth
textFields: Determine the affected location with one roll on the Hit Locations table.

rows.name: Glowing Skin
textFields: Provides as much light as a candle.

rows.name: Patchy Feathers
textFields: Roll twice on the Hit Locations table to determine the affected locations.

rows.name: Spiny Protrusions
textFields: Determine the affected location with one roll on the Hit Locations table.

rows.name: Uneven Horns
textFields: +1 Armour Point to Head; gain Horns

rows.name: Whiskered Snout
textFields: Gain Acute Sense (Smell); +2 SL to Track Tests

rows.name: Chaotic Dreams
textFields: Suffer Fatigued during each day’s first two hours.

rows.name: Hateful Impulses
textFields: Animosity applies to every other Species.

rows.name: Lonely Spirit
textFields: While alone, suffer −10 to every Test.

rows.name: Shaky Morale
textFields: Failing a Fear Test also inflicts Broken.

rows.name: Unending Malice
textFields: Tests to hurt receive +1 SL; all other Tests suffer −1 SL.
